Frost Blossom
weapon.201.text: 水属性マス配置中、攻撃時にまれに敵を凍結状態にする
While deployed on a Water element tile, rarely Freezes the enemy on attack
unit.201.profile:
手裏剣のような小さな武器から自身の等身大人形まで、何でも氷で作れてしまうつらら女娘。
愛に一途な性格で、身体は氷のように冷たいが心は熱く情熱的で、惚れっぽい。高温なものは苦手だが、身体をカチコチに凍らせれば、温泉旅行で熱々の鍋を食べたりすることも可能だとか。その昔、想い人に逃げられたという悲しい過去があるらしい。

An icicle woman who can make anything out of ice, from small weapons like shuriken to a life-size doll of herself.
Devoted in love, her body is as cold as ice but her heart burns with passion, and she falls for people easily. She's not good with high temperatures, but if she freezes her body solid, she can apparently still enjoy a piping hot hotpot on a hot spring trip. It's said she has a sad past in which the one she loved once ran away from her.
unit.202.title: 号令のシルバードラゴン娘

Silver Dragon's Starting Call
unit.202.profile: その冷静さと正確さからスターター役を任されたシルバードラゴン娘。彼女のコンマ一秒にも拘った開始の合図には、他の生徒たちも納得してしまう完璧さである。運動会のようなお祭り事は苦手だそうだが、人間観察が趣味の彼女は運動会をちょっと普通と違う観点で楽しんでいるらしい。

A silver dragon girl entrusted with the role of starter for her calm and precise nature. Her starting signal, meticulous down to the hundredth of a second, is so flawless that even the other students can't help but be convinced. She's reportedly not fond of festival-like events such as sports days, but since people-watching is her hobby, she apparently enjoys sports day from a slightly different angle than most.
unit.203.title: 援武のカトブレパス娘
Cheerleading Catoblepas Girl
race.203.text:
常に攻撃対象数+1
範囲内の自身を除く味方の攻撃力を自身の攻撃力の50%<aw>+10%</aw>分上昇

Always targets hit +1
Increases ATK of allies in range other than herself by 50%<aw>+10%</aw> of her own ATK
race.203.name: がんばれ～がんばれ～
Go Go, Fight Fight~

[duration]秒間攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍

skill.203.name: ポンポンシャワー
Pom-Pom Shower
unit.203.profile: チアリーダーを任されたカトブレパス娘。特にやる気はなかったが、居眠りしている間に周りの推薦によって勝手に決まった。運動会の応援の花形として、振り付けをどうするかを考えるよりも、どうやって練習をサボるかについて頭を悩ませている。２つのおっきなポンポンは自前らしい。

A catoblepas girl put in charge of cheerleading. She had no particular motivation for it, but it was decided for her by everyone else while she was dozing off. As the star of the sports day cheer squad, she spends more time racking her brain over how to skip practice than over choreography. Her 2 big pom-poms are apparently her own.
unit.204.title: シャドウエルフ娘
Shadow Elf Girl
race.204.text:
闇属性マス配置中は敵の遠距離攻撃の対象にならず、攻撃力+20％<aw>+10%</aw>
<t=闇の庵トークン>闇の庵トークン</t>を使役可能、トークンは配置20秒後に消滅する

Ruler of Shadows

スキル発動時に1度だけ、
範囲内の闇属性の味方がいるマスを闇属性マスに変化

skill.204.name: 闇の祝福
Blessing of Darkness
unit.204.profile:
闇の精霊を従えるダークエルフたちの長。無慈悲にして残酷であり種族の大義に関することならどんな手段もいとわない。ダークエルフこそが至上の存在で、島を統べるにふさわしいと考えている。そのため、美少年を一族の所有物にすべく、あれこれと画策しているらしいのだが、結局、ダークエルフ娘のティーレやレティアに阻止されている。
また一族の中では最年長のため、実は年齢を気にしているらしく、『長老』と呼ぶことはタブーとなっている。

Leader of the dark elves who command spirits of darkness. Merciless and cruel, she'll resort to any means necessary when it comes to her race's greater cause. She believes dark elves are the supreme beings, rightfully fit to rule the island. To that end, she's apparently scheming various plots to claim handsome young men as property of her clan, though she's ultimately thwarted every time by the dark elf girls Tiere and Retia.
Being the eldest of her clan, she's apparently quite sensitive about her age, and calling her 'Elder' is strictly taboo.
unit.205.title: レイス娘
Wraith Girl
race.205.text:
ワープして移動するが、移動コスト+5
攻撃時に相手の攻撃力を2％減少、減少値の2倍<aw>+0.5倍</aw>自身の攻撃力を増加

30% chance to evade physical and magic attacks

Wandering Spirit
race.205.bonus: 攻撃力減少値に対する攻撃力増加+0.5倍
ATK increase relative to ATK lowered +0.5×
skill.205.text: スキル発動時にクリティカル率100%、クリティカルダメージ+[0,0,0]%で1度だけ周囲の敵全てを攻撃
On skill activation, Crit rate 100%, Crit damage +[0,0,0]%, attacks all nearby enemies, 1 time(s) only
skill.205.name: ソウルサイス
Soul Scythe
unit.205.profile: 幽体離脱の術を使用し、失敗して魂と肉体が分離したモンスター娘。いわゆる生霊と呼ばれる存在であり、元は魔導師の端くれだったらしい。しかし、美少年の愛らしさに囚われた結果、好みの美少年の魂を求めて幽体離脱を行い、長い年月をさまよい歩いていた。すでに元の肉体がどこにあるかも忘れてしまったが、強い美少年のオーラを感じてゲシュペンス島へ迷い込んだようだ。自らが幽体であるため、美少年を幽体にして色んなコトを楽しみたいと考えている。

A monster girl who attempted astral projection, failed, and ended up with her soul and body separated. She's what's known as a living spirit, and was apparently once a fledgling sorceress. However, having become captivated by the loveliness of handsome young men, she left her body to seek out the souls of her favorite type, wandering for long years. She's since forgotten where her original body even is, but she seems to have wandered onto Gespenst Island after sensing a strong aura of handsome young men. Since she herself is a spirit, she wants to turn handsome young men into spirits too, so she can enjoy all sorts of things with them.
unit.206.title: 蹴才のハーピー娘
Harpy Girl of Swift Legs
race.206.text:
飛行して移動(ブロック0にならない)
移動中の速度が2倍
物理と魔法攻撃を20％<aw>＋5％</aw>の確率で攻撃を回避
風属性マス配置時は回避効果が倍化

Flies to move (Block does not become 0)
Move speed ×2 while moving
20%<aw>+5%</aw> chance to evade physical and magic attacks
Evasion effect doubles when deployed on a Wind element tile
race.206.name: 疾風の脚力
Swift Wind Legs
skill.206.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍
4連続攻撃を行い、攻撃した敵を低確率で吹き飛ばす

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0]
Performs 4 consecutive attacks; small chance to blow away enemies hit
skill.206.name: 邪魔しないで！
Don't Get in My Way!
unit.206.profile:
運動会といえば、脚力に自信がある自分の出番だと張りきっているハーピー娘。
パンをくわえたまま「いっけなーい、遅刻遅刻♪」というセリフを繰り返しながら走り込みをするのが日課。それも全ては優勝のため、かと思いきや、実は別の目的があるらしい。
それは『パンをくわえたまま、道の角で誰かとぶつかると恋が発展する』というジンクスを信じているからである。

When it comes to sports day, this harpy girl is fired up, confident that her leg strength is finally her time to shine.
Her daily routine is to run full-tilt with bread in her mouth, repeating the line 'Oh no, I'm late, I'm late~♪.' You'd think it was all for the sake of winning, but she actually has another motive.
It's because she believes the jinx that 'if you run with bread in your mouth and crash into someone at a street corner, romance will blossom.'
unit.207.title: 風神娘
Fujin Girl
race.207.text:
射程+30、飛行して移動し攻撃した相手を後退させる
攻撃時、7秒間全ての味方の移動速度を+60<aw>+15</aw>

Range +30; flies to move and knocks back enemies hit
On attack, increases all allies' Move speed by +60<aw>+15</aw> for 7s
race.207.name: 神の追い風
The God's Tailwind
race.207.bonus: 攻撃時の味方の移動速度+15
skill.207.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
4連続で攻撃する

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Attacks 4 times in a row
skill.207.name: 大暴風
Great Tempest
weapon.207.name: 疾風袋シナト
Shinato's Wind Bag
weapon.207.text: 風属性マス配置ボーナス効果が2倍、スキル発動中風属性マス配置状態になる
Wind element tile deployment bonus ×2; counts as deployed on a Wind element tile while the skill is active
unit.207.profile: 雷神娘とは腐れ縁。背負った大きな風袋がトレードマークのモンスター娘。正義のヒーローに憧れ、ヒーロー活動と称した人助けをするべく西に東に風のように飛び回る……といえば聞こえはいいのだが、豪胆かつ大雑把な性格ゆえに助け方が力任せの風任せ。人助けのはずが被害を拡大してしまうことも。風と一緒に様々な菌やウィルスも運んでしまうため、彼女と出会うと何らかの病気にかかることも。

She has an inseparable, love-hate bond with the Raijin girl. A monster girl whose trademark is the huge wind sack she carries on her back. She admires heroes of justice and flits about east and west like the wind, helping people under the banner of 'hero activities'—which sounds nice, but her bold and slapdash nature means her help relies purely on brute force and the wind's whims. Sometimes what's meant to help people ends up making the damage worse instead. Since she carries various germs and viruses along with the wind, meeting her can sometimes leave you with some kind of illness.
unit.208.title: 雷神娘
Raijin Girl
race.208.text:
攻撃した相手にスタン値を蓄積
（蓄積値：小）
スタン中の敵に与えるダメージ2倍
配置中、10回攻撃する毎に、攻撃速度が上昇する
上昇回数は最大5回<aw>+2回</aw>、撤退後も持続する

Builds up Stun on the enemy hit
(build-up: small)
Damage dealt to Stunned enemies ×2
While deployed, Attack speed increases every 10 attacks
Up to 5<aw>+2</aw> increases, persisting even after retreating
race.208.name: 雷神太鼓
Raijin's Drums
race.208.bonus: 攻撃速度の上昇最大数+2回
Max number of Attack speed increases +2
skill.208.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍
遠距離魔法攻撃に変化し、
広範囲の敵5体まで同時に攻撃

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0]
Becomes a ranged magic attack, and
attacks up to 5 enemies at once over a wide area
skill.208.name: 大召雷
Great Thunder Summon
unit.208.profile: 常にトレーニングを欠かさないモンスター娘。腐れ縁である風神娘のトラブルに巻き込まれることが多く、問題解決のためには「言葉より拳が何よりも重い」と悟り、身体を鍛えるに至った。極限まで苦しいメニューをこなし、身体を痛めつけるので、トレーニング狂いの脳筋扱いされるが、かなりの頭脳派。手順が難しい米作りを趣味としている。マイ畑を所有し、故郷の島では『雷神娘印のお米』は名ブランドなんだとか。

A monster girl who never skips training. Frequently dragged into trouble by her inseparable friend, the Fujin girl, she came to realize that 'fists speak louder than words' when it comes to solving problems, and took up training her body. She pushes herself through brutally punishing routines that batter her own body, so she's treated as a training-obsessed meathead, but she's actually quite the brain. Her hobby is growing rice, a notoriously complicated process. She owns her own field, and back on her home island, 'Raijin Girl Brand Rice' is apparently a famous label.
unit.209.title: ファイアードレイク娘
Firedrake Girl
race.209.text:
配置中、範囲内の火属性の味方の火属性マス配置ボーナス効果が3倍
常に魔法攻撃化し、配置中範囲内の敵に攻撃力15％<aw>＋5％</aw>の継続ダメージ、火属性マス配置中は追加で2倍分のダメージを与える

While deployed, Fire element tile deployment bonus for Fire element allies in range ×3
Always becomes a magic attack; while deployed, deals damage over time to enemies in range equal to 15%<aw>+5%</aw> of ATK, with an additional ×2 damage while deployed on a Fire element tile
race.209.name: 竜炎の舞
Dance of Dragon Flame
race.209.bonus: 範囲内への継続ダメージ+5％
Damage over time to enemies in range +5%
skill.209.text:
[duration]秒攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍、攻撃対象数+1、攻撃した敵を後退させる
自身を含む範囲内の味方を、火属性マスに配置中の状態にする

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0], targets hit +1, knocks back enemies hit
Counts allies in range, including herself, as deployed on a Fire element tile
skill.209.name: 猛火焔舞
Blazing Flame Dance
unit.209.profile: 高みを目指して熱くトレーニングを続けて限界を超えた結果、種族すらも超越したファイアードレイク娘。進化するまで追い込んだ結果、ブレーキが壊れてしまい今まで以上に熱く燃え盛っている。今までの何倍も強くなったが、今までの何倍も暑苦しい。彼女が居るだけで気温が１００度以上は上がると言われている。

A firedrake girl who pushed her fiery training past her limits in pursuit of new heights, and in doing so, transcended her own species. Having driven herself all the way to evolution, her brakes have broken, and now she burns hotter than ever. She's grown many times stronger than before, but also many times more stifling to be around. It's said the temperature rises by at least 100 degrees just from her being present.
unit.210.title: ナベリウス娘
Naberius Girl
race.210.text:
飛行して移動し、配置時とスキル発動時、敵全員の攻撃力が[attack,[MAG,0,0]]減少（減少量は基本攻撃力に依存）
与ダメージが80%<aw>＋10％</aw>になるが、常に3連続攻撃で弾速が上昇する

Flies to move; on deployment and skill activation, lowers all enemies' ATK by [attack,[MAG,0,0]] (scales with base ATK)
Damage dealt becomes 80%<aw>+10%</aw>, but always fires 3 shots in a row with increased projectile speed
race.210.name: 三首の魔銃
Three-Headed Magic Gun
race.210.bonus: 与ダメージ減少量が10％緩和
skill.210.text:
[duration]秒攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
攻撃間隔が大幅に減少し、6連続攻撃
攻撃が必中になり敵の回避効果を無視する

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Attack interval greatly decreases, 6 consecutive attacks
Attacks always hit, ignoring enemy evasion
skill.210.name: 乱れ撃つわん！
Firing Wildly, Woof!
unit.210.profile: ゲシュペンス島から失われつつある『おねショタ』を復権するために、進化したナベリウス娘。難事件もズバッと解決するために、空を飛ぶ翼に今まで以上の戦闘能力、更には頭脳までパワーアップした完璧な警察官となった。しかし、肝心の性格などに関してはパワーアップしても今まで通りである。

A Naberius girl who evolved to restore the fading 'onee-shota' culture on Gespenst Island. To crack even the toughest cases in a flash, she gained wings to fly, even greater combat ability than before, and a boost to her intellect, becoming the perfect police officer. However, when it comes to the most important part—her personality—she's exactly the same as ever, power-up or not.
unit.211.title: 槌投のゴースト娘
Hammer-Throwing Ghost Girl
race.211.text:
自身そっくりのトークンを使役可能
トークン1体まで配置人数に含まれず、スキル使用可能
スタン状態の敵に与ダメージが1.3<aw>+0.2</aw>倍

Can command a Token that looks just like her
Up to 1 Tokens do not count toward the deployment limit, and can use skills
Damage dealt to Stunned enemies ×1.3<aw>+0.2×</aw>
race.211.name: スイングエージェント
Swing Agent
race.211.bonus: スタン状態の敵に与えるダメージ+0.2倍
skill.211.text:
[duration]秒攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、遠距離範囲攻撃を行いスタン値を蓄積（中）
スキル終了後、次回スキル使用時の攻撃力・射程が強化（最大2回）

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0]; performs a ranged area attack and builds up Stun (medium)
After the skill ends, ATK and Range are enhanced the next time the skill is used (up to 2 times)
skill.211.name: シャドウスローイング
Shadow Throwing
unit.211.profile:
モンスター娘学園の運動会にて、ハンマー投げ選手に選ばれたゴースト娘。日中は外に出られない体質だったが、凄腕コーチと猛特訓によって克服した。競技では投げたハンマーがなぜか戻ってきたり、宙に浮いたまま落下しなかったりしたが、それは彼女のせいではなく何者かの力によるものらしい。
ハンマー投げの練習よりも、シャウトの練習の方にこだわりを持って取り組んでいる。

A ghost girl chosen as the hammer throw competitor at the Monster Girl Academy's sports day. She used to be constitutionally unable to go outside during the day, but overcame it thanks to a skilled coach and intense training. During competition, her thrown hammer would inexplicably come back to her or hang in midair without falling, but that's apparently not her doing—it's the work of some other power.
Rather than practicing her hammer throw, she's far more dedicated to practicing her shout.
unit.212.title: アークデーモン娘
Archdemon Girl
race.212.text:
闇属性マス配置時、与ダメージが1.2倍上昇
編成時闇属性モンスター娘の攻撃力+16％<aw>+4%</aw>、ただし最大HP-10%
スキル発動時、配置中のマスが闇属性に変化

While deployed on a Dark element tile, damage dealt ×1.2
When in the party, Dark element monster girls' ATK +16%<aw>+4%</aw>, but Max HP -10%
On skill activation, her deployment tile becomes a Dark element tile
race.212.name: 悪を統べる者
Ruler of Evil
race.212.bonus: 闇属性モンスター娘の攻撃+4％
skill.212.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、
射程[MAG,1,0]倍、攻撃対象数+1
種族特性の与ダメージ効果を2倍

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0],
Range ×[MAG,1,0], targets hit +1
Race trait damage dealt effect ×2
skill.212.name: 糧になってもらおうか！
You'll Become My Sustenance!
unit.212.profile:
ザコ悪魔から上位悪魔に成りあがった悪魔モンスター娘。
向上心の塊でとにかく意識が高い。目指すはてっぺん。世界を統べるをスローガンにして地道な努力を重ねている。努力は決して裏切らないと信じているため、魔道の修練はかかさない。が、修練では高度な術でも周囲に関係なくぶっ放すので、決して近づいてはならない。

A demon monster girl who rose from a weakling demon to a high-ranking one.
A bundle of ambition, she's constantly striving to better herself. Her goal is the very top. With 'rule the world' as her slogan, she keeps up steady, unglamorous effort. Believing that hard work never betrays you, she never skips her magical training. However, during training she fires off advanced spells regardless of who's around, so never approach her while she's at it.
unit.213.title: 大天狗娘
Great Tengu Girl
race.213.text:
飛行して移動(ブロック0にならない)
風属性マス配置中、毎秒ACTゲージが3％<aw>+1％</aw>上昇。
剣気解放中、クリティカル率、クリティカル率上限+20%

Flies to move (Block does not become 0)
While deployed on a Wind element tile, ACT gauge increases by 3%<aw>+1%</aw> per second.
During Sword Aura Release, Crit rate and Crit rate cap +20%
race.213.name: 自惚の天狗長
Conceited Tengu Chief
race.213.bonus: 風マス配置時のACTゲージ獲得+1％
ACT gauge gain while deployed on a Wind tile +1%
skill.213.text:
[duration]秒、最大HP[MAG,0,0]倍、攻撃力[MAG,1,0]倍
攻撃した敵を低確率で吹き飛ばす
クリティカル時は更に確率が上昇

[duration]s: Max HP ×[MAG,0,0], ATK ×[MAG,1,0]
Small chance to blow away enemies hit
Chance increases further on Crit
skill.213.name: 疾走・竜巻剣
Sprint: Tornado Blade
weapon.213.name: 名刀・鼻山オロシ
Famed Blade: Hanayama Oroshi
weapon.213.text: クリティカル率とクリティカル率上限+30％
Crit rate and Crit rate cap +30%
unit.213.profile: 美しく大きな翼をもつ天狗系モンスター娘たちのリーダー。自ら様々な術式を作りだせるほど豊富な知識を持っており、その知識を周囲に惜しみなく分け与えている。そのため周囲に頼りにされることも多いようだ。性格は明るく情熱的なナルシスト。ただ自分だけではなく美しいものすべてを偏愛しており、見目麗しいモンスター娘たちにも甘い。しかし、その反面美しくないものには厳しく、すぐに燃やしてしまおうとする恐ろしい一面もあるという。

Leader of the tengu-type monster girls with beautiful, large wings. She possesses such vast knowledge that she can create various techniques of her own, and generously shares that knowledge with those around her. As a result, she's often relied upon by others. She's cheerful and passionate, with a narcissistic streak. However, she doesn't only love herself—she's infatuated with all things beautiful, and is quite indulgent toward good-looking monster girls too. On the other hand, she's harsh toward anything not beautiful, and is said to have a frightening side that tries to burn it away without hesitation.
unit.214.title: ベルフェゴール娘
Belphegor Girl
race.214.text:
攻撃した敵の攻撃速度が6<aw>+3</aw>秒間減少する
スキル中攻撃間隔が大幅に減少するが、非スキル中は攻撃間隔が増加する
スキルを使用する度にスキル待機時間が7秒短縮する
（最大3回/撤退死亡後も継続）

Attack speed of the enemy hit decreases for 6<aw>+3</aw>s
Attack interval greatly decreases during her skill, but increases while her skill is not active
Each time her skill is used, its cooldown shortens by 7s
(up to 3 times; persists even after retreating or death)
race.214.name: 怠惰の悪魔
Demon of Sloth
race.214.bonus: 敵への攻撃速度減少効果時間+3秒
Attack speed reduction duration on enemies +3s
skill.214.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
攻撃対象数+[0,2,0]
次回スキルの攻撃力上昇量が+0.4倍、攻撃対象数+1（最大3回）

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Targets hit +[0,2,0]
The next skill's ATK increase +0.4×, targets hit +1 (up to 3 times)
skill.214.name: 研究の成果よ～
The Fruits of My Research~
unit.214.profile: 怠惰を司る悪魔モンスター娘。掃除や洗濯、料理など身の回りの生活全てを自らの発明品に任せている。才能豊かな発明家で、便利グッズの開発に勤しんでおり、楽をするためならどんな労力もいとわない。研究時間以外はすべて合理的かつ短時間で済ませたいと考えており、トイレに行く時間も削減するため、常に便器の上で生活をしている。ちなみに便器も発明品で排泄はもちろんのこと、移動や読書、快適な睡眠までサポートしてくれる代物らしい。座右の銘は「便器で快適な生活を」

A demon monster girl who governs sloth. She leaves all of her daily life—cleaning, laundry, cooking—to her own inventions. A gifted inventor, she devotes herself to developing convenient gadgets, and spares no effort if it means avoiding effort herself. Outside of her research time, she wants everything done efficiently and quickly, and to cut down on time spent going to the bathroom, she lives permanently on top of a toilet. Incidentally, that toilet is also her own invention, supposedly supporting not just waste disposal but also transportation, reading, and comfortable sleep. Her motto is, 'A comfortable life on the toilet.'
unit.215.title: ベルゼブブ娘
Beelzebub Girl
race.215.text:
編成時、<t=悪魔>悪魔</t>の攻撃力+14%<aw>+3％</aw>
<t=執事トークン>執事トークン</t>を使役する
自身と執事トークンの攻撃時、まれに相手を猛毒状態にする

When in the party, <t=悪魔>Demon</t>'s ATK +14%<aw>+3%</aw>
Commands <t=執事トークン>Butler Token</t>
On attack by self or Butler Token, rarely inflicts Deadly Poison on the target
race.215.name: 悪魔の宰相
The Demon's Chancellor
race.215.bonus: When in the party, Demon ATK +3%
skill.215.text:
射程[MAG,0,0]倍、スキルは自身が通常攻撃を行い続ける限り持続する
自身と自トークンの足元に魔力の奔流を作り出し
奔流内の敵に攻撃力100%の持続ダメージが発生

Range ×[MAG,0,0]; the skill persists as long as she keeps performing normal attacks
Creates a torrent of magic beneath herself and her own Token
Enemies within the torrent take damage over time equal to 100% of ATK
skill.215.name: ソウルサクリファイス
Soul Sacrifice
unit.215.profile: ハエの頭のような帽子や羽のようなスカートを着こなす悪魔の宰相。仕事ができる彼女は知的な印象を持たれがちだが、私生活はとんでもなくだらしない。書類はそのまま破り捨てる、脱いだものは脱ぎっぱなし、食べたものも投げ捨てる……などなど。放っておくと住処はすぐに汚部屋となるため、部下が定期的に片づけているらしい。また、常に腹を空かせており、食べられるものは何でも食べる。たとえ床におちたものでも気にせず食べようとするため、部下の苦労は絶えないという。

The demon chancellor, dressed in a fly-head-like hat and wing-like skirt. Capable at her job, she tends to come across as intelligent, but her private life is a disaster. She tears up documents and tosses them aside, leaves whatever she's taken off lying around, throws away what she's eaten... and so on. Left unchecked, her home quickly turns into a filthy mess, so her subordinates apparently clean up after her regularly. She's also always hungry and will eat anything edible—even something dropped on the floor, without a second thought—so her subordinates' troubles never end.
unit.216.title: ヴォジャノーイ娘
Vodyanoy Girl
race.216.text:
天候：雨状態の時、与えるダメージが<naw>1.2</naw><aw>1.3</aw>倍
水属性マス配置時、または天候：雨状態の時、スキル準備時間が3秒毎に1秒短縮

While the weather is Rain, damage dealt ×<naw>1.2</naw><aw>1.3</aw>

Ruler of the Rain

unit.216.profile: 水辺に生息するモンスター娘。人間が嫌いで、湖のそばを通りがかった人間を水の中に引きずり込んで、ペットにして自分の住み処で働かせている。また、気に入った美少年はペロリといただいちゃうこともあるらしい。楽観的でのんびり屋で、何があってもケロっとしているのが特徴。

A monster girl who lives by the water. She dislikes humans, dragging any who pass by the lake into the water, keeping them as pets, and putting them to work in her home. She also apparently sometimes just gobbles up any handsome young man she takes a liking to. Optimistic and easygoing, she's known for staying unfazed no matter what happens.
unit.217.title: 祝砲のヒポグリフ娘

unit.217.profile: クリスマスパーティーを盛り上げるべく、特大クラッカーに持ち変えたヒポグリフ娘。合いの手のようにクラッカーを鳴らしまくるが、音が大きすぎて逆に場の空気を冷やしてしまうことも。ささやかな膨らみを大きくするため、世界のどこかにあるといわれている「願いが叶うクラッカー」を探しているらしい。

A hippogriff girl who's switched to an extra-large party popper to liven up the Christmas party. She fires it off like a rhythmic accompaniment, but sometimes the bang is so loud it actually kills the mood instead. To make her modest bust a bit bigger, she's apparently searching for the legendary 'wish-granting cracker' said to exist somewhere in the world.

Flower Orchestra
unit.218.profile: 楽器に興味を持ち、自ら演奏するようになったことで進化したガーデンノーム娘。土人形たちを引き連れてガーデンノーム音楽隊を結成し、様々な楽曲を奏でている。音楽に詳しいモンスター娘から教わり鍛えたヴァイオリンの音色は誰もが聞き惚れるほど。時折発明でこっそり自動演奏をしているという噂がある。

A garden gnome girl who evolved after taking an interest in musical instruments and learning to play herself. She's formed a Garden Gnome Music Band with her clay dolls in tow, playing all kinds of tunes. The sound of her violin, honed under the guidance of a monster girl well-versed in music, is captivating enough to enchant anyone who hears it. Rumor has it she sometimes secretly uses an invention to play automatically instead.

Cake Frenzy!
unit.219.profile: 最高のきゃわわを追究するうちに甘い香りのするキャンドル、甘いハチミツケーキ作りに目覚めたワーベア娘。「甘いケーキときゃわわなテティちゃんは最高のマリアージュ！」と胸を張るが、ケーキの方に人気を奪われているらしい。

A werebear girl who, in her pursuit of the ultimate cuteness, awakened to sweet-scented candles and baking sweet honey cakes. She proudly declares, 'Sweet cake and cute little Teti make the perfect pairing!'—though it seems the cake is the one stealing all the popularity.

Flame Guardian Dragon
unit.220.profile: 聖域で”神秘の果実”を守り続けているモンスター娘。神秘の果実の効力は非常に恐ろしく、匂いを嗅ぐだけで身体に活力が満ちてしまうため、創世記時代の少年に守ることを頼まれてしまった。それから不眠不休でずーっと実の守護を続けている。百の竜を従えており、その百の竜は様々な言語で話すらしい。その影響かわからないが、たまに上空を見つめ何かと交信している姿が目撃されている。

A monster girl who continues to guard the 'mystic fruit' in a sacred sanctuary. The fruit's power is extraordinarily fearsome—just smelling it fills the body with vitality—so a boy from the age of creation asked her to guard it. She's kept watch over the fruit without rest ever since. She commands a hundred dragons, said to speak in many different languages. Perhaps because of that, she's sometimes been spotted gazing up at the sky, seemingly communicating with something.
unit.221.title: 巫女舞のリザードマン娘

unit.221.profile: 良い１年を願って祈りを捧げる巫女となったリザードマン娘。お手製の神楽鈴を鳴らして踊ることで偉大なる獣神に願いを届けることができるようだが、それとは別に対価も必要らしい。自作のお姉ちゃんおみくじで「大吉吉」を引くと頭を熱烈によしよしされてしまう。

A lizardman girl who became a shrine maiden, offering prayers for a good 1. By ringing her handmade kagura bells and dancing, she can apparently deliver wishes to the great Beast God, though it seems a separate price must also be paid. If you draw a 'Great-Great Luck' from her homemade Big Sister Fortune Slips, you'll get your head enthusiastically petted.

unit.222.profile: 管狐を使って人の心を読み取ることができるモンスター娘。とてもまじめな性格で、この忍法を人の役に立てたいと思っているようだ。ただ人の心を読み取る際、えちちなことも一緒に読み取ってしまうムッツリな一面も。管狐をイヤらしいことに使ってはいけない、と思いながらも欲望には勝てないらしい。

A monster girl who can read people's minds using her tube fox familiar. She's very earnest and seems to want to use this ninja art to help others. However, when reading someone's mind, she also inevitably picks up on their lewd thoughts, revealing a secretly perverted side. She knows she shouldn't use her tube fox for indecent purposes, but apparently can't win against her own desires.

Bear Swing
unit.223.profile: 大きな熊の手足を持つモンスター娘。小さくきゃしゃだが、凄まじい怪力で恐怖の対象とされてきたことから、人目を避けて生活していた。そのため寡黙。しかし、人間のことは好きなのでこっそりと手助けしている。たくさんの人が楽しんでいるお祭りには興味津々で、いつか参加したいと思っているらしい。

A monster girl with the large limbs of a bear. Though small and slight herself, her tremendous strength has made her an object of fear, so she's lived avoiding the public eye. As a result, she's a woman of few words. Still, she likes humans, and secretly helps them out. She's intensely curious about festivals where lots of people have fun, and apparently hopes to join in one day.

unit.224.profile: トナカイになり代わってソリを引き、プレゼントを配りまくるアンドロスフィンクス娘。贈り物は砂漠を探索中に掘り当てた品やソリの振動で崩れたケーキなど。プレゼントはほとんどが役に立たないものばかりだが、中にはとんでもないお宝もあるらしい。

An androsphinx girl who's taken the reindeer's place pulling the sleigh, handing out presents left and right. Her gifts include things she's dug up while exploring the desert and cakes that crumbled from the sleigh's jostling. Most of the presents are pretty useless, but apparently some turn out to be incredible treasures.
unit.225.title: 氷雪のカリュブディス娘

Christmas Brinicle
unit.225.profile: 渦潮を氷細工へと変化させ、剣と盾に持ち変えたカリュブディス娘。クリスマスが明けるまで断食しなければならないらしく、欲望を必死でおさえている。しかし頑強で立派なボートを見かけると、ガマンしていたものが思わず爆発してしまうこともあるようだ。

A Charybdis girl who's turned her whirlpool into ice sculptures, trading her weapon for a sword and shield. She apparently has to fast until Christmas is over, so she's desperately holding back her urges. However, if she spots a sturdy, splendid boat, all that pent-up restraint sometimes explodes without warning.
unit.226.title: 闇の墓守
Dark Gravekeeper
race.226.text:

While deployed, own ATK +25% for every 1 Dark element monster girls deployed as allies
unit.226.profile:
異世界にてダーク王子の臣下を務める、アンデッドの魔術師。現在の姿は、ゲシュペンス島にてロリ化する溶岩に足を滑らせた際に、肉体を授かって蘇った姿である。
世界を渡る機会があるたびに、ロリ化溶岩に関する研究を行っているらしい。また、リッチ娘リコとの交流も深く、寝食を忘れ研究に没頭する姿勢に感銘を受けているようだ。

An undead sorcerer serving as a vassal to the Dark Prince in another world. Her current form is one she was reborn into after slipping on lava that turns things into lolis on Gespenst Island, gaining a physical body in the process.
Since then, it seems that every time she gets the chance to cross worlds, she conducts research on the loli-fying lava. She's also grown close to the lich girl Riko, and seems deeply impressed by her attitude of forgetting to eat or sleep while absorbed in research.
unit.227.title: さとり娘
Satori Girl
race.227.text:
スタン/石化無効
物理/魔法攻撃を40%<aw>+5%</aw>で回避
剣気解放中、回避確率が2倍になり、敵の回避効果を無視する

Immune to Stun and Petrify

race.227.name: 先手の読心術
Mind-Reading First Strike
skill.227.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍
自身の攻撃が防御力無視の貫通属性化し
攻撃した相手をスタンさせる(蓄積値：中)

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0]
Own attacks become piercing and ignore DEF
Stuns the enemy hit (build-up: medium)
skill.227.name: 秘々の心眼
Secret Mind's Eye
awaken.90070.name: スキル時ACT+30%
ACT gauge +30% on skill
unit.227.profile: 他者の心を読むことができるモンスター娘。心の声がうるさすぎて人里にはめったに姿を現さず、山奥で隠れ潜んで暮らしている。ただ、本人は快活で明るいお調子者タイプで退屈が嫌いなため、山奥に迷い込んだ人の前に姿を現しては心を読んで脅かして遊んでいるようだ。なまじ心が読めるせいで、突発的な出来事や無意識の行動にはかなり弱く、滅多に驚かされることはないが、驚かされると「ひぎにゅあああ！！」と素っ頓狂な声が出ることもあるらしい。

A monster girl who can read the minds of others. People's inner voices are far too noisy for her, so she rarely appears near human settlements and lives hidden deep in the mountains. However, she's actually a cheerful, upbeat, fun-loving type who hates being bored, so she seems to enjoy appearing before anyone who wanders into the mountains, reading their minds and startling them for fun. Ironically, because she can read minds, she's quite weak to sudden events or unconscious actions, and is rarely surprised herself—but when she is, she apparently lets out an absurd shriek like 'Hyagnyaaaah!!'
unit.228.title: 賀照のゴールドドラゴン娘
Gold Dragon Girl of New Year's Glory
race.228.text:
スキルを使用する度に、自身の最大HP[0,1,0]%、攻撃力[0,0,0]%上昇
撤退後も持続する（最大5回）

unit.228.profile: 名前通り金ぴかでとても豪華な晴着に身を包んだゴールドドラゴン娘。どうやら配下の者たちから正月はお年玉を渡し、これからよい一年を過ごすため初夢は宝船の絵を枕に入れるなどの情報を仕入れたらしい。女王としてやらねばなるまいと張り切っており、ため込んだ金塊を懸命に丸く削っているところや、宝船の絵を探している姿が目撃されている。

True to her name, a gold dragon girl dressed in dazzling, luxurious New Year's finery. She's apparently learned from her subordinates that at New Year's, one gives out otoshidama money, and that for a good year ahead, you should put a picture of the treasure ship under your pillow for your first dream. Determined to do things properly as a queen, she's been spotted diligently filing down her hoarded gold bars into round coins, as well as searching for a picture of the treasure ship.

unit.229.profile: 短剣を槍に持ち替えて、心機一転で年明けを迎えたバジリスク娘。毒を抑える薬も飲み、準備万端お正月を迎えるも、代わりに石化能力が突出して気づくと周囲に石像ができてしまい、それが新春を寿ぐ有り難い像だと勘違いされてみんなが手を合わせる事態となった。推し詣や聖地巡礼などなど、新年早々推し活に忙しく、普段より財布の紐も緩みがち。元旦課金にお年玉の全てを使い切ってしまったが、本人的にはとても幸せそうである。

A basilisk girl who's traded her dagger for a spear, greeting the New Year with a fresh start. She's even taken medicine to suppress her venom and is fully prepared for New Year's, but as a side effect, her petrification ability has become so pronounced that stone statues keep popping up around her before she notices, and people mistake them for auspicious New Year's idols and start praying to them. Between fan pilgrimages and sacred site visits, she's busy with fan activities right from the start of the year, and her purse strings tend to loosen more than usual. She blew her entire New Year's money on New Year's Day gacha pulls, but she seems very happy about it herself.

unit.230.profile: 伸びをするだけで太陽を隠し、強制的に夜にしてしまう程の巨体を持つモンスター娘。彼女にかかれば象もサイもクジラも簡単に狩り捕られてしまう。また、雄がいなくても産卵ができ、生まれた卵はとても巨大だとか。そんなどこもかしこも大きな彼女は、小さいモノも小さいコトも気にしないおおらかな性格をしている。しかし、家族はとても大事なため、ちょっとでも傷つけられたらすぐさま報復にいく恐ろしい一面も。

A monster girl so enormous that simply stretching blots out the sun and forces night to fall. In her hands, elephants, rhinos, and even whales are easily hunted down. She can also lay eggs without a male, and the eggs she produces are said to be absolutely massive. Being so big in every way, she has a generous personality that doesn't sweat the small stuff, whether things or matters. However, family is extremely important to her, and she has a frightening side that seeks immediate revenge the moment they're harmed, even slightly.

unit.231.profile: 猿の頭部、虎の手足、狸の胴体、蛇の尻尾を持つモンスター娘。夜、黒煙と共に現れるという、ひょうひょうとした掴みどころのない性格の風来坊。どんな相手にも媚ず、従わず、自分の流儀に従って生きている。そんな彼女は歌うのが趣味で、こっそり夜の森で練習をしているようだ。しかし、一向に上達せず、その歌声は聞いた者を気絶させてしまうほど、おどろおどろしいものだとか。また子どもが好きなので、ママと呼ぶととても興奮するらしい。

A monster girl with the head of a monkey, the limbs of a tiger, the torso of a raccoon dog, and the tail of a snake. A carefree, hard-to-pin-down vagabond said to appear at night trailing black smoke. She flatters no one and obeys no one, living entirely by her own code. Her hobby is singing, and she apparently practices secretly in the night forest. However, she never seems to improve, and her singing voice is so ghastly it can knock out anyone who hears it. She also loves children, and gets extremely excited if you call her 'Mama.'

Cutie Eye
unit.232.profile:
顔の真ん中に鎮座する単眼が魅力の一つ目小僧娘。
明るく元気な性格で、愛らしい上目遣いがチャームポイント。他人の生活を覗き見する趣味があり、気になることは観察しつつ何でもメモメモ。気になり過ぎると追いかけ回してストーカー化してしまう困った一面もある。実は重度の視線恐怖症で、たくさんの好奇な目で見られるのが苦手。

A one-eyed boy girl whose charm point is the single eye sitting in the middle of her face.
Cheerful and energetic, her adorable upward glance is her signature trait. She has a hobby of peeking into other people's lives, observing anything that catches her interest and jotting it all down. If she gets too invested, she has a troublesome habit of chasing after people, turning into a full-blown stalker. Ironically, she actually suffers from a severe fear of being looked at, and hates being on the receiving end of curious stares.

unit.233.profile: 枕を抱えた、見習い忍者のモンスター娘。眠っている人間の枕を裏返すことに全力を注いでおり、潜入技術を極めようと忍者になった。本来眠っている人間が枕を裏返しにされると、魂が夢の世界へ閉じ込められてしまい、二度と起きれなくなる。しかし、彼女は情報収集が終わったら枕を戻してあげるので問題ないとのこと。とはいっても、彼女の枕返しは一度も成功したことはない。

An apprentice ninja monster girl who carries a pillow around. She pours all her effort into flipping the pillows of sleeping humans, and became a ninja to master the art of infiltration. Normally, if a sleeping human's pillow is flipped, their soul gets trapped in the dream world, never to wake up again. However, she insists it's fine, since she flips the pillow back once she's finished gathering information. That said, her pillow-flipping has never once actually succeeded.

unit.234.profile: バレンタインに興味はないのに、同族の女の子からモテモテで毎年バレンタインチョコをたくさんもらえるヴァンパイア娘。チョコレート自体にも関心はなく、美味しいとも思っていない。不要なチョコを投げ捨てながら銃で撃ってみたら面白かったので、それを実戦にも投入している。それでもまだ大量のチョコを持て余し、美少年の生き血を混ぜ込んだブラッドチョコに作り変えてから食べようという、恐ろしい計画を立て、実行もした。しかし今では、チョコを食べすぎた人間は鼻血が出やすい、という事実の方に関心があるようだ。

A vampire girl with no interest in Valentine's Day, yet extremely popular among girls of her own kind, receiving mountains of Valentine's chocolate every year. She has no interest in chocolate itself either, and doesn't even think it tastes good. She found it fun to shoot unwanted chocolates with her gun while tossing them away, so she's now incorporated that into actual combat. Still left with an overwhelming amount of chocolate, she hatched a terrifying plan—and actually carried it out—to remake it into blood chocolate mixed with the fresh blood of handsome young men before eating it. These days, though, she seems more interested in the fact that humans who eat too much chocolate tend to get nosebleeds.

バレンタインは破廉恥行為が横行していて危険だと、いつも以上に風紀の監視に気が張っているアイアンゴーレム娘。
この格好は乙女気分を味わい、バレンタインで風紀が乱れるその理由を身を持って体感しているだけなのだとか。自慢の拳闘を封印し、癒やし手として一歩引いた立ち回りを試みるのも、同じ理由からかもしれない。手作りバレンタインチョコにも挑戦したが、巨大な手ではやはりムリだった。ちなみに今は、彼女が両足で歩くという珍しい姿を見られる貴重なタイミングでもある。

An iron golem girl on extra-high alert for public decency, believing Valentine's Day to be a dangerous time when indecent behavior runs rampant.
Apparently, dressing like this is just her way of experiencing a maiden's feelings firsthand, so she can understand exactly why Valentine's Day corrupts public morals. She may have sealed away her prized fistfighting and taken a step back to try acting as a healer for the same reason. She also tried her hand at making homemade Valentine's chocolate, but it proved impossible with her enormous hands. Incidentally, this is also a rare, valuable chance to see her walking on both legs.

unit.236.profile:
チョコレートを吸収し、体の一部が茶色く変化したスライム娘。体内のチョコに害はないので、毒を吸収したときのような性格の変化は見られない。しかしカカオ成分のおかげで普段よりもお肌はツヤツヤ、舐めるとちゃんと甘い身体になっていて、「今年のバレンタインチョコは私自身だよ♪」という定番文句を、文字通りの意味で体現してしまった。
いったいどういう理屈なのか、戦いのときはチョコ化した体をチョコナイフにして投げつける。チョコパフェにも変化できるらしいが、だから何だと言われたら、それまでである。

A slime girl who's absorbed chocolate, turning part of her body brown. Since the chocolate inside her body is harmless, she doesn't show the same personality changes she does when absorbing poison. However, thanks to the cocoa content, her skin is glossier than usual, and her body has genuinely become sweet to the taste, literally embodying the classic line 'this year's Valentine's chocolate is me myself♪.'
By some logic no one quite understands, when she fights, she turns her chocolate-ified body into a chocolate knife and hurls it at enemies. She can apparently also turn into a chocolate parfait, though if you ask what good that does, well, that's about the size of it.

unit.237.profile: 新年初海賊狩りで得た戦利品の杖を、縁起物として使うことにしたアクアドラゴン娘。お年玉のシステムを弱者への施しだと曲解し、秘蔵の財宝を配下の水棲モンスター娘たちに配ったり、百人一首を訓練も兼ねた実践ゲームに昇華し力と技を競い合ったりと、独自のお正月を楽しんでいる模様。しかし１番の楽しみは、お正月の海での商船狩りなのだとか。

An aqua dragon girl who's decided to use the staff she won as loot from her first pirate hunt of the New Year as a good-luck charm. She's misinterpreted the otoshidama tradition as charity for the weak, distributing her hoarded treasure to the aquatic monster girls under her command, and has elevated the card game hyakunin isshu into a competitive training exercise where strength and skill are put to the test, enjoying her own unique New Year's in the process. However, her number 1 favorite pastime is apparently hunting merchant ships on New Year's at sea.

unit.238.profile: 異世界からやってきた万機の祖たる戦士。亜神トラムの被造物。常に冷静沈着で世界の情報や技術を学び、主のために精進を続けている。亜神製であるためか、記憶容量と知識欲も破格の性能であり、ゲシュペンス島のモンスター娘たちのせいで偏った常識を得てしまっているようだ。

A warrior from another world, the ancestor of all machines. A creation of the demigod Tram. Always calm and composed, she continually learns the world's information and technologies, striving ever onward for her master's sake. Perhaps because she's a demigod's creation, her memory capacity and thirst for knowledge are of exceptional performance, though it seems the monster girls of Gespenst Island have left her with a rather skewed sense of common sense.

When in the party, all monster girls' ATK +3%<aw>+2%</aw>

Flame Lead Vocalist
race.239.bonus: 編成時全モンスター娘の攻撃力+2％
When in the party, all monster girls' ATK +2%
skill.239.text:
[duration]秒、射程[MAG,0,0]倍、自身を含む周囲の味方の攻撃力が自身の基本攻撃力の10%分上昇

OC: restores 7% of Max HP to all allies every 1s
skill.239.name: 不死鳥伝説よ！
Legend of the Phoenix!
unit.239.profile: 正統派のアイドルとして、デビューを果たしたフェニックス娘。スタンドマイクを振り回し、歌と踊りで観客を盛り上げ、迫る敵をも倒していく。ただ、基本的に鳥頭なので歌詞や振り付けを覚えるのは苦手。ゆえに毎日のレッスンは欠かさない努力家な一面もあるという。燃えるような熱いライブが人気で、チケットはいつも即日完売。転生能力を使った唯一無二のライブ演出が話題となり、伝説の不死鳥ライブとして今もなおファンの間で語り継がれているのだとか。

A phoenix girl who made her debut as a proper, mainstream idol. She swings her mic stand around, hyping up the crowd with song and dance while also taking down approaching enemies. However, being fundamentally birdbrained, she's bad at memorizing lyrics and choreography. Because of that, she's also a hard worker who never skips her daily lessons. Her blazing hot live shows are hugely popular, with tickets always selling out the same day. Her unique stage production using her reincarnation ability became a hot topic, and it's still talked about among fans today as the legendary phoenix live.
unit.240.title: ピクシー娘
Pixie Girl
race.240.text:
配置人数に含まれず、
物理と魔法攻撃を30%<aw>+10%</aw>の確率で攻撃を回避
<t=痺れキノコトークン>痺れキノコトークン</t>を使役可能

Does not count toward the deployment limit
30%<aw>+10%</aw> chance to evade physical and magic attacks
Can command <t=痺れキノコトークン>Numbing Mushroom Token</t>
race.240.name: 森の防精
Guardian Spirit of the Forest
skill.240.text:
[duration]秒攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍
魔法攻撃を行い、攻撃した敵を蔦で5秒停止させる

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0]
Performs a magic attack that binds enemies hit with vines, halting them for 5s
skill.240.name: 森からのお仕置き
Punishment from the Forest
unit.240.profile: 小さく愛らしい姿をしている羽のない妖精。妖精の森の平和を守るため、自警団として日夜パトロールに励んでいる。ただ嘘が大嫌いでどんなに些細なものでも許さない。さらに思い込みが激しくて暴走しがちなので勘違いでお仕置きしてしまうことも多い。またかわいい子どもが大好きなので、見かけるとついつい攫ってしまう悪癖もある。そのため周囲からは悪戯好きの妖精と思われているようだ。

A small, adorable, wingless fairy. She works day and night as part of a neighborhood watch to protect the peace of the fairy forest. However, she despises lies and won't forgive even the smallest one. She's also prone to jumping to conclusions and running wild with them, often ending up punishing people over a simple misunderstanding. She also loves cute children so much that she has the bad habit of impulsively kidnapping any she comes across. Because of this, she seems to be seen by those around her as a mischief-loving fairy.
unit.241.title: ティターニア娘
Titania Girl
race.241.text:
飛行して移動し、物理攻撃と魔法攻撃を40%の確率で回避
スキル中、配置中の味方のモンスター娘1体につき、攻撃力が10%増加する
編成時、<t=妖精>妖精</t>の攻撃力+14%<aw>+4%</aw>

Flies to move; 40% chance to evade physical and magic attacks
During her skill, ATK increases by 10% for every 1 deployed ally monster girls
When in the party, <t=妖精>Fairy</t>'s ATK +14%<aw>+4%</aw>
race.241.name: 混沌の妖精女王
Chaos Fairy Queen
skill.241.text:
[duration]秒、与ダメージ[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,2,0]倍
攻撃対象数+1
攻撃時、確率で暗闇を付与する

[duration]s: damage dealt ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,2,0]
Targets hit +1
Chance to inflict Darkness on attack
skill.241.name: ナイトドリーム
Night Dream
unit.241.profile: 闇属性の妖精たちを統べる女王のティターニア娘。妖精王たるオベロン娘とは、創世記の少年を巡って争った過去がある。今でも顔を合わすたびにいがみ合っているが、両者が本気でケンカをすると天変地異が起きてしまうらしいので、実はそこまで関係は悪くないのかもしれない。「立派な妖精＝バストが立派」という持論があり、自身も育乳に励んで自慢の胸を手に入れた。オベロン娘から受けたいたずらの後遺症により、毛深い男性しか性的興味を持てなくなってしまい、さらには動物のロバに興奮してしまうという、困った性癖に陥っているのだとか。

Titania girl, the queen who rules over the dark element fairies. She has a past rivalry with the Fairy King, Oberon girl, over a boy from the age of creation. Even now, they snipe at each other every time they meet, but apparently if the two of them ever fought seriously, it would cause natural disasters, so maybe their relationship isn't actually all that bad. She holds the personal theory that 'a splendid fairy equals a splendid bust,' and has worked hard on her own breast growth to obtain her prized chest. As an aftereffect of a prank played on her by Oberon girl, she's apparently developed the troublesome fetish of only being sexually interested in hairy men, and even getting excited over donkeys.
unit.242.title: うさ耳ロボ
Bunny-Ear Robot
race.242.text:
非ブロック時は遠距離攻撃を行う。
非ブロック中は攻撃力が50％<aw>+10%</aw>上昇
ブロック中は物理防御力・魔法防御力が50％<aw>+10%</aw>上昇

Maxi Commander
race.242.bonus:
非ブロック中の攻撃力+10%
ブロック中の物理・魔法防御力+10%

DEF and MDEF while blocking +10%
skill.242.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
ブロック数が0、攻撃速度が減少するが、直進し触れた敵全てを攻撃する防御無視の遠距離攻撃を行う

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Block becomes 0; Attack speed decreases, but performs a ranged attack that charges straight ahead, hitting all enemies touched and ignoring DEF
skill.242.name: ヒルデの秘密兵器…
Hilde's Secret Weapon...
unit.242.profile:
異世界で製造された完全自律型のアンドロイド娘。正式名称はブリュンヒルデ。機械の身体ながら有機的な特徴もあり、五感も兼ね備えているが、感情には乏しく他者とのコミュニケーションも苦手な模様。「世界を滅びから救う」目的で造られ、戦闘能力が高くいろんな兵器をも使いこなす。ただし演算能力は高くないようで、頭脳の方は高性能ではないようだ。
噂で聞いた話では、その動力源は男性から放出されるアレで、その液体を搾り取るための器官が、ちゃんと股間に備わっているらしい……。

A fully autonomous android girl manufactured in another world. Her official name is Brunhilde. Despite her mechanical body, she also has organic characteristics and possesses all five senses, but seems to lack emotion and is bad at communicating with others. Built with the purpose of 'saving the world from ruin,' she has high combat ability and can wield all kinds of weapons. Her processing power doesn't seem to be very high, though, so her brain isn't exactly top-of-the-line.
According to rumor, her power source is that stuff released by men, and she's apparently properly equipped with an organ between her legs for extracting that fluid...
unit.243.title: 女神
Goddess
race.243.text:
飛行して移動する
配置中、1秒ごとに範囲内の味方のHPを自身の基本最大HPの2%<aw>+1%</aw>回復
一定時間毎に範囲内の全敵に対しさばきのいかづちを落とし短時間スタンさせる（蓄積値：超特大）

Flies to move
While deployed, every 1s, restores allies' HP in range by 2%<aw>+1%</aw> of her base Max HP
At set intervals, drops a judging thunderbolt on all enemies in range, briefly Stunning them (build-up: extra large)
race.243.name: そうせいのめがみ
Goddess of Genesis
race.243.bonus: 味方回復効果の参照量+1%
skill.243.text:
[duration]秒、射程[MAG,0,0]倍、範囲内の味方が受ける物理魔法ダメージを50％減少する
光属性の味方は60％減少し、自身は70%減少する。

[duration]s: Range ×[MAG,0,0], physical and magic damage taken by allies in range -50%
Light element allies -60%, and herself -70%.
skill.243.name: 守護をもたらしなさい…！
Bring Forth Protection...!
unit.243.profile:
聖なる力を持つ創世の女神。邪悪な魔王を滅ぼすため、多くの勇者に洗礼を授けて旅へと送り出している。
元は大人の姿だったが、敵対する何者かによる六祖大縛呪によって幼い姿になってしまった。誰がそんな呪いをかけたのか、聖なる女神にも犯人は分からないようだ。ルカがモンスター娘に敗北すると別世界で反省会を開き、不甲斐なさを厳しく叱責しつつ、弱点や戦い方をアドバイスしてくれるらしい。

A goddess of creation with holy power. To defeat the wicked Demon Lord, she baptizes many heroes and sends them off on their journeys.
She originally had an adult form, but was turned into her current young appearance by a great binding curse cast by some hostile figure using the Six Ancestors' technique. Not even the holy goddess herself seems to know who cast such a curse. Apparently, whenever Luca loses to a monster girl, she holds a reflection session in another world, sternly scolding him for his poor performance while also offering advice on weaknesses and how to fight.
unit.244.title: 学者
Scholar

Mad Sci-Angel

Max HP of allies in range ×[MAG,0,0]
skill.244.name: ちょっとした増強剤です
Just a Little Booster
unit.244.profile:
好奇心の趣くまま実験を重ねるマッドサイエンティストな天使。ゲシュペンス島で初めて目にするモンスター娘や生き物に目を輝かせている。
知識を得るためなら非人道的な実験にも躊躇がないためモンスター娘に体を解剖していいかと尋ねたり、魔導巡洋艦を勝手に分解したりしているようだ。森では食虫植物を研究しているらしいが……近づくとどうなるのかは不明である。

A mad scientist angel who conducts experiment after experiment, following wherever her curiosity leads. Her eyes light up at every monster girl and creature she encounters for the first time on Gespenst Island.
She won't hesitate to run inhumane experiments if it means gaining knowledge, so she's been known to ask monster girls if she can dissect their bodies, or to disassemble magical cruisers without permission. She's apparently researching carnivorous plants in the forest, too... but what happens if you get close is Unknown.
unit.245.title: 暗黒魔導師
Dark Sorcerer
race.245.text:
攻撃力+10％<aw>+4%</aw>、
攻撃が２連続かつ必中になる
ただしHP-10％

ATK +10%<aw>+4%</aw>,
attacks become 2 consecutive hits that always land
However, HP -10%
race.245.name: 魔導師ごっこ
Playing Sorceress
skill.245.text:
発動時、全ての敵に攻撃力分のダメージを2回与える
その後[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍上昇、射程[MAG,1,0]倍、攻撃対象数+1、攻撃が4連射に強化

On activation, deals damage equal to ATK to all enemies 2 times
Then for [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0], targets hit +1, attacks enhanced to 4 shots in a row
skill.245.name: 魔王の暴虐
The Demon Lord's Tyranny
unit.245.profile: 大きな帽子に魔法の杖という典型的な容姿の魔女。暴虐の魔王「黒のアリス」を討ち果たした伝説の勇者ハインリヒの旅に同行している。いつも微笑みを浮かべているが、どこか不気味な雰囲気があるため、お茶会を開くも、参加者は少ないようだ。後世の伝承にも存在が記されていない謎の人物だが、最上級の魔法も扱える高い実力を持っている。苦手な食べ物はぬいぐるみ「クマちゃん」のエサにしているらしい。

A witch with the typical appearance of a large hat and magic staff. She accompanies the legendary hero Heinrich, who defeated the tyrannical Demon Lord 'Black Alice.' She always wears a smile, but has an eerie air about her, so even when she hosts tea parties, few people show up. A mysterious figure whose existence isn't even recorded in later legends, she possesses high skill capable of handling even the most advanced magic. Foods she dislikes apparently get fed to her stuffed animal, 'Kuma-chan.'
unit.246.title: ヴァンパイアガール
Vampire Girl
race.246.text:
攻撃時に相手の攻撃力を20秒2%<aw>+1%</aw>減少、減少値の2倍自身の攻撃力を20秒増加
敵撃破時にコスト+3

On attack, lowers the target's ATK by 2%<aw>+1%</aw> for 20s, and increases her own ATK by ×2 of the amount lowered for 20s
Cost +3 when defeating an enemy
race.246.name: 盗賊アイテム番
Thieving Item Keeper
race.246.bonus: 敵攻撃時の攻撃力減少値+1%
skill.246.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,2,0]倍上昇、射程[MAG,0,0]倍、攻撃対象数+[0,1,0]
3連続攻撃になり攻撃時自身のHP2％回復

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,2,0], Range ×[MAG,0,0], targets hit +[0,1,0]
Becomes 3 consecutive attacks, restoring 2% of her own HP on attack
skill.246.name: 行くぞ！コウモリの嵐！
Here I Go! Storm of Bats!
unit.246.profile:
マントと下着姿の小さなヴァンパイア。背後にはコウモリを連れており、名前も付けて可愛がっている。立派な商人になることを夢見ており、自分の店の目玉にしようと、ゲシュペンス島で様々な商品を仕入れているようだ。
とっても親しみやすい性格をしているが、胸が小さいことや自分の真名については地雷。触れられたら怒り出して手が付けられなくなってしまうという。

A small vampire dressed in a cape and underwear. She keeps a bat with her, which she's named and dotes on. She dreams of becoming a fine merchant, and seems to be stocking up on all kinds of goods on Gespenst Island to make them the star attractions of her own shop.
She has a very friendly personality, but her small chest and her true name are touchy subjects. If either is brought up, she apparently flies into an uncontrollable rage.
unit.247.title: 牛頭鬼娘
Ox-Head Demon Girl
race.247.text:
最大HP+20％
HPが80%以上の時与ダメージ1.2倍
ブロック中の敵は攻撃力が15%<aw>+4%</aw>減少する

Max HP +20%
Damage dealt ×1.2 when HP is 80% or above
Enemies she is blocking have their ATK reduced by 15%<aw>+4%</aw>
race.247.name: 地獄の闘獄卒
Hell's Fighting Warden
race.247.bonus: ブロックしている敵の攻撃力減少値+4%
skill.247.text:
[duration]秒攻撃速度が減少するが攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍で攻撃範囲拡大
攻撃した敵を低確率で吹き飛ばす

[duration]s: Attack speed decreases, but ATK ×[MAG,0,0] and attack range expands
Small chance to blow away enemies hit
skill.247.name: 全力パワースタンプ
Full-Power Stomp
unit.247.profile: 不思議なミルクでパワーが倍増し、ミノタウロス娘から進化を果たした牛頭鬼娘。夢の中で赤い肌と大きな角の人物と出会い、なんとなく肩こりの相談をしたら変なミルクを渡された。それを飲むとたちまち肩こりは治ったが、目覚めると牛頭鬼娘に変化していたという。囚人を取り締まる獄卒と化した影響か、以前より少し厳しい性格になり、非のある相手を責めることも増えた。しかし牧場のホルスタインの世話は今でも忘れず、ミルクの配達も欠かしてはいない。

An ox-head demon girl who evolved from a minotaur girl after her power doubled thanks to a mysterious milk. In a dream, she met a figure with red skin and large horns, and after casually mentioning her shoulder stiffness, was handed a strange milk. Drinking it instantly cured her stiff shoulders, but when she woke up, she'd turned into an ox-head demon girl. Perhaps influenced by becoming a warden who oversees prisoners, she's grown a bit stricter than before, and now scolds those in the wrong more often. Still, she hasn't forgotten to look after the Holsteins on her ranch, and never skips her milk deliveries.
unit.248.title: 双鳴のアイドル
The Twin-Voiced Idols
race.248.text:
<t=オーバーチャージ(OC)スキル>オーバーチャージスキル</t>を使用可能
範囲内の敵の攻撃と移動速度を15%減少

by -4s<aw>-2s</aw>
race.248.name: 小悪魔系アイドル
Little Devil Idol
race.248.bonus: 味方近接のスキル再使用時間-2秒
skill.248.text:
[duration]秒、範囲内の敵の攻撃と移動速度を[0,0,0]%減少、またスキル発動中の味方の与ダメージを1.3倍
OC：射程2.2倍上昇

[duration]s: Attack and Move speed of enemies in range -[0,0,0]%, and damage dealt by allies during their skill ×1.3
OC: Range ×2.2
skill.248.name: キュートデュオ
Cute Duo
unit.248.profile: アルプ娘とインキュバス娘が、双鳴アイドルデュオとして、まさかのデビュー。前代未聞の両方付いているアイドルとして、男女問わず幅広いファン層を獲得。ステージの上では、２人の息の合ったパフォーマンスで観客を魅了し、ハマらなかった場合は力づくでアイドル沼に突き落とす。そのライブは誰もが夢見心地となり、夢のような楽しい時間だったと全員が感想を口にするという。特技を生かしたライブパフォーマンスをいくつも考案する意欲的な２人ではあるが、そのどれもこれもが公序良俗に反したものばかりのため、実現には至っていないらしい。

An alp girl and an incubus girl have unexpectedly made their debut as the duet idol duo. As the unprecedented idols who have 'both,' they've won over a wide fan base regardless of gender. On stage, the 2 of them captivate audiences with their perfectly synced performance, and if you don't fall for it, they'll force you into idol fandom by sheer will. Everyone who attends their live shows says they felt like they were in a dream, and that it was an absolutely wonderful time. The 2 of them are an ambitious pair who've come up with numerous live performance ideas making use of their special talents, but every single one apparently violates public decency, so none have ever actually been realized.
unit.249.title: エンキ神殿娘
Temple of Enki Girl
race.249.text:
<t=ビッグMトークン>ビッグMトークン</t>を使役
ブロックしている敵１体につき攻撃力と物理防御力が+12%<aw>+5%</aw>
ビッグM配置中、自身の受けるダメージを30%軽減

Commands <t=ビッグMトークン>Big M Token</t>
For every 1 enemies blocked, ATK and DEF +12%<aw>+5%</aw>
While Big M is deployed, damage taken -30%
race.249.name: にょるにょるエンキ神殿
Slithery Temple of Enki
race.249.bonus: 敵ブロック時の攻撃物防上昇量+5％
ATK and DEF increase from blocking enemies +5%
skill.249.text:
スキル発動時、範囲内の敵を触手攻撃で5秒停止させる、[duration]秒攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、遠距離範囲魔法攻撃を行う
さらにビッグM配置中、攻撃対象+1

On skill activation, halts enemies in range with a Tentacle attack for 5s; for [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], performs a ranged area magic attack
Also, while Big M is deployed, targets hit +1
skill.249.name: エンキ神殿へいらっしゃい
Welcome to the Temple of Enki
weapon.249.name: 太古の戦鎚
Ancient War Hammer
weapon.249.text: ビッグＭトークンに隠密効果を付与
Grants stealth to the Big M Token
unit.249.profile: あのエンキ神殿が、なんやかんやあってモンスター娘化した。島で最も古く歴史のある神殿だが、見た目はなぜか幼い少女で、逆に大きな胸が特に目を引く。性格は不遜、そしてセクハラ好きなエロオヤジ。島中の神殿や遺跡の地図は頭に入っていると豪語するが、実際はうろ覚えで大体の場合は迷子になる。エンキ神殿に棲む巨大な触手モンスター、ビッグＭを飼い慣らし、いつか美少年との触手プレイを夢見ているという。

That famous Temple of Enki has, through various circumstances, become a monster girl. It's the oldest and most historic temple on the island, but for some reason she looks like a young girl, with her large chest standing out all the more by contrast. Personality-wise, she's insolent, and behaves like a lecherous old man who loves sexual harassment. She boasts that she has the map of every temple and ruin on the island memorized, but in truth her memory is hazy, and she usually ends up getting lost. She's tamed the giant tentacle monster living in the Temple of Enki, Big M, and apparently dreams of one day enjoying tentacle play with a handsome young man.
unit.250.title: ビヨンデッタ娘
Beyondetta Girl
race.250.text:
配置中、全敵の攻撃力を自身の基本攻撃力の50%<aw>+15%</aw>分減少させる
範囲内の敵は攻撃力減少効果が倍になる

While deployed, lowers all enemies' ATK by 50%<aw>+15%</aw> of her base ATK
The ATK reduction effect doubles for enemies in range

Charm of Pure Love
race.250.bonus: 敵への攻撃力減少効果の参照量+15%
Reference amount for the ATK reduction on enemies +15%
skill.250.text:
[duration]秒、射程[MAG,0,0]倍、足元に魔力の奔流を作り出す
奔流内の敵は攻撃力66％の持続ダメージが発生し
更に魔法防御力が-10減少、移動速度が70%減少する

[duration]s: Range ×[MAG,0,0]; creates a torrent of magic beneath herself
Enemies within the torrent take damage over time equal to 66% of ATK,
and also have MDEF -10 and Move speed -70%
skill.250.name: 本物の愛を見せてあげる
I'll Show You True Love
unit.250.profile: 主食は男の精力ながら、愛する人にはとことん尽くすタイプのビヨンデッタ娘。極度のヤキモチ焼きで、ちょっとしたことでもすぐに拗ねたり嫉妬をしてしまう。とはいえ、イライラがＭＡＸになっても歌を唄いだすだけなので別段実害はない模様。片付けが苦手、お風呂が嫌い、なぜかハエが言うことを聞くなど、前にもどこかで会ったことがあるような気がしないでもない。

A Beyondetta girl whose staple food is male vitality, yet who devotes herself completely to the one she loves. She's an extreme jealous type, quick to sulk or feel envious over the smallest things. That said, even when her frustration maxes out, she just starts singing, so there doesn't seem to be any real harm done. Bad at tidying up, hates baths, and for some reason flies obey her—somehow, it all feels a bit familiar, like you've met someone like her somewhere before.
unit.251.title: 飛縁魔娘
Hienma Girl

攻撃力+30%、飛行して移動する
３回攻撃を行う毎に、攻撃着弾地点の周囲が炎上し持続ダメージを発生させる
持続ダメージは発動時の攻撃力の100%<aw>+20%</aw>
編成時、<t=妖怪>妖怪</t>・火属性のモンスター娘それぞれの攻撃力+8%

ATK +30%; flies to move
Every 3 attacks, the area around the impact point bursts into flame, dealing damage over time
Damage over time is 100%<aw>+20%</aw> of ATK at the time of activation
When in the party, <t=妖怪>Yokai</t> and Fire element monster girls' ATK +8% each
race.251.name: 焦熱地獄
Scorching Inferno
race.251.bonus: 持続ダメージの攻撃力参照量+20％
ATK reference for damage over time +20%

[duration]秒、射程[MAG,0,0]倍、攻撃力[MAG,1,0]倍、攻撃対象数+[0,2,0]
種族特性の炎上が全ての攻撃で生成される

[duration]s: Range ×[MAG,0,0], ATK ×[MAG,1,0], targets hit +[0,2,0]
Race trait Burn is created on every attack
skill.251.name: ヤキいれてやりましょう
Time for a Fiery Beatdown
unit.251.profile:
任侠に生きる妖怪モンスター娘。日頃から堅気(人間)に迷惑をかけてはいけない、と妖怪モンスター娘を諭し、問題が起こった場合でも種族問わず公平な態度で接することができるため、妖怪島の裏社会を取り仕切っているというウワサも。
ただ、激情家の一面もあり、彼女の怒りに触れた者は、たとえ堅気(人間)でも、容赦なくエサとして美味しく頂かれてしまう。その妖艶な笑みと巧みな手練手管に、オスは自ら進んで陥落するのだとか。また『焼く』ことに関しては、誰にも負けない自負があるらしい。

A yokai monster girl who lives by a code of chivalry. She regularly counsels other yokai monster girls not to cause trouble for ordinary folk (humans), and because she treats everyone fairly regardless of species even when problems arise, there are rumors she runs the underworld of Yokai Island.
However, she also has a fiery temper, and anyone who incurs her wrath, even an ordinary human, gets devoured mercilessly as a tasty meal. It's said that men willingly fall for her bewitching smile and skillful wiles. She also apparently takes great pride in her 'grilling' skills, unmatched by anyone.
unit.252.title: エンプーサ娘
Empusa Girl
race.252.text:
ブロック中の敵から受ける物理魔法ダメージを40%<aw>+10%</aw>減少
ただし自身がスタン・石化・凍結状態の時、被ダメージ1.5倍
敵を倒す毎に自身のHPを100%回復する

Physical and magic damage taken from blocked enemies -40%<aw>+10%</aw>
However, damage taken ×1.5 while Stunned, Petrified, or Frozen
Restores 100% of her own HP each time she defeats an enemy
race.252.name: サッシーサディスティック
Sassy Sadistic
skill.252.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍
ブロック中の敵から受ける物理魔法ダメージ減少効果が2倍
攻撃した敵の物理防御力を[0,3,0]減少させる

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0]
Physical and magic damage reduction from blocked enemies ×2
Lowers DEF of the enemy hit by [0,3,0]
skill.252.name: いたぶってあげる
Let Me Torment You
unit.252.profile:
この世の男は全て自分のオモチャだと思っている、女王様気質のエンプーサ娘。変身能力を有していて、普段はかわいい女の子の身体に右脚はしんちゅう製の足、左脚はロバの足という姿をしている。尻尾も特殊な形状をしているが、その用途については不明。常に上から目線で誰にでも生意気な口を利き、相手をからかうことが好きなドＳな性格。ただし異様に打たれ弱く、自分が悪口を言われたら泣いて逃げ出してしまうほど。
意味は不明だが「ワカラセ」という言葉にも弱いという。
「ざ～こざ～こ♪」が口癖。

An empusa girl with a dominatrix mentality who believes every man in the world is her plaything. She has shapeshifting ability, and normally appears as a cute girl's body with a brass leg on the right and a donkey leg on the left. Her tail also has a peculiar shape, though its purpose is Unknown. Always looking down on others, she talks back cheekily to anyone and has a sadistic personality that loves teasing people. However, she's oddly thin-skinned, to the point of crying and running away if anyone insults her.
For reasons unknown, she's also weak to the word 'wakarase' (make you understand).
Her catchphrase is 'Weak, weeeak♪.'
unit.253.title: アプサラス娘
Apsaras Girl
race.253.text:
配置中、1秒ごとに範囲内の味方のHPを
自身の基本攻撃力の2%<aw>+1%</aw>回復
水属性の味方への回復量2倍
<t=水精トークン>水精トークン</t>を使役可能
トークンは１体まで配置人数に含まれない

While deployed, every 1s, restores HP to allies in range
by 2%<aw>+1%</aw> of her base ATK
Healing to Water element allies ×2
Can command <t=水精トークン>Water Spirit Token</t>
Up to 1 Tokens do not count toward the deployment limit
race.253.name: 霊薬の乳海
Elixir Sea of Milk
skill.253.text:
発動時に範囲内の味方HPを[hp,[MAG,0,0]]回復する
水属性には効果２倍(回復量は基本HP依存)
その後[duration]秒射程[MAG,2,0]倍、トークン所持数+1

On activation, restores [hp,[MAG,0,0]] HP to allies in range
Effect ×2 for Water element allies (healing scales with base HP)
Then for [duration]s, Range ×[MAG,2,0], Token capacity +1
skill.253.name: 接待サービス♪
Hospitality Service ♪
unit.253.profile:
全身がローションでできている、ヌルヌルが自慢のアプサラス娘。ゲシュペンス島内でもトップクラスの踊りの技術を活かし、ダンスステージ付きの飲食店を経営している。しかしそれは表向きの姿。常連客だけが知っている合言葉を言えば、裏メニューとして彼女の得意技「ローションヌルヌルマットプレイ」が楽しめる。
自由に分身を生み出すことができ、お店の従業員は全て自身の分身。やろうと思えば最高で６億体もの分身が作れるため、どんなに店が忙しくても人手には困らないようだ。

An apsaras girl whose entire body is made of lotion, proud of her slippery smoothness. She makes use of her top-class dancing skills on Gespenst Island to run a restaurant with a dance stage. However, that's just her public face. Say the password known only to regulars, and you can enjoy her specialty off-menu offering, the 'Slippery Lotion Mat Play.'
She can freely create clones of herself, and every single employee at her shop is one of her own clones. If she really put her mind to it, she could create up to 6 hundred million clones, so no matter how busy the shop gets, she never has trouble with staffing.
unit.254.title: パズズ娘
Pazuzu Girl
race.254.text:
飛行して移動する
配置時、自身のスキル待機時間を8秒<aw>+2秒</aw>短縮
常に攻撃後の待ち時間を短縮

Flies to move
On deployment, shortens her own skill cooldown by 8s<aw>+2s</aw>
Always shortens attack cooldown
race.254.name: クイックチャージ
Quick Charge
race.254.bonus: スキル待機時間短縮+2秒
skill.254.text:
1度だけ攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍で範囲内の全敵を攻撃し、後退させる
20秒間、範囲内自身を除く味方の攻撃後の待ち時間を短縮

1 time(s) only, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]; attacks all enemies in range and knocks them back
For 20s, shortens attack cooldown for allies in range other than herself
skill.254.name: レッツダンス！
Let's Dance!
unit.254.profile: 獣神パズズがモンスター娘化した姿。ダンスが大好きでいつも踊っている。しかし、踊るとモンスター娘さえも病気にさせる熱風が発生するので、誰も見てくれないらしい。基本的には温厚で明るい性格だが、怒ると何処からともなくバッタを召喚してぶつけるという、ちょっと怖い一面も持っているようだ。踊っている途中に流砂に巻き込まれ、埋まってしまったという過去があり、砂地が大嫌い。

The Beast God Pazuzu, transformed into a monster girl. She loves dancing and is always at it. However, her dancing generates a hot wind so intense it can make even other monster girls sick, so apparently no one will watch her. She's generally gentle and cheerful, but has a slightly scary side too—when angered, she summons locusts from out of nowhere and hurls them at people. She was once caught in quicksand and buried alive while dancing, and has hated sandy ground ever since.

Lilith Girl

飛行して移動する
配置中、全敵の魔法防御力を自身の
基本攻撃力の50%<aw>+15%</aw>分減少させる
範囲内の敵は魔法防御減少効果が倍になる
攻撃時、自身のHPを最大値の3%回復、10秒間自身の攻撃力を5％増加
男性に対して、またはスキル中種族特性全ての効果が倍になる

Flies to move

by 50%<aw>+15%</aw> of her base ATK
The MDEF reduction effect doubles for enemies in range
On attack, restores her own HP by 3% of Max HP, and increases her own ATK by 5% for 10s
All race trait effects double against males, or during her skill

Wave of the Lustful Demon
race.255.bonus: 敵への魔法防御力減少効果の参照量+15％
Reference amount for the MDEF reduction on enemies +15%

その後、全ての敵の受ける魔法ダメージを1.5倍にし、射程内の敵全てを攻撃

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]

Then, magic damage taken by all enemies ×1.5, and attacks all enemies in range
skill.255.name: リリステンプテーション
Lilith Temptation
unit.255.profile: 淫力を高める石の効果により、夜の女王へと進化したリリス娘。「お姉さんとして艶が大切」と、ペントが開発したＧストーンを部屋に置いて生活していたことで、この姿となったらしい。以前とは嗜好も変わったらしく、甘えさせるよりも嫌がる相手をお仕置きするというＳなプレイが好きになったようだ。バストサイズもアップしたらしいが、真相は定かではない。

A Lilith girl who evolved into the Queen of the Night thanks to the effects of a stone that heightens lustful power. She apparently took this form after living with a G Stone developed by Pent placed in her room, believing that 'allure matters for an onee-san.' Her tastes seem to have changed too—rather than pampering someone, she now prefers dominant play, punishing those who resist. Her bust size has apparently gone up as well, though the truth of that remains unconfirmed.
unit.256.title: ハンプティダンプティ娘
Humpty Dumpty Girl
race.256.text:
クリティカル率、クリティカル率上限+20％
攻撃時、30％<aw>+10％</aw>の確率で攻撃対象数+2
移動中はスキルが解除されず、攻撃速度+30%

Crit rate and Crit rate cap +20%

Skill is not cancelled while moving, and Attack speed +30%

An Unstable Existence
race.256.bonus: 10%の確率で範囲内の攻撃対象数+2
10% chance for targets hit in range +2
skill.256.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
範囲内の敵3体に範囲攻撃

[duration]s: ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Performs an area attack on 3 enemies in range
skill.256.name: 不思議な卵
Mysterious Egg
awaken.90059.name: CRI率/CRI率上限+20%
Crit rate/Crit rate cap +20%
unit.256.profile: 頭に被った大きな卵の殻が目を惹くハンプティダンプティ娘。特徴的なのはその被り物だけではなく言動も個性的で、独特すぎる表現や単語の選び方が一部ではナンセンスとも言われている。言葉の意味について議論することが大好きだが、他人の顔は全部同じに見えるため、相手を覚えられないらしい。お気に入りの場所は塀の上で、その理由は地上より落ち着くからなのだとか。しかし塀から落下した場合は自力では立ち上がることができず、最悪の場合再起不能になるという。体型をとても気にしていて、彼女に対して「ずんぐりむっくり」は禁句。

A Humpty Dumpty girl whose most eye-catching feature is the large eggshell she wears on her head. It's not just her headwear that stands out—her words and actions are just as distinctive, with some calling her overly unique expressions and word choices pure nonsense. She loves debating the meaning of words, but apparently can't remember people because everyone's face looks the same to her. Her favorite spot is atop a wall, supposedly because it's more calming than being on the ground. However, if she falls off a wall, she can't get back up on her own, and in the worst case, she may never recover. She's extremely self-conscious about her body shape, so calling her 'squat and dumpy' is strictly forbidden.
unit.257.title: ベヒモス娘
Behemoth Girl
race.257.text:
出撃コスト+3、最大HP+30%<aw>+10%</aw>、
攻撃力+20%
4回攻撃を行うごとにブロック中の敵全てを盾で強打しスタンを蓄積（大）

Deploy cost +3, Max HP +30%<aw>+10%</aw>,
ATK +20%
Every 4 attacks, bashes all blocked enemies with its shield, building up Stun (large)
race.257.name: 護獣の激昂
Guardian Beast's Fury
skill.257.text:
スキル発動時に1度だけ攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍で
周囲の敵全てを攻撃しスタンさせる
（蓄積値：超特大）

On skill activation, attacks all enemies in range at ATK ×[MAG,0,0], 1 time(s) only, applying Stun
(build-up: Extra Large)
skill.257.name: ガイアブラスト
Gaia Blast
unit.257.profile: なんやかんやあって獣神ベヒモスがモンスター娘化。体躯はスケールダウンしたものの、何事も力任せで大雑把なところは健在で、細かいことは気にしない性格。大飯食らいな菜食主義者で、満足に食料が確保できないときは性欲を満たすことで食欲も満たそうとする。全ての獣に慕われていて、森をちょっと散歩するだけで動物たちが集まってくるほど。動物たちの言葉も分かるようだが、その翻訳能力には審議を要する。

Through various circumstances, the beast god Behemoth became a monster girl. Though her body has scaled down, she's still all brute force and big, careless gestures, never sweating the small stuff. A vegetarian with a massive appetite, when she can't get enough food, she tries to satisfy her hunger by satisfying her lust instead. Every beast adores her — just a short walk through the forest is enough to draw animals flocking to her side. She seems to understand what animals say, though her translations are questionable at best.
unit.258.title: ゴルゴーン娘
Gorgon Girl
race.258.text:
飛行して移動する
配置時に邪眼で敵全体を超毒と石化状態にする
配置中、全敵の毒/石化の耐性が減少し、
毒はダメージ値が、石化は効果時間が増加
攻撃時、まれに相手を超毒/石化状態にする、スキル発動時は確率が倍化
毒か石化状態のいずれかの敵への与ダメージが1.45倍<aw>+0.25倍</aw>

Flies to move
When deployed, its evil eye inflicts Super Poison and Petrify on all enemies
While deployed, reduces all enemies' Poison/Petrify resistance,
increasing Poison damage and Petrify duration
On attack, rarely inflicts Super Poison/Petrify on the target; the chance doubles on skill activation
Damage dealt to enemies with either Poison or Petrify ×1.45<aw>+0.25</aw>
race.258.name: 禁呪の邪眼
Forbidden Evil Eye
race.258.bonus: 毒か石化状態の敵への与ダメージ+0.25倍
Damage dealt to Poisoned or Petrified enemies +0.25×
skill.258.text:
発動時、範囲内の敵を超毒/石化状態にする
その後[duration]秒、射程[MAG,1,0]倍で3連攻撃
毒/石化状態の敵への攻撃が防御力を無視

On activation, inflicts Super Poison/Petrify on enemies in range
For the next [duration]s, Range ×[MAG,1,0], attacks 3 times in succession
Attacks on Poisoned/Petrified enemies ignore DEF
skill.258.name: ゴルゴーンサクセサー
Gorgon Successor
unit.258.profile: 蛇の女王メデューサ娘からゴルゴーン娘へと進化した姿。それは２人の姉の助力によって成し遂げられ、念願の若返りも果たされた。そのため年齢に関する自虐はなくなり、より積極的で前向きな性格へと変化したが、独特の口調やときどき飛び出す古臭い死語は相変わらずな様子。得意の石化能力にはいっそう磨きがかかり、幼くはなったが戦闘能力は向上している。昔から美しかったことも証明でき、本人はこの姿におおむね満足しているが、自慢のバストが年相応に小さくなってしまったことだけは不満なようだ。

The form Medusa Girl, queen of serpents, took after evolving into Gorgon Girl. It was achieved with the help of her 2 older sisters, granting her long-desired wish to become younger. As a result, she no longer makes self-deprecating jokes about her age, and has grown more proactive and positive — though her distinctive way of speaking and the occasional outdated slang she drops are unchanged. Her signature petrification power has only sharpened further, and despite looking younger, her combat ability has improved. She's also proven that she was beautiful all along, and seems mostly satisfied with her new form — except for the fact that her prized bust has shrunk to match her age.
unit.259.title: ブラスドラゴン娘
Brass Dragon Girl
race.259.text:
常に攻撃力が70％<aw>+10％</aw>に減少する
通常攻撃が6連続攻撃になる
攻撃した敵の物理防御力を[attack,[MAG,2,0]]低下させる
(減少量は基本攻撃力に依存)
ブロック中の敵から受ける
物理魔法ダメージを35%減少

ATK is always reduced to 70%<aw>+10%</aw>
Normal attacks become 6 consecutive attacks
Lowers the DEF of attacked enemies by [attack,[MAG,2,0]]
(the reduction amount depends on base ATK)
Reduces physical and magic damage taken
from blocked enemies by 35%
race.259.name: ブラススケイル
Brass Scale
skill.259.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、
範囲内の敵1体に遠距離攻撃
着弾地点の周囲に持続ダメージが発生する(持続ダメージは発動時の攻撃力の100%)

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0],
ranged attack against 1 enemies in range
Creates lingering damage around the impact point (lingering damage is 100% of ATK at activation)
skill.259.name: 破天歯砕撃
Sky-Shattering Fang Strike
unit.259.profile: 銅から真鍮へ。カッパードラゴン娘から進化を果たしたブラスドラゴン娘。胸の大きさはそのままに、強さと美しさがパワーアップ。回転ノコギリのような武器で立ちはだかる敵をなぎ倒す。しかし本人の弁によると、１番変化したのは外見より中身の方で、意味は分からないが「もう後方彼女面とは誰にも呼ばせない！」らしい。これまでよりは前に前にと出てくる性格に変わったが、それはそれで面倒くさいとみんなに思われているとか、いないとか。

From copper to brass. Brass Dragon Girl, evolved from Copper Dragon Girl. Her bust size stays the same, but her strength and beauty have both leveled up. She mows down any enemy standing in her way with a rotary-saw-like weapon. According to her, though, what changed the most wasn't her looks but what's inside — though it's unclear what she means by, "I won't let anyone call me the sidelined girlfriend type anymore!" She's become much more forward and assertive than before, which everyone apparently finds a bit exhausting... or so they say.

unit.260.profile: 周囲のモンスター娘たちにおいてかれないように修行しまくった結果、進化したワキヤン・タンカ娘。雷に何度も何度も打たれまくって、突如自分は終わりも始まりもなく、生きとし生けるものすべてに宿っている『宇宙の真理』だということを理解した。そのため自分はどこにでも宿っていると思いこんでおり、宿っていないものには胸にピアスを付けて電気を流すという痛すぎる儀式を行うという。

Wakinyan Tanka Girl, who evolved after training relentlessly so as not to be left behind by the monster girls around her. After being struck by lightning over and over, she suddenly came to understand that she is the 'cosmic truth' — without beginning or end, dwelling within every living thing. Because of this, she's convinced she resides within everything, and performs an excruciating ritual of piercing the chest and running electricity through it on anything she decides doesn't.

Atlach-Nacha Girl

Domain of Entangling Thread

Rending Thread Pincer
unit.261.profile: アラクネ娘がクモの神へと進化した姿。誰も姫扱いしてくれないことに悩んだ末、「だったら、もっと威厳を付ければいいんですわ！」と思ったことで、本当に神へと覚醒したらしい。威厳を保つために洞窟の奥に巨大なクモの巣を制作中で、時間を忘れるほど作業に没頭しており、邪魔されると烈火の如く怒り襲ってくる。従者のクモたちは「偉大なる織り手」と呼ばれているが、その巣作りは手伝っていない模様。神へと進化したことで知性も多少上がったため、以前のように簡単には甘い言葉に惑わされないようになっている。

The form Arachne Girl took after evolving into a spider god. After agonizing over the fact that no one treated her like a princess, she thought, 'Then I'll just have to make myself more dignified!' — and apparently that's what truly awakened her divinity. To maintain her dignity, she's deep in a cave building a massive spider web, so absorbed in the work that she loses track of time, and flies into a rage if disturbed. Her attendant spiders are called 'the great weavers,' though they don't seem to actually help with the web-building. Having evolved into a god also raised her intelligence somewhat, so she's no longer as easily swayed by sweet words as she once was.
unit.262.title: シェイプシフター娘
Shapeshifter Girl
race.262.text:
出撃コスト+10、最大HP+100%<aw>+30%</aw>、ブロック数+2
非スキル中は宝箱に擬態し、攻撃が近接攻撃化、さらに物理魔法ダメージ50%減少し、敵の攻撃を引き付ける

Jack-in-the-Box
unit.262.profile: 変身能力と食欲を極限まで高めた結果、進化を遂げたシェイプシフター娘。肉体だけでなく、服ですら何にでも変化させられる変幻自在の力を持つ。その能力を活かし、戦いではナイフやモンスターを、日常では美少年のパンツなどを生み出して周囲を翻弄している。変身能力で自分の体を縮めることで、少ない量でお腹いっぱいになろうと目論んでいるらしい。

Shapeshifter Girl, who evolved by pushing her transformation ability and appetite to their absolute limits. She wields a versatile power that lets her change not just her body but even her clothes into anything at all. She puts this ability to use in battle by conjuring knives or monsters, and in daily life by conjuring things like handsome boys' underwear, toying with everyone around her. She's apparently scheming to shrink her own body with her transformation power so that a small amount of food will fill her stomach.
unit.263.title: 魔女生カーバンクル娘
Witch Student Carbuncle Girl

unit.263.profile: モンスター娘学園に通うごく普通の学生……というのは仮の姿。その正体はえちちパワーで世界を救う魔法少女のカーバンクル娘。愛用の魔法の杖を手にし、日々悪い何かと戦っている。魔法少女であることは誰にも知られてはいけないが、その秘密がバレたらどうなるかは誰も知らない。本人も知らない。魔法少女につきものの、かわいいマスコットキャラクターがいるのかいないのか、それも今のところは不明である。

An ordinary student attending Monster Girl Academy... or so her cover story goes. Her true identity is Carbuncle Girl, a magical girl who saves the world with the power of naughtiness. Wielding her beloved magic wand, she fights against some manner of evil every day. No one is supposed to know she's a magical girl, but what would happen if that secret got out is anyone's guess — even she doesn't know. As for whether she has the cute mascot character that comes standard with being a magical girl, that too remains unknown for now.

unit.264.profile: 妖怪学園軽音部に所属している猫又娘。最初はギター担当だったがいくら練習してもなぜか騒音しか出さないため、軽音部のセッションは三味線担当に変更された。しかしロックライブでパフォーマンスを見て、ギターは叩けばいい音がでると思い込み、セッションの最後はギターを思いっきり叩こうと企んでいるとか。おそらく……いや、確実に壊れるがそんなことは些細なことのようだ。

Nekomata Girl belongs to the Yokai Academy's light music club. She started out on guitar, but no matter how much she practiced, she somehow only ever produced noise, so her role in the club's sessions was switched to shamisen. However, after watching a live rock performance, she became convinced that smashing a guitar produces great sound, and is apparently now scheming to smash one with all her might at the end of every session. It will probably — no, definitely — break, but that seems like a minor detail to her.

unit.265.profile: 科学部の部長を務めるリッチ娘。なんかそれっぽく見える、という理由で白衣を着用。ショタがお姉さんに与える影響を科学的に解明すべく、日々、謎の実験や研究を続けているが、今はまだあまり結果は出てない模様。ほとんど授業に出てこないため、先生たちからしばしば注意を受けているが、毎回論破して帰してしまう。ただ、他の学生たちからの信頼は厚く、彼女に怪しげな薬の作成を依頼する者が後を絶たないのだとか。

Lich Girl serves as the head of the science club. She wears a lab coat simply because it looks the part. In pursuit of scientifically explaining the effect that shota boys have on older women, she continues her mysterious experiments and research day after day, though it seems she hasn't gotten much in the way of results yet. Since she rarely shows up to class, the teachers often scold her, but she debates them into submission and sends them packing every time. Even so, she's deeply trusted by the other students, and there's apparently no shortage of people asking her to whip up some questionable medicine.

skill.266.name: バーンと一発！
One Big Bang!
unit.266.profile: 妖怪学園の水泳部でエースをしている川熊娘。推薦で入学したため、勉強についてはからっきしである。その代わり、水泳に関しては向かうところ敵なし。そんなに泳ぎが得意なのにビート板を携帯している理由は、水に沈めた際に銃みたいに勢いよく飛び出て興奮するから、らしい。ちなみに正しい使い方は知らないようだ。

River Bear Girl is the ace of the swim team at Yokai Academy. Having gotten in on a special recommendation, she's hopeless when it comes to studying. In the water, though, she's unmatched. As for why she carries a kickboard around despite being such a strong swimmer, it's apparently because pushing it underwater and letting it shoot back up like a gunshot gets her excited. She doesn't seem to know its proper use, incidentally.

Meteor Buster
unit.267.profile: 仲間うちでは１番背が小さく妹扱いをされているリトルグレイ娘のリーダー。普段はとてもしっかりしており、仲間たちの身の回りの世話をしている。しかし、かわいいものには目がなく、すぐに宇宙船へ誘拐しようとする危険な一面も。また敵対しているリトルグリーンマンとゴブリンのことはとにかく嫌っており、どうにかして殲滅してやろうと企んでいるらしい。

The leader of the Little Grey Girls, treated like the little sister of the group for being the 1 shortest among them. Ordinarily very level-headed, she looks after her comrades' daily needs. However, she has a weakness for cute things, and has a dangerous side that makes her quick to try to abduct them onto her spaceship. She also thoroughly despises the rival Little Green Men and Goblins, and is apparently scheming to wipe them out somehow.

Little Grey Girl

Mystic Stealth
unit.268.profile: 銃を常に携えている灰色肌のリトルグレイ娘。宇宙を股にかける研究員のひとりで、モンスター娘たちとも順調に友好関係を築いている。異種族との交流には非常に前向きであり、もともと戦争をしているリトルグリーン娘とも友好関係を結ぶ道はないかと思案するほど。興味の惹かれたものへの執着はすさまじく、ロックオンと言って狙いを定めたら、宇宙船で解析を行うまで諦めない。ちなみに指先に感覚神経があるため、触れ合わせて挨拶をすることもあるらしい。

A grey-skinned Little Grey Girl who always carries a gun. One of the researchers who travels across the cosmos, she has been steadily building friendly relations with the monster girls. She's extremely open to interacting with other races, to the point of considering whether there's some way to build friendly ties even with the Little Green Girls, with whom her kind is originally at war. Her fixation on anything that catches her interest is intense — once she 'locks on' to a target, she won't give up until she's analyzed it aboard her spaceship. Incidentally, since she has sensory nerves in her fingertips, she apparently sometimes greets others by touching them together.

unit.269.profile: 顔をヘルメットで覆い、丸みを帯びた宇宙服を着用しているリトルグリーンマンのリーダー。敵対しているリトルグレイはもちろん、他の種族のことも劣等種として見下しており、邪魔をするものには容赦しない。しかし、仲間とみなしたものには甘い一面があるようだ。額の触角はあらゆる感覚を感知でき、相手の嘘を見抜くこともできる優れもの。ちなみに宇宙服で着ぶくれしているが、実は脱いだらすごいらしい。

The leader of the Little Green Men, her face covered by a helmet and clad in a rounded spacesuit. She looks down on the rival Little Greys, of course, as well as every other race, considering them inferior species, and shows no mercy to anyone who gets in her way. Yet she seems to have a soft spot for anyone she considers a comrade. The antenna on her forehead can sense all manner of things, and is even good enough to see through an opponent's lies. Incidentally, her spacesuit makes her look padded out, but apparently she's quite something once she takes it off.

unit.270.profile: ゲシュペンス島に訪れたリトルグリーンマンの狙撃手で、偵察を得意としている。リトルグレイとの争いにあまり関心がないが、若い世代では稀にある価値観のようだ。しかし争いそのものに関心はなくとも、リーダーのプリプリダに良いところを見せようと、厳しい訓練に励み、超一流のスナイパーとなった。ゴブリンと友好関係にあるリトルグリーンマンだが、気の小さい彼女は苦手で近付けないようだ。

A Little Green Man sniper who came to Gespenst Island, skilled at reconnaissance. She has little interest in the conflict with the Little Greys, a viewpoint that's apparently rare but not unheard of among the younger generation. Even so, though she cares little about the conflict itself, she trained hard to impress her leader Priprida, and became a top-tier sniper. The Little Green Men are on friendly terms with the Goblins, but being timid, she seems unable to get close to them.

unit.271.profile: 暑い時期に備え、水着に着替えたフロストサラマンダー娘。海ならではの遊びをたくさん試してみたが、ビーチバレーを教わってからはそれがお気に入りとなったようだ。暑さ対策に氷のボールを作り出し、必殺サーブを打ち込むという新しい戦法を編み出したらしい。

Frost Salamander Girl, changed into a swimsuit to prepare for the hot season. She's tried out plenty of activities unique to the beach, and after being taught beach volleyball, it seems to have become her favorite. As a countermeasure against the heat, she apparently came up with a new tactic of conjuring an ice ball and spiking it in with a finishing serve.

unit.272.profile: 夏の陽射しもなんのそのと、海に繰り出したポルターガイスト娘。日傘を手放さないのは雰囲気作りのアイテムなだけで、ゴースト娘じゃないので太陽に弱くない、とあくまで本人は言い張っている。素手でのスイカ割りに挑戦すべく格闘術を身に付けたものの、戦闘ではパンチと一緒になぜかスイカも飛んで行く。水着からはみ出たスイカップな胸が眩しいが、それとこれとは韻でもダジャレでもなく、ただの偶然なのである。

Undeterred by the summer sun, Poltergeist Girl heads out to the beach. She insists that the parasol she never lets go of is purely for atmosphere, and that she's not weak to sunlight since, unlike Ghost Girl, she isn't a ghost. She trained in martial arts to try her hand at watermelon-splitting bare-handed, but in battle, watermelons somehow go flying along with her punches. Her voluptuous, melon-sized bust spilling out of her swimsuit is dazzling, but she insists that's neither a rhyme nor a pun with the watermelons — just pure coincidence.

Fatal Snipe
unit.273.profile: ベルティオの師匠にあたるドヴェルグ娘のリーダー。数多のモンスター娘たちの願望に応える伝説の玩具職人であり、クルクリの玩具は数十年、数百年待ちの人気商品になっている。ゲシュペンス島に伝わる「古の玩具」を発掘しては自分なりにカスタマイズするのが趣味。まれにベルティオが造ったエロトラップダンジョンを見つけたら、弟子の作品を眺めつつ一杯やるのが楽しみらしい。ちなみに手にしている武器は、遺跡に潜っている際に偶然発掘したもので、自分なりにカスタマイズして使っているようだ。

The leader of the Dvergr Girls and master to Veltio. A legendary toymaker who answers the wishes of countless monster girls, her toys are so popular that customers wait decades, even centuries, for one. Her hobby is excavating the 'ancient toys' passed down on Gespenst Island and customizing them to her own taste. On the rare occasion she stumbles across one of the erotic trap dungeons built by her apprentice Veltio, she apparently enjoys having a drink while admiring her student's handiwork. Incidentally, the weapon she carries was something she happened to dig up while exploring ruins, which she's customized to her own liking.

unit.274.profile: ギザ歯で常にニヤニヤ顔のチェシャキャット娘。神出鬼没でかつ、子供のように無邪気で悪戯好き。なんにでも首を突っ込むタイプかと思いきや気分屋で、興味ないものには一切関心を示さない。姿を消せる能力を持っているが、なぜか顔だけは消えないようだ。暖かい屋根や火が消えた後のかまど、木の上が大好きでよくその場所で昼寝をしている。

Cheshire Cat Girl, always grinning with her jagged teeth. She's elusive, and as innocent and mischievous as a child. You'd think she'd stick her nose into everything, but she's actually quite moody, and shows zero interest in things she doesn't care about. She has the ability to vanish, though for some reason her face alone never disappears. She loves warm rooftops, hearths after the fire's gone out, and treetops, and often naps in those spots.

skill.275.name: リリースフォース
Release Force
unit.275.profile: 大きすぎる胸がひときわ目を引くジャヒー娘。その膨らみは溢れる母性の証であり、全てを優しく包んでくれる。ママみのライバルとしてミテラスに対抗意識を燃やす一方で、裏の顔は自分本位で他人サゲの激しい、いわゆる性悪女だという噂もある。そんな彼女の悩みは、見た物の良いところが３分の１奪われてしまう能力で本人にその気があろうとなかろうと、出された料理を３分の１だけ腐らせたり、女性のバストサイズを小さくしてしまうことだという。また１か月周期で魔力がお腹に溜まるため、こっそりと発散しなくてはならないそうだ。

Jahy Girl's oversized bust is especially eye-catching. Its fullness is proof of overflowing maternal warmth, gently embracing everything around her. While she burns with rivalry against Miterasu as a rival 'mom-type,' rumor has it her true self is self-centered and viciously puts others down — a so-called wicked woman. Her worry is a power that strips away 1/3 of the good qualities of whatever she looks at, whether she means to or not — causing served food to spoil by 1/3, or shrinking women's bust sizes. Also, since mana builds up in her belly on a 1-month cycle, she apparently has to secretly release it.

skill.276.name: フェアリーセイント
Fairy Saint
unit.276.profile: 妖精たちを統べる妖精王。「王の中の王」と慕われているほど評判も上々のオベロン娘。王として生まれたからなのか、他の妖精たちより身体が大きく、普通の人間並み。王としての誇りは高く、世話好きなところがある反面、根はやはり妖精なので、いたずらや賑やかな催しも大好きな、子どもっぽい無邪気さもある。ティターニア娘とは創世記の少年を巡って争い、今でも両者のケンカは絶えないようだが、本人曰く、ティターニア娘へのいたずらは彼女の気を惹くためであり、本音としてはもっと仲良くしたいようである。

The Fairy King who rules over all fairies. Oberon Girl's reputation is so stellar that she's adored as 'the king among kings.' Perhaps because she was born a king, her body is larger than other fairies', about the size of an ordinary human. Her pride as king runs deep, and she has a caring side, but at heart she's still a fairy, so she also has a childlike innocence and a love of pranks and lively festivities. She and Titania Girl have long fought over a boy from Genesis, and the two of them apparently still bicker constantly to this day — but according to her, the pranks she plays on Titania Girl are just to get her attention, and deep down she'd really rather they got along better.

unit.277.profile: ミュルミドーン娘たちの母であり、コロニーの女王。娘たち全員から慕われ、部屋から物音ひとつでもあれば女王の元へかけつけたりと、やや過剰に保護されている。そのため、本人はおっとりのんびりした性格だが、種族の繁栄とコロニー拡大のために力を尽くしている。女王しか持たない特別なフェロモンを持っており、それを嗅がされた雄はどんな命令にも従ってしまうらしい。

The mother of all the Myrmidon Girls, and queen of the colony. Adored by every one of her daughters, she's protected almost excessively — the moment there's so much as a noise from her room, they come rushing to her side. As a result, she herself has a calm and easygoing personality, but she devotes all her strength to her race's prosperity and the colony's expansion. She possesses a special pheromone unique to queens, and any male exposed to its scent will apparently obey any order given to him.
