Sharp Poison Claw
unit.278.profile: 硬直した死体であるのに、呪術により動き回るモンスター娘。目の悪さを嗅覚で補っており、特に呼気や血の匂いに敏感。元々は命令に忠実な召使いとして生み出されたが、道士とはぐれてからはその反動で、イタズラ好きの性格になってしまっている。縛る物のなくなった彼女は、自分の欲望に忠実に生きている（？）ようだ。

A monster girl who is technically a stiff corpse, animated by sorcery. She makes up for her poor eyesight with a sharp sense of smell, and is especially sensitive to the smell of breath and blood. Originally created as an obedient servant who followed every command, she became mischievous as a reaction to getting separated from her Taoist master. With nothing left to restrain her, she now seems to live faithfully by her own desires (?).

unit.279.profile: 炎のような赤いウェディングドレスに身を包んだイフリート娘。その理由は結婚式を目論んでのことだが、結婚や式自体がどういうものかはあまり理解していない模様。結婚式で定番の「ケーキ入刀」の噂を聞き、武器も特注の巨大ナイフに持ち替えている。現在は誓いの儀式に必要だといわれる神様を探して、島内を走り回っているようだ。

Ifrit Girl, dressed in a flame-red wedding dress. Her reason is that she's plotting a wedding, though she doesn't seem to fully understand what marriage or the ceremony itself actually involves. Having heard rumors about the classic 'cutting the cake' custom at weddings, she's swapped her weapon for a custom-made giant knife. She now seems to be running around the island searching for the god said to be necessary for the vow ceremony.

unit.280.profile: リコの研究により物体に干渉しやすくなり、着替えもできるようになったレイス娘。おしゃれを楽しむ中、面白半分でウェディングドレスを着用中。結婚からキューピットを連想し、武器も弓矢に持ち替えている。まだ練習中だと本人は言っているが、高い精度で矢を放つことができ、十分に使いこなしている模様。「結婚は人生の墓場」という格言を気にし、本人的には結婚願望は高くないそうだが、結婚するなら身体の相性がいい相手を望んでいるらしい。

Wraith Girl, who — thanks to Riko's research — can now interact with objects more easily and even change clothes. While enjoying fashion, she's currently wearing a wedding dress half as a joke. Associating marriage with Cupid, she's also swapped her weapon for a bow and arrow. She claims she's still practicing, but she can already fire arrows with high precision and seems to have mastered it well enough. Bothered by the saying that 'marriage is the graveyard of life,' she claims her own desire to marry isn't very strong — but if she were to marry, it seems she'd want a partner who's physically compatible.

unit.281.profile: 色めきだつ空気を読んでウェディングドレスを身にまとい、花嫁になろうとしたジン娘。もろもろの誤解に気づいた後も、ドレスが気に入ったので着替えなかった。しかし、ドレスに本は合わないため、チャペルで拾ったウェディング・ベルを新たな武器として使用し、戦う花嫁として戦場を舞っている。結婚式の勉強もしているようだが、彼女の行う式の練習には何か下心も潜んでいるようだ。

Reading the romantic mood in the air, Djinn Girl donned a wedding dress and tried to become a bride. Even after realizing the whole thing was a misunderstanding, she liked the dress so much that she never changed out of it. However, since a book doesn't suit the dress, she picked up a wedding bell from a chapel to use as her new weapon, and now dances across the battlefield as a fighting bride. She seems to be studying up on wedding ceremonies too, though her ceremony practice appears to be hiding some ulterior motive.
unit.282.title: 憧嫁のペガサス娘

skill.282.name: ブレスウインド

unit.282.profile: ひとりでひっそりと楽しむつもりで純白のウェディングドレスの試着していたペガサス娘。ひとりで浮かれていたところを見られた後も「せっかくだから！」と言い訳しながら身に着けている。ドレスや結婚に憧れがあり、やってみたい理想の結婚式もあるらしい。なかでも新郎は絶対に白いタキシードというこだわりがあり、理想を叶えるためなら夜なべでタキシードを手作りするほど。

Pegasus Girl was quietly trying on a pure white wedding dress, meaning to enjoy it all by herself. Even after getting caught prancing around alone, she keeps wearing it, excusing herself with 'well, since I'm already at it!' She longs for wedding dresses and marriage, and apparently has an ideal wedding ceremony she'd love to hold. Among her must-haves, she's especially particular that the groom wear a white tuxedo — so particular, in fact, that she'll stay up all night hand-sewing one herself to make that dream come true.

unit.283.profile: 頭に特殊な輪っかを付けた石猿娘。その名の通り、お猿さんのような特徴的な耳や尻尾を持っている。伸縮自在の不思議な棒を武器として持つが、普段は拳で敵を殴り倒していく。そんな体術以外にも、変化の術や分身の術など妖術も得意。紅孩児娘とはライバル関係であることを認めつつも、互いに切磋琢磨している相手だという認識は、あまりもってないようだ。石遊びの延長で気持ちいい遊びを覚えてしまい、以来、ムラムラしたときは、その遊びでこっそりと解消しているのだとか。

Stone Monkey Girl wears a peculiar ring on her head. True to her name, she has distinctive monkey-like ears and a tail. She carries a mysterious, freely extending and shrinking staff as her weapon, but usually just punches enemies down with her fists. Besides that martial skill, she's also skilled in mystic arts like transformation and shadow-clone techniques. Though she acknowledges Red Boy Girl as her rival, she doesn't seem to think of her much as someone to push each other to improve with. Through an extension of playing with stones, she picked up a certain pleasurable pastime, and ever since, whenever she gets worked up, she apparently relieves it secretly through that same play.

unit.284.profile: 名の知れた大妖怪を親に持つ紅孩児娘。幼い頃から火山地帯で厳しい修行を受けていたため、長い槍と炎を自在に扱うことができる。さらに「三昧真火」と呼ばれる、消えない炎を操ることができるようだ。子ども扱いすると怒るので、火のように取り扱いは注意が必要。ライバル関係の石猿娘とは浅からぬ縁があるようだが、その詳細は不明である。

Red Boy Girl, daughter of a renowned great yokai. Having undergone strict training in volcanic regions since childhood, she can freely wield both a long spear and fire. She also seems able to control an unquenchable flame known as 'Samadhi True Fire.' Treat her like a child and she'll get angry, so handling her requires the same caution as handling fire. She and her rival Stone Monkey Girl appear to share more than a passing connection, though the details remain unknown.

unit.285.profile: 死んだ妊婦が化けた姿とされるモンスター娘。羽毛のついた羽織を着ると鳥の姿に変身することができる。「ショタお世話係」を自称するほどショタを愛しており、不幸なショタを見つけると、服に血判をつけて誘拐してしまうほどの深い母性を持つ。さらわれたショタは、上げ膳据え膳のお世話を受け、彼女なしでは生きていけないほど幸せな生活を得てしまうらしい。

A monster girl said to be the transformed spirit of a woman who died while pregnant. She can transform into a bird by wearing a feathered coat. She loves shota boys so much that she calls herself their 'dedicated caretaker,' and has such deep maternal instincts that when she finds an unfortunate shota, she'll mark his clothes with a blood seal and simply abduct him. The abducted boy apparently receives such thorough, hand-and-foot care that he ends up living so happily he can't imagine life without her.

unit.286.profile: 軽やかな身のこなしと軽妙な話術が得意なモンスター娘。大陸ではその特技を生かし、曲芸師として気ままな巡業生活を送っていた。曲芸の十八番は、炎で体が燃えることがないという火鼠娘の特性を生かした火の輪くぐり。フットワークと同じく調子も軽く、トラブルの気配を察知するとさっさと逃げ出してしまう。

A monster girl skilled at light, nimble movement and witty conversation. On the continent, she made use of that talent to lead a carefree life touring as an acrobat. Her signature trick makes full use of Fire Rat Girl's trait of never burning — jumping through a ring of fire. Just like her light footwork, she has a light temperament to match, and the moment she senses trouble brewing, she wastes no time running off.

Frost Giant Girl came to the beach in a cool, white swimsuit. Being weak to heat, she brings along ice and her favorite milk in a cooler box. The cooler box is just as huge as she is, so apparently even a human could easily fit inside. Since it's chilled to the bone, though, anyone who accidentally climbs in is said to end up frozen solid in no time.

Zombie Girl, wearing a swimsuit and watching for a chance to cause mischief at the beach. She's tried all sorts of things to stir up a happy accident, but being a zombie, she just floats on the water and keeps failing. In reality, though, she's brought along plenty of gear for relaxing on the shore, so maybe she's just itching to enjoy the sea like everyone else.

unit.289.profile: 嫉妬心と執着心の塊であるヤンデレモンスター娘。想い人のすべてを把握していないと気が済まない性質で、監視するために２４時間つけ回す。自分のことだけを見ていてくれる間は心優しく穏やかであるが、少しでもよそ見をした瞬間、豹変。愛する人を亡き者にしようとするようだ。過去にも想い人に逃げられては、焼き殺すというのを繰り返していたらしい。「鐘コレクター道」を嗜んでおり、若き名匠「清太郎」の作品を好んで集めている。

A yandere monster girl who is a walking mass of jealousy and obsession. She can't rest easy unless she knows everything about her beloved, and will trail him for 24 hours straight just to keep watch. As long as he's only looking at her, she's kind and gentle, but the instant he so much as glances elsewhere, she flips completely — apparently even trying to do away with the one she loves. In the past, whenever her beloved fled from her, she's said to have repeatedly burned him to death. She also enjoys 'the way of the bell collector,' and is fond of collecting the works of the young master craftsman 'Seitaro.'

unit.290.profile: 秘密結社・冥界のエージェントとして、妖怪島という未知の領域に潜入すべく、幽霊へ昇格したゴースト娘。島を越えてのエージェントごっこは健在で、秘密の井戸をつたって妖怪島支部とゲシュペンス島を行き来しているらしい。組織の会員証としてお皿を自作したものの、ドジで割ってしまったり、１枚足りずに泣いたりしているが、ウソ泣きっぽいので周りからは相手にされていない。

Ghost Girl, promoted to a full Ghost in order to infiltrate the unknown territory of Yokai Island as an agent of the secret society, the Underworld. Her cross-island 'secret agent' game is still going strong, and she apparently travels between the Yokai Island branch and Gespenst Island via a secret well. Though she made herself membership plates for the organization, she's forever clumsily breaking them, or crying over being 1 plate(s) short — but since her tears seem fake, no one around her takes her seriously.

unit.291.profile: おねショタ警察の妹分であり、おねショタ道を極めている途中のモンスター娘。獣神ファロルーチェとあまりにも似ているので、本人ではないかと疑われているが、遠い親戚の友人の妹であり本人とは一切関係ないらしい。おねショタ道だけではなく「小さい同士の組み合わせが最も尊い」と周囲に推してまわっている。

A monster girl who serves as the little sister of the Onee-Shota Police, still on her way to mastering the way of the onee-shota. She looks so much like the beast god Farolucce that people suspect she might actually be her, but apparently she's just the little sister of a friend of a distant relative and has no connection to her whatsoever. Beyond just the way of the onee-shota, she also goes around telling everyone that 'a pairing of two small ones together is the most precious of all.'

unit.292.profile: おとなしく控えめな草食系モンスター娘。小さく愛らしい見た目とは裏腹に、身体の倍以上の氷塊を一撃で砕くほどのパワータイプ。戦いを好まない温和な性格だが、一度怒らせると周囲の地形が変わるほど暴れる。しかし、鼻の頭を撫でると落ち着かせることができるようだ。泥浴びや身体を擦りつけ、相手に自分の匂いをつけることで愛情表現するらしい。

A quiet, reserved, herbivorous monster girl. Despite her small, adorable looks, she's a raw powerhouse capable of shattering a block of ice more than twice her size in a single blow. She has a gentle disposition and dislikes fighting, but once she's truly angered, she rampages hard enough to reshape the surrounding terrain. Even so, stroking the tip of her nose seems able to calm her down. She apparently expresses affection by rolling in mud and rubbing her body against her partner to mark them with her scent.

unit.293.profile: 一途に情念の炎を燃やすモンスター娘。愛する相手の幸せのため、お金や食べ物を贈り、かいがいしく世話を焼いて尽くす。逆にそれ以外はどうでもいいので、贈るための品は盗んで調達するし、邪魔だと感じた者は躊躇なく血の海に沈めようとする。執念も蛇のように深く、彼女から逃げるのは難しいだろう。結婚式を挙げるのが夢だが、儀式に使うお酒が苦手で匂いだけで気絶してしまうのが悩みらしい。

A monster girl who burns with a single-minded flame of passion. For the sake of her beloved's happiness, she showers him with money and food, devotedly caring for and serving him. On the other hand, she doesn't care about anything else at all — she'll steal the gifts she gives, and won't hesitate to drown anyone who gets in her way in a sea of blood. Her obsession runs as deep as a snake's, and escaping her would be difficult. Her dream is to hold a wedding, but her trouble is that she can't stand the sake used in the ceremony — even its smell alone is enough to knock her out.

unit.294.profile:
ミュルミドーンクィーン娘から産まれたモンスター娘。
兵士たちを束ねるリーダーを務め、女王様に絶対の忠誠を誓い、女王様の為に働いている。命令とあれば、死に至るような危険な任務も平気で遂行するが、それは血を分けた姉妹たちが住処であるコロニーにたくさん棲んでいるから。女王に種を提供した後は食べられてしまう定めのため、他種族のオスを見下している。いつもクールな姿勢を崩さないが、妹たちの小さい頃を思い出すためか、子どもには優しいようだ。

A monster girl born from Myrmidon Queen Girl.
She serves as the leader who commands the soldiers, sworn to absolute loyalty to her queen and working entirely for her sake. Given an order, she'll calmly carry out even the deadliest of missions, since so many of her blood sisters live together in the colony they call home. Because males of her own kind are fated to be eaten after providing their seed to the queen, she looks down on males of other races. She always keeps her cool composure, but seems to be gentle with children — perhaps because they remind her of her little sisters when they were small.

unit.295.profile: かつての大戦争の発端と噂されている悪魔モンスター娘。そのあまりの凶暴極悪さから、ビビ神の手によって万年牢獄に封じられていた。しかし噂とは全く違い、実際は気の弱い豆腐メンタルで、単なる引きこもりのモンスター娘だった。アンティモーの姉だが、封じられていたので長い間交流がなく、ほとんど他人みたいな距離感になっており、密かに悲しんでいる。愛用の弓はハマっているオンラインゲームに登場する武器のレプリカらしい。

A demon monster girl rumored to have been the spark that ignited an ancient great war. Due to her sheer, extreme brutality, she was sealed away in an eternal prison by the god Bibi. But contrary to the rumors, she was actually timid with a heart as fragile as tofu — just a plain old shut-in monster girl. She's Antimo's older sister, but having been sealed away for so long, they've had no contact for ages and now feel almost like strangers to one another, which secretly saddens her. The bow she treasures is apparently a replica of a weapon from an online game she's obsessed with.

unit.296.profile: 大きな団扇を装備したカリスマ性のあるモンスター娘。策を練り、天候を操り、さらには武術の達人でもあるため、配下たちにも尊敬されている。そんな彼女だが過去に権力と力の象徴として政治に利用されてきたことから、人間たちを嫌悪しているようだ。ゆえに邪悪な人間達から同族を守ろうと日々修行を重ねているらしい。とてもストイックなので、弟子になれば四六時中、稽古を強要されてしまうという。

A charismatic monster girl equipped with a large war fan. She plots strategies, controls the weather, and is even a master of martial arts, earning the respect of her subordinates. Despite this, she seems to hold humans in disdain, having been used in the past as a political symbol of power and authority. As a result, she reportedly trains day after day to protect her own kind from wicked humans. She's extremely disciplined, so anyone who becomes her disciple is said to be forced into training around the clock.

Wings That Cleave the Heavens

unit.297.profile: 異世界からやってきた堕天使。千年戦争の折、民を守るために自らを犠牲に結界を張り、その反動で、物質界の外側へ落ちてしまったのだという。そのため、物質界と魔界の狭間で、時が止まったまま生き続けていたらしい。『堕ちし星の天使』『欲望の黒翼』など、恐ろしい二つ名を持つが、それは後世で感謝されたくないために、照れ隠しで自らつけたもの。ゲシュペンス島滞在中は、おねショタ警察の元で「世界を制する何か」を学んでいるらしい。

A fallen angel who came from another world. During the Thousand Year War, she sacrificed herself to cast a barrier to protect her people, and the backlash sent her falling outside the material realm, or so it's said. As a result, she apparently continued living with time stopped, suspended between the material world and the demon realm. She bears fearsome epithets like 'Angel of the Fallen Star' and 'Black Wings of Desire,' but she gave herself those names out of embarrassment, so as not to be thanked by later generations. During her stay on Gespenst Island, she's apparently learning 'something to conquer the world' under the guidance of the Onee-Shota Police.

unit.298.profile: 大きな身体と大きな手を持ち、常に浮遊する球体に乗っているフラットウッズ・モンスター娘。母星は高度な科学力を持ち、高度な工業化とエネルギー消費を伴う社会が形成されていた。しかしそのせいで環境汚染が深刻な問題となり、汚染された雨が降る星となっている。そのため、ゲシュペンス島の美しい自然に感動し、涙したことがあるらしい。母星では人と目を合わせて会話することがなかったため、極度の緊張から「シューッ」と息を吐かなければ話せないようだ。

Flatwoods Monster Girl has a large body and large hands, and always rides atop a floating orb. Her home planet possessed advanced scientific technology, forming a society built around high industrialization and heavy energy consumption. As a result, however, environmental pollution became a serious problem, and it's now a world where polluted rain falls. Because of this, she's reportedly been moved to tears by the beautiful nature of Gespenst Island. Since she never made eye contact while conversing on her home planet, she apparently can't speak without letting out a nervous 'ssss' hiss from extreme tension.

unit.299.profile: 愛らしい少女の姿をしているが、長い年月を生きるモンスター娘。呪いの人形「アンドーさん」によって力を得て、創世記の少年をさらったり、黄金を略奪したりと、ごう慢の限りを尽くしていた。とある勇者に討たれてからは、自信を喪失して引きこもりになってしまった。今は元々の物静かな性格に戻っているが、黄金に目ざとい一面は変わっていないらしい。

A monster girl who appears as an adorable young girl, but has lived for countless years. Empowered by a cursed doll named 'Ando-san,' she once ran wild with arrogance, kidnapping boys from Genesis and plundering gold. After being struck down by a certain hero, she lost her confidence and became a shut-in. She's now returned to her originally quiet personality, but her sharp eye for gold apparently hasn't changed a bit.

I've Got to Hurry!
unit.300.profile: 長いウサ耳と時計、ラッパを持っているモンスター娘。「遅刻する、遅刻しちゃう～！」と時計を見ながら、いつも焦っている様子を見せている。だが、これは忙しいアピールのようで、実際に急いでいることはほぼなく、急用時には遅れてくる遅刻魔である。また長いモノには巻かれろという性格で強いものにはへりくだる臆病な部分も。そのため怒られそうになると、普段とは別人のようなスピードで逃げ出すようだ。

A monster girl with long rabbit ears, carrying a clock and a trumpet. She's always shown looking flustered, glancing at her clock and crying, 'I'm late, I'm going to be late~!' However, this seems to be mostly for show — she's rarely actually in a hurry, and is in fact a habitually tardy type who shows up late whenever there's actually somewhere urgent to be. She also has the mindset of bending to whoever's strongest, revealing a cowardly streak of submitting to anyone powerful. As a result, whenever she's about to get scolded, she flees at a speed that makes her seem like a completely different person.

unit.301.profile: 獣神ニーズホッグがモンスター娘になった姿。幼く可愛らしい姿をしているが、実際は強欲なサディストでショタを虐めることを生きがいにしている。それというのもショタの怒り顔に萌えるかららしい。ちなみに１番萌えるのは本気のガチギレ顔とのこと。しかし、思ったようなガチギレ顔はなかなか見られないため、携帯している自分の分身である「蛇ちゃん」を抱きしめて駄々をこねることがある。またワエマワなどの大型の羽をもつモンスター娘とは相性が非常に悪く、毛嫌いしている。

The form the beast god Nidhogg took as a monster girl. She looks young and adorable, but is actually a greedy sadist who lives to torment shota boys — apparently because she gets a thrill from their angry faces. Incidentally, what excites her the 1 most is a genuinely furious face. However, since she rarely gets to see the truly furious expression she's hoping for, she sometimes hugs her carried companion, a little snake plush named 'Snake-chan,' and throws a tantrum instead. She's also extremely incompatible with, and thoroughly detests, monster girls with large wings, like Waemawa.

unit.302.profile: 鋭く大きな剣を装備しているウサギ耳のモンスター娘。可愛らしい容姿からは想像できないが、大変攻撃的な性格をしており、攻撃を仕掛けてきたと認識すると、躊躇なく首を斬り落とす。そのため周囲からは「首切りウサギ」と呼ばれ恐れられているようだ。だが、彼女が首を必要に狙うのは、重度のうなじフェチだかららしい。ちなみに昔は今よりもさらに狂暴だったため、こしょうの手りゅう弾でお仕置きされたことがある。しばらくくしゃみが止まらなかったトラウマから、手りゅう弾をみたら思わず逃げ出してしまうという。

A rabbit-eared monster girl armed with a large, sharp sword. You wouldn't guess it from her cute looks, but she has an extremely aggressive personality, and the moment she perceives that she's been attacked, she cuts off the offender's head without hesitation. Because of this, she's apparently feared by those around her as the 'Decapitating Rabbit.' The reason she specifically targets necks, however, is said to be her severe fetish for the nape of the neck. Incidentally, she was even more ferocious in the past, so she was once punished with a pepper grenade. Ever since, traumatized by the fit of sneezing that wouldn't stop, she can't help but flee the moment she sees a grenade.

unit.303.profile: 火山で乗り捨てられたデカイオーから誕生したモンスター娘。搭乗者であったブレイデン騎士団長の魂を模倣しているため、真面目で頑固な騎士であり、出世欲が強い野心家でもある。しかし生まれたばかりなので、そもそもなぜ出世したいのかは理解していない。また、同じデカイオー娘のリッティとは姉妹のようなものらしいが、より優れている自分が姉だと言って譲らない。だが、性格は真逆のため衝突も多く、頻繁に姉妹ケンカが勃発しているようだ。

A monster girl born from a Giant King left abandoned in a volcano. Because she imitates the soul of its former pilot, Knight Commander Braiden, she's a serious and stubborn knight, as well as an ambitious go-getter with a strong desire to rise in rank. However, since she was only just born, she doesn't actually understand why she even wants to climb the ranks in the first place. She's also said to be something like sisters with fellow Giant King Girl, Litty, but insists she's the older sister since she's the superior one and won't budge on the matter. Since their personalities are polar opposites, though, they clash often, and sisterly spats reportedly break out frequently between them.

unit.304.profile: ハロウィンということで、セクシーなドレスで仮装したドラゴンゾンビ娘。ドレスに合わせて武器もギターに持ち替えている。ギターの音色は指先からじわじわと腐り、肌が冷たくなっていくというゾンビのような旋律らしい。イケおじと出会うための秘策として特別な漬物を研究しているようだ。

It's Halloween, so Dragon Zombie Girl dressed up in a sexy dress for the occasion. To match the dress, she's also swapped her weapon for a guitar. The tone of her guitar is said to carry a zombie-like melody — one where your fingertips slowly rot away and your skin turns cold. As a secret strategy for meeting a handsome older man, she also seems to be researching a special type of pickle.

unit.305.profile: 主食は生き血で、今までに多種多様なエイリアンの血を吸ってきたチュパカブラ娘。はるか昔に宇宙船が故障してゲシュペンス島に不時着し、その後はゲシュペンス島の奥地に隠れ住んできた。人間の血はマズいからと襲わず、獣の血を好んで吸って生き永らえてきたらしい。人見知りだが、エイリアンハンターらしい残忍さもあり、狙った獲物は必ず仕留める執念も持ち合わせている。

Chupacabra Girl's staple food is fresh blood, and she's fed on the blood of a wide variety of aliens over the years. Long ago, her spaceship malfunctioned and crash-landed on Gespenst Island, and she's lived hidden away in its depths ever since. She apparently avoids attacking humans since their blood tastes bad, and has survived by preferring to drink the blood of beasts instead. She's shy around people, but also has the ruthlessness fitting of an alien hunter, along with the tenacity to always bring down whatever prey she sets her sights on.

Gravity of the White Star
unit.306.profile: 月からやって来た者たちのひとりと言われる、謎多きモンスター娘。月の言語と呼ばれる聞き慣れない言葉を使って、夜空に問いかける姿を目撃されている。思考が読めない不思議系だが、真面目で尽くしたがりの献身的な一面もあり。だがその献身も行き過ぎることがあったりなかったり。

A mysterious monster girl said to be one of the ones who came from the moon. She's been spotted addressing the night sky in an unfamiliar tongue known as 'moon language.' She's an enigmatic type whose thoughts are hard to read, but she also has a serious, devoted side that likes to be of service. That devotion, however, occasionally — or perhaps not so occasionally — goes a bit too far.

unit.307.profile: 牛の尾、馬の足、狼の頭部を持ち、額に１本角を生やしたモンスター娘。全ての生き物の頂点に立つほどの実力を持っているが、非情に優しく穏やかな性格で、争いと殺生をとても嫌っている。素晴らしきショタ王の前にのみ降り立つ幻のモンスター娘であり、長い歴史の中では創世記の少年の前にしか降り立ったことがないらしい。

A monster girl with the tail of an ox, the legs of a horse, and the head of a wolf, with 1 horn(s) growing from her forehead. She possesses strength enough to stand at the very top of all living creatures, yet has an extremely gentle and calm disposition, deeply hating conflict and killing. She's a legendary monster girl who only ever appears before a truly magnificent shota king, and throughout the long course of history, is said to have only ever appeared before the boy from Genesis.

unit.308.profile: 赤い翼が特徴のモンスター娘。方角を司る四神娘のひとりであり、主に南方を守護している。ヒーローに憧れており、他の四神娘達とチームを組んで、人間もモンスター娘も平和に過ごせる世界を作るべく日夜奮闘中。その平和に対する熱すぎる思いから、体が発熱して周囲を燃やしてしまうこともある。最近は目の前で披露するだけで戦意を失ってしまうようなポーズを考えているらしい。

A monster girl characterized by her red wings. She is one of the Four Guardian Girls who preside over the cardinal directions, primarily protecting the south. She admires heroes, and together with the other Guardian Girls, strives day and night to build a world where both humans and monster girls can live in peace. Her passion for peace burns so intensely that her body sometimes heats up and sets everything around her on fire. Lately, she's apparently been devising a pose so powerful that simply performing it in front of an enemy would sap their will to fight.

unit.309.profile: 橋の守護神であるモンスター娘。基本的には大人しく楚々とした性格だが、嫉妬深いところもあり、自分の守護する橋以外を褒めた者を見た時には、我を忘れて藁人形に五寸釘を打ちつけて呪ってしまうらしい。『らぶあんどかーす』という呪いのスペシャリスト集団に所属しており、丑の刻参りという呪いを生み出したことを誇りに思っているようだ。

A monster girl who serves as the guardian deity of a bridge. She's basically quiet and demure by nature, but also has a jealous streak, and when she sees someone praising a bridge other than the one she guards, she apparently loses herself and curses them by driving a five-inch nail into a straw doll. She belongs to a group of curse specialists called 'Love & Curse,' and seems proud of having created the ushi no koku mairi curse ritual.

unit.310.profile: 聖なる夜限定のステッキを振り、幻想的な音と光で死者を導くワイト娘。「秘密結社・冥界」の司教として、この時期は迷えるアンデッドたちの大掃除を任されている。その美声によって死霊たちを導くようだが、うっかり歌声を聞いてしまうと生者は身動きがとれなくなるので注意が必要。墓場で行われる組織のクリスマスパーティーもなんだかんだ言って参加し、アメリにもらったホネ人形もなんだかんだ言って大切にしている。

Wight Girl waves a wand exclusive to this holy night, guiding the dead with fantastical sound and light. As a bishop of the secret society 'the Underworld,' she's tasked this season with the great cleanup of lost undead. She guides the spirits of the dead with her beautiful voice, but the living need to be careful — accidentally hearing her singing leaves them unable to move. Despite her grumbling, she attends the organization's Christmas party held in the graveyard every year, and despite her grumbling, she also treasures the bone doll Ameri once gave her.

Radiant Lich Girl

skill.311.name: 不死者の威光
Majesty of the Undead
unit.311.profile: 自身の研究を極めるあまり、クリスマス衣装を新調してしまったリッチ娘。だが華やかな装いに変わっても、彼女の『ショタマター』への探求心が変わることはない。寧ろ、増大していると言えるだろう。研究中心の生活を送るリコ故に、クリスマスへの解釈もまた特殊。この聖夜を自身の計画を遂行する記念すべき夜としか見ていない。

Lich Girl, so devoted to perfecting her research that she went and bought herself a new Christmas outfit. But even with her more festive attire, her pursuit of 'Shota Matter' hasn't wavered in the slightest — if anything, it's only grown stronger. Since Riko lives a life centered entirely around research, her interpretation of Christmas is likewise unusual: to her, this holy night is nothing more than a landmark occasion for carrying out her own plans.
unit.312.title: 聖飾のローパー娘
Sacred Ornament Roper Girl
race.312.text:
配置時・スキル発動時に範囲内の敵を5秒間触手状態にする
攻撃時に敵の移動速度20秒間10％<aw>+3%</aw>減少

Slippery Tentaclus
race.312.bonus: 攻撃時の移動速度減少+3％

skill.312.name: ぬるっとアイス！
Slippery Ice!
unit.312.profile: クリスマスツリーのように触手をたくさんのオーナメントで飾り付けしたローパー娘。”クリぼっち”を『ひとりでクリスマスを堪能できる最強の言葉』だと思っており、自分は最強のクリぼっちだと豪語している。そんな最強のクリぼっちの彼女は、サンタとしても役目を果たす気満々。クリスマスプレゼントはケーキをそのまま靴下に詰め込もうと計画している。ちなみに靴下がなかったらパンツでも代用可能という自分ルールがあるらしい。

Roper Girl decorated her tentacles with plenty of ornaments, just like a Christmas tree. She considers being 'alone on Christmas' the ultimate phrase for someone who can fully enjoy the holiday by themselves, and boasts that she's the strongest at spending Christmas alone. Being the strongest at that, she's also fully prepared to take on the role of Santa. As for Christmas presents, she's planning to stuff an entire cake straight into a stocking. Incidentally, she apparently has a personal rule that underwear can substitute if there's no stocking on hand.
unit.313.title: 白虎娘
Byakko Girl
race.313.text:
レンタルを含めず光属性が8体以上編成されている時全モンスター娘のHPと攻撃力+7％<aw>+2%</aw>上昇

Platinum Brave Tiger

skill.313.name: 断つ猛進
Fierce Charge That Cuts Down
unit.313.profile: 大陸西方イチの誇り高きクールな特攻隊長系モンスター娘。その実力は広くに名をとどろかせている……らしい。率直なマイペース派でとっつきにくいが、実際はただのツンデレ。フワフワ自慢の耳と尻尾を優しく撫でられると、本能的にニャンゴロしてしまうとか。

The proud, cool special-attack squad leader-type monster girl, said to be the best in the western continent. Her skill is renowned far and wide... or so it's said. She's a blunt, at-her-own-pace type who's hard to approach, but in truth she's simply a tsundere. Apparently, if you gently stroke her prized fluffy ears and tail, she'll instinctively melt into a purring roll.
unit.314.title: 金角大王娘
Golden Horn King Girl
race.314.text:
被弾時、攻撃力が5％上昇（最大20回/撤退死亡時リセット）

<aw>Reduces the ATK of blocked enemies by 20%</aw>
race.314.name: 黄金の武将
Golden Warlord

Reduces the ATK of blocked enemies by 20%
skill.314.text:

skill.314.name: 金硬爆
Golden Hardshell Blast
awaken.90075.name: スタン無効
Immune to Stun
unit.314.profile: 強力な５つの法具を持っていると言われている、豪快で尊大なモンスター娘。古今東西の宝物を集めるのが趣味で、コレクションは洞窟を埋め尽くす程。宝物を巡り何度も戦いを繰り広げたとの逸話も。また、一度同胞と認識した者には非常に親身で、時には仲間の身の上話で号泣する涙もろい一面も。噂によると、妹を溺愛しているとか。

A bold and haughty monster girl said to possess 5 powerful magic treasures. Her hobby is collecting treasures from every era and every land, and her collection is said to fill an entire cave. There are also tales of her fighting countless battles over such treasures. That said, once she recognizes someone as a comrade, she's remarkably devoted to them, and even has a tearful side, sometimes bursting into sobs over a companion's life story. Rumor has it she also dotes excessively on her little sister.
unit.315.title: レヴィアタン娘
Leviathan Girl
race.315.text:
編成時、全モンスター娘の攻撃力+6%<aw>+3%</aw>
攻撃時に相手の物理防御力を20秒3%減少、減少値の2倍自身の物理防御力を20秒増加

When in the party, all monster girls' ATK +6%<aw>+3%</aw>
On attack, reduces the target's DEF by 3% for 20s, and increases own DEF for 20s by ×2 of the amount reduced
race.315.name: オールフォーミー
All for Me
race.315.bonus: 全モンスター娘の攻撃力+3%

遠距離範囲魔法攻撃を行い攻撃した敵の移動速度を一定時間減少

Performs a ranged area magic attack that reduces the Move speed of attacked enemies for a set duration
skill.315.name: 深海からの誘い
Invitation from the Deep Sea
unit.315.profile: 大海の荒波を制する強い力を持つ悪魔モンスター娘。物静かな容姿をしているが、本性は嫉妬深く自分勝手であり、周りからチヤホヤされて過ごして来たので、誰に対しても上から目線で接する癖がある。そのためゲシュペンス島では浮いた存在だが、細かいことを気にしないベヒモス娘のデインとはウマが合うようだ。気に入らないことがあるとすぐに拗ねてしまう性格で、たまに「病みモード」に入ってしまうことも。しかし、親身に優しくされることに慣れていないので、機嫌を直すのは意外と簡単なようだ。

A demon monster girl with the might to command the raging waves of the open sea. She looks quiet and composed, but her true nature is jealous and selfish; having spent her life being fawned over by everyone around her, she has a habit of looking down on everyone she talks to. Because of this, she's something of an outsider on Gespenst Island, though she seems to get along well with Behemoth Girl Dain, who doesn't sweat the small stuff. She's the type to sulk the moment something displeases her, and occasionally slips into a 'gloomy mode.' However, since she's not used to being treated with genuine kindness, it's apparently surprisingly easy to win her back over.
unit.316.title: ガン・ケン娘
Gan-Ken Girl

Dance of the Undying

skill.316.name: サイレントナイト
Silent Knight
awaken.90073.name: 凍結無効
Immune to Freeze
unit.316.profile: 寝技の究極奥義『ショタカケルオネエサンノ顔ニ』を修得した結果、進化を遂げたガン・ケン娘。長く険しい修行の旅で古今東西の寝技とギャグを身につけ、美味しいグルメに詳しくなった模様。愛馬のコショタ・パワーは首から上が無くとも「パワー！」と元気にいななき、凄まじいスピードで夜空を駆けるらしい。

Gan-Ken Girl, who evolved after mastering the ultimate grappling technique, 'Shota Riding on Onee-san's Face.' Through a long and grueling journey of training, she picked up grappling holds and gags from every era and every land, and apparently also became quite the gourmet along the way. Her beloved steed, Koshota Power, still whinnies energetically with a hearty 'Power!' even without a head, and is said to gallop across the night sky at tremendous speed.
unit.317.title: 初縁の白面金毛九尾の狐娘
New Bond White-Faced Gold-Furred Nine-Tailed Fox Girl
race.317.text:

Crimson Greatsword

火傷発生の確率が上昇
火傷状態の相手への与えるダメージ1.2倍

Burn chance increases
Damage dealt to Burning targets ×1.2
skill.317.name: 御来光の焔刃
Flame Blade of the Sacred Sunrise
unit.317.profile: 新たな年に心機一転。「新しいわっちを見ておくんなんし」と大太刀へと持ち替えた。大量のお年玉を準備しており、新年に初めて出会うモンスター娘に配りまくっているらしい。決してワイロなどではないと言い張るが、受け取らなかった者は刀を持つ何者かに襲われて行方知れずになり、お年玉をもらった者は全て彼女の味方になっている。羽根つきが好きらしく「お遊びに付き合っておくんなんし」と色々な相手に対戦を申し込んでいるようだ。

A fresh start for the new year. Saying, 'Do take a look at the new me,' she swapped her weapon for a greatsword. She's prepared a huge stash of New Year's money, and is apparently handing it out en masse to every monster girl she meets for the first time in the new year. She insists it's absolutely not a bribe, but anyone who refuses to accept it ends up attacked by some sword-wielding figure and goes missing, while everyone who does accept the money ends up on her side. She also seems to love hanetsuki, and is apparently challenging all sorts of opponents with, 'Do join me for a game.'
unit.318.title: 暗陰巫バイコーン娘
Shadow Priestess Bicorn Girl

編成時闇属性モンスター娘の攻撃力+7％<aw>+3%</aw>、出撃コスト-1

Priestess of Dark Obscurity

skill.318.name: 巫女の健康祈願
Priestess's Prayer for Good Health
unit.318.profile: 天にも昇るような奉仕をするため、巫女になったバイコーン娘。「ちょっとエッチな巫女」をイメージして服をカスタマイズした結果、セクシーさが限界突破した姿になった。おはらい棒を振られると逆に邪気にまみれてしまいそうな気がするが、それは思い過ごしである。

Bicorn Girl became a shrine maiden in order to offer service so devoted it could send you to heaven. After customizing her outfit with the image of 'a slightly naughty shrine maiden' in mind, she ended up with a look whose sexiness broke every limit. You might feel like being waved with her purification wand would leave you covered in even more impurity instead — but that's just your imagination.
unit.319.title: 散詣のダークエルフ娘
Scattering Pilgrimage Dark Elf Girl

skill.319.name: 画龍点睛
The Finishing Touch
unit.319.profile: 『反逆の羽子板～ダークネスミラージュ～』を片手に、晴れやかな姿で新しい年に潜む闇を打ち砕くダークエルフ娘。『深淵の境地』とやらにたどり着いたらしく、闇を打ち砕く深淵の力を手に入れた。闇をはらい清めるひと振り『ダークネスフラッシュ』は、厳しい修行を乗り越えた者だけに与えられる特殊奥義らしい。自称天才の名を欲しいままにし、装いも決意も新たに、まずはファイトイッパツ。契約者との新たな絆を深めることを目標にしているとか。

With 'Battledore of Rebellion ~ Darkness Mirage ~' in hand, Dark Elf Girl shatters the darkness lurking in the new year with a radiant look. She's apparently reached what's called 'the Realm of the Abyss,' gaining the abyssal power to break the darkness. Her single purifying swing, 'Darkness Flash,' is said to be a special ultimate technique granted only to those who have overcome grueling training. Claiming the title of self-proclaimed genius all for herself, with fresh attire and fresh resolve, her first order of business is one good fight. Deepening a new bond with her Contractor is said to be her ultimate goal.
unit.320.title: 颯明巫フェアリー娘
Bright Gale Priestess Fairy Girl
race.320.text:
配置人数に含まれず、飛行して移動する
物理と魔法攻撃を30%<aw>+10%</aw>の確率で回避
風属性マス配置時に敵の遠距離攻撃の対象にならない

Does not count toward the deployment limit, and flies to move

While deployed on a Wind element tile, cannot be targeted by enemy ranged attacks
race.320.name: 小さな正月
Little New Year
skill.320.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
範囲内の味方の石化と暗闇状態を無効化

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Nullifies Petrify and Darkness on allies in range
skill.320.name: 新たな門出と初日の出
A New Beginning and the First Sunrise
unit.320.profile: 自作の祝詞を捧げるために巫女になったフェアリー娘。子孫繁栄の願いを込め、「はらたま、きよたま、きんきんたまたま～」と独自の祝詞を唱えている。神社の清掃や祭事の補助に懸命に励んでいるが、その可愛らしさゆえに、時折お守りとして持ち帰られてしまうこともあるらしい。

Fairy Girl became a shrine maiden in order to offer up prayers of her own making. Wishing for prosperous descendants, she chants her own original prayer, 'Haratama, kiyotama, kinkin tamatama~.' She works hard cleaning the shrine and assisting with festivals, but due to her sheer cuteness, she apparently sometimes ends up taken home as a good-luck charm herself.
unit.321.title: フロストドレイク娘
Frost Drake Girl
race.321.text:

Blizzard Enhance

skill.321.name: 冷氷螺旋刃
Frozen Spiral Blade
awaken.90074.name: 30％で貫通攻撃
30% chance for a piercing attack
unit.321.profile: イグニの限界トレーニングを受けた結果、種族を超越したフロストドレイク娘。クールな性格は相変わらずかと思いきや、内なる熱い感情を素直に表現することが増えているようだ。武器を手裏剣に持ち替えたのは、近距離でも遠距離でも対応できるというクールな判断によるもの。進化した後も変わらずイグニのブレーキ役を務めている。

Frost Drake Girl, who transcended her own species after undergoing Igni's grueling training. You'd think her cool personality would stay the same, but she seems to have started expressing her burning inner feelings more honestly. She switched her weapon to shuriken as a cool, calculated decision, since they work at both close and long range. Even after evolving, she still serves the same role as Igni's brake.
unit.322.title: アスモデウス娘
Asmodeus Girl
race.322.text:
編成時、<t=悪魔>悪魔</t>の攻撃力+12%<aw>+3%</aw>、自身の最大HP-20%

skill.322.name: プチプチフレア
Pop Pop Flare
unit.322.profile: 大きな羊の角と小さな牛の角、毒蛇の尻尾とガチョウの足を持つアスモデウス娘。『色欲の悪魔』としてその名をとどろかせており、色気と手管で数多のオスを落としてきた実績を持つ逆ナンのプロ。創世記の少年を陥落させるためにゲシュペンス島にやってきたが、結果は惨敗。逆に落とされてしまい、創世記の少年に近づいたオンナを次々葬り去ったことから、万年牢獄に封じられた。そのため、ダムストーとは牢獄シェア仲間でもある。独占欲の強さについてはスライム娘のリンと気が合い、皇女姉妹の話題になると、リンと一緒に「むっきー！」と怒りをあらわにすることもある。

Asmodeus Girl has large ram horns, small bull horns, a venomous snake's tail, and goose feet. Renowned as the 'Demon of Lust,' she's a professional seductress with a proven track record of felling countless men with her allure and skillful moves. She came to Gespenst Island to seduce the boy from Genesis, but ended up utterly defeated — falling for him herself instead — and was sealed away in an eternal prison after ruthlessly disposing of every woman who got close to him. Because of this, she's also a prison-sharing companion with Damstoh. When it comes to sheer possessiveness, she gets along well with Slime Girl Rin, and whenever the topic of the princess sisters comes up, the two of them sometimes bare their fangs together with an angry 'grrr!'
unit.323.title: 甘護のマタンゴ娘
Sweet Guardian Matango Girl

Sweet Sweet Chocolate
unit.323.profile: バレンタインは女の戦いだと聞かされて、チョコで作った剣と盾を持って気合を入れているマタンゴ娘。彼女なりに最高のチョコを作ろうと試行錯誤している。その中でつくったキノコのチョコがけは、ゲシュペンス島ではタケノコチョコと人気を二分するほどの出来だという。ただ、チョコの形状が人気なだけであり、味の方はイマイチらしい。

Having been told that Valentine's Day is a battle among women, Matango Girl is psyching herself up with a sword and shield made of chocolate. She's trying her hand at trial and error to make the best chocolate she can. Among her creations, her chocolate-coated mushrooms are said to be popular enough on Gespenst Island to rival the famous bamboo-shoot chocolates. That said, it's apparently only the shape of the chocolate that's popular — the taste itself still leaves something to be desired.

unit.324.profile: チョコレートなる活性化物質(？)に魅了され、研究を始めたホムンクルス娘。チョコレートを食べると得られる効果についての研究に没頭し、いつしかゲシュペンス島のモンスター娘御用達のチョコレートショップのオーナー兼バレンタインの恋のキューピッドとなっていた。この状態に本人は「研究資金が増える」とご満悦らしい。

Homunculus Girl, captivated by the activating substance(?) known as chocolate, began researching it. Absorbed in studying the effects gained from eating chocolate, she eventually became the owner of a chocolate shop beloved by the monster girls of Gespenst Island, as well as a Cupid for Valentine's Day romance. She's apparently quite pleased with this arrangement, since it means 'more research funding.'

skill.325.name: ハンマーミキサー
Hammer Mixer
unit.325.profile: 最強最大のチョコレートを求める、バレンタインの装いに身を包んだロックバード娘。大切なつがいのためなら、例え火の中水の中密林の中。究極の甘味を探求した結果、巨大なるチョコレートの城砦を築き、バレンタインの護り手となった。カチコチ自慢のビックサイズチョコレートも、愛しいつがいの前では文字通り形無しである。

Roc Girl, dressed in her Valentine's outfit, seeking the strongest and biggest chocolate there is. For the sake of her precious mate, she'd go through fire, water, or the deepest jungle. In her quest for the ultimate sweet, she built a colossal fortress of chocolate and became the guardian of Valentine's Day. Even her prized, rock-hard, giant chocolate melts — quite literally — in front of her beloved mate.

unit.326.profile: 異世界の騎士・オンシジュームのコスチュームを身に着けたジャイアント娘。せっかくだからオンシジュームのようにかわいらしく踊りたいと草原でこっそりダンス練習をしている。しかしその巨体のせいで踊ると地響きが起き、周囲には丸わかり。それどころかそのあたりの木もなぎ倒してしまうのでとても危険らしい。そのため練習中の彼女にはなるべく近づかないほうがいいと噂になっているようだ。

Giant Girl, wearing the costume of the otherworldly knight Oncidium. Since she's going all the way, she's secretly practicing dancing in the grasslands, hoping to dance as cutely as Oncidium does. However, because of her massive size, dancing makes the ground shake, giving her away to everyone nearby. Worse still, she ends up knocking down every tree in the area, making it apparently quite dangerous. As a result, rumor has it that it's best to stay as far away as possible while she's practicing.

unit.327.profile: 異世界の天使・アナのコスチュームを身に着けた、アークエンジェル娘オシュネー。命令大好きドМ根性は変わらないものの、妖怪娘の持ち寄った菓子や、釣りなどのアウトドアに、自主的に取り組む様子が確認できる。またお団子や饅頭に強い興味を示している。本人曰く「天啓を受けた」とのこと。何故小さくなっているかは謎である。

Archangel Girl Oshunee, wearing the costume of the otherworldly angel Ana. Her love of being ordered around and her masochistic streak remain unchanged, but she's been observed voluntarily taking part in things like sweets brought by Yokai girls and outdoor activities like fishing. She's also shown a strong interest in dango and manju. According to her, she's 'received divine revelation.' Why she's become smaller is a mystery.
unit.328.title: フェアリードラゴン娘
Fairy Dragon Girl

unit.328.profile: 突如ゲシュペンス島に現れた、明るく元気な異界の騎士。遊んで遊んで遊びまくることにこだわる、生粋の元気っ子。そんな彼女だからこそか、どこかリゾート気分でこの島での生活を楽しんでいる。だが元の世界の仲間たちのことは気にかけているようで、特にカトレアや『シンビジューム』という花騎士について彼女の口から聞くことができる。

A bright, energetic knight from another world who suddenly appeared on Gespenst Island. A true bundle of energy, utterly devoted to playing and playing and playing some more. Perhaps because of that, she seems to be enjoying life on this island with a bit of a resort vibe. Still, she does seem to think about her comrades from her original world, and you can hear from her about Cattleya and a flower knight named 'Cymbidium' in particular.
unit.329.title: メルカバー娘
Merkabah Girl

飛行して移動

unit.329.profile: 優秀な星力と頭脳を持つ、異世界からやってきた天使。所属しているという星徒会では、副会長を務めており、その有能さで多種多様な仕事を一手に引き受け片づけている。報酬として和菓子を渡すなら、大量の仕事をお願いしても一向に構わないらしい。ゲシュペンス島滞在中はネイスたちの『お昼寝同好会』を見学したり、オシュネーと天界のルールや風習について語り合ったりと、異世界交流を楽しんでいるようだ。

An angel from another world, gifted with exceptional stellar power and intellect. In the student council she reportedly belongs to, she serves as vice president, single-handedly taking on and clearing a huge variety of tasks with her capability. Apparently, as long as you pay her in traditional sweets, she has no problem being asked to handle even a mountain of work. During her stay on Gespenst Island, she seems to be enjoying cross-world exchange — sitting in on Naise and the others' 'Nap Appreciation Club,' and chatting with Oshunee about heavenly rules and customs.
unit.330.title: プリンシパリティ娘
Principality Girl

飛行して移動

Light of Mercy

unit.330.profile: 迷える子羊たちを救うべく降り立った天使モンスター娘。その胸には「美少年を愛したいのではなく、愛されたい」という深い願望が秘められている。数多のモンスター娘たちが、美少年の愛を求めている現状に心を痛め、「どうすれば美少年に愛されるのか」を説いてまわっているらしい。愛の名のもとでは全てが調和し、平和になると高らかに宣言している一方で、最も強く求めているのは、１番に自分が愛されること。そんな矛盾した願望を抱えながらも、自らの使命に尽力しているようだ。

An angel monster girl who descended to save the lost lambs of the world. Deep in her heart lies a secret desire — not to love a handsome boy, but to be loved by one. Pained by the sight of so many monster girls chasing after handsome boys' love, she's apparently gone around preaching on 'how to be loved by a handsome boy.' While she proudly declares that in the name of love, all things will harmonize and peace will reign, what she most desperately wants, above all else, is to be the 1 one loved.
unit.331.title: 銀角大王娘
Silver Horn King Girl
race.331.text:
攻撃時、攻撃力が5％上昇（最大20回/撤退死亡時リセット）
ジンリェ配置時、与えるダメージが1.1倍<aw>+0.1倍</aw>、物理/魔法攻撃を30%で回避

Silver Confidant

Stops the movement of attacked enemies for 0.5s
skill.331.name: 銀速陣
Silver Swift Formation
unit.331.profile: 金角大王娘の妹であり、右腕。覇道を歩む首魁の右腕は常にクールであるべきという信条を持ち、能力も高い。そのため姉や配下からは厚い信頼を集めているが、褒められると照れてクールさが崩れてしまうので、彼女らの好意を遠ざける為もあり、単独行動を好んでいる。ひょうたんの栽培が趣味で、くびれに並々ならない拘りがあるとか。

Golden Horn King Girl's younger sister and right hand. She holds the belief that the right hand of a leader walking the path of conquest should always stay cool, and her ability matches that conviction. As a result, she commands deep trust from both her sister and her subordinates, but since being praised makes her flustered and shatters her cool composure, she prefers to act alone — partly to keep their goodwill at arm's length. Her hobby is growing gourds, and she's apparently got an unusual fixation on their narrow waists.
unit.332.title: 購買のマモン娘
Merchant Mammon Girl
race.332.text:
<t=購買部食品トークン>購買部食品トークン</t>を使役
光属性マス配置時、コスト回復速度がややアップ

Commands <t=購買部食品トークン>Store Food Token</t>
While deployed on a Light element tile, Cost recovery speed slightly increases
race.332.name: 本日の目玉商品
Today's Star Item
race.332.bonus: トークンの攻撃力増加+5％
skill.332.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
範囲内の敵の攻撃力を40秒間6%減少させ、減少値の半分の値分全味方の攻撃力を40秒間増加させる

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Reduces the ATK of enemies in range by 6% for 40s, and increases all allies' ATK for 40s by half the amount reduced
skill.332.name: 強欲の購買部
Store of Greed
unit.332.profile: モンスター娘学園の購買部を仕切るマモン娘。品揃えは学園トップクラスだが、価格は気分次第。金銭だけでなく物々交換や怪しい取引が必要な場合も。夜な夜なそろばんをはじく音と笑い声が響く七不思議の元凶。購買部の財産を増やすことに命をかけており、損する取引は絶対にしない。

Mammon Girl runs the school store at Monster Girl Academy. Her selection is top-class for the school, but her prices depend entirely on her mood. Sometimes payment isn't even money — bartering or shady deals may be required instead. She's the source of one of the school's seven mysteries: the sound of an abacus clicking and laughter echoing night after night. She's staked her life on growing the school store's fortune, and never makes a deal that costs her a loss.
unit.333.title: 奏響のマンドレイク娘
Melodic Mandrake Girl
race.333.text:
地属性マス配置時、自身の射程が増加
射程内の味方の物理防御力を、自身の攻撃力50％<aw>+10%</aw>分増加させる

While deployed on an Earth element tile, own Range increases
Increases the DEF of allies in range by 50%<aw>+10%</aw> of own ATK

Harmony of the Eerie Root
race.333.bonus: 物理防御力上昇の攻撃力参照値+10％

[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
自身を地属性マス配置状態にする

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Treats herself as deployed on an Earth element tile
skill.333.name: 怪根のクレッシェンド
Crescendo of the Eerie Root
unit.333.profile: 愛器である手作りコントラバスを片手に持った、吹奏楽部のマンドレイク娘。余りにも魅力的な旋律を奏でるが故に、彼女の音楽に『恋』をしてしまう生徒が続出中。丁重にお断りしているようではあるが、あまりにもしつこい生徒には、コントラバスアタック（と言う名の素殴り）で撃退しているとか。

Mandrake Girl of the brass band club, carrying her beloved handmade double bass in one hand. Her melodies are so captivating that a growing number of students keep falling head over heels in 'love' with her music. She politely turns them down, but for the especially persistent ones, she apparently drives them off with a Double Bass Attack (a fancy name for just decking them).
unit.334.title: 蔵書のアプサラス娘
Archivist Apsaras Girl
race.334.text:
<t=図書水精トークン>図書水精トークン</t>を使役
配置中、10秒<aw>-2秒</aw>毎にトークン所持数+1

Commands <t=図書水精トークン>Library Water Spirit Token</t>
While deployed, Token capacity +1 every 10s<aw>-2s</aw>
race.334.name: しごでき図書委員♪
Efficient Library Committee Member ♪
race.334.bonus: トークン所持数増加の時間-2秒

トークン所持数+3

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Token capacity +3
For every 1 Tokens summoned during battle, ATK +5% and Crit rate +2%
skill.334.name: 図書室ではお静かに♪
Please Be Quiet in the Library ♪
unit.334.profile: 学園図書館のカウンターにて利用者を静観する、図書委員系アプサラス娘。自身の得意技である分身を駆使し、先生方から仰せつかった雑務を完璧にこなす。最近の悩みは、本にイタズラをされたり、なかなか返却されない本があること。もちろん、該当生徒にはきっちりお仕置きをしているもよう。

Apsaras Girl, a member of the library committee who quietly watches over patrons from the counter of the academy library. Making full use of her specialty, shadow clones, she flawlessly handles all the chores assigned to her by the teachers. Her recent troubles include books being tampered with and books that never seem to get returned. Of course, she apparently gives the offending students a proper punishment.
unit.335.title: 呪剣のファフニール娘
Cursed Blade Fafnir Girl
race.335.text:
常に攻撃が魔法属性になる
攻撃した敵をスタンさせる（蓄積値：小）、更にスタン状態の敵への与えるダメージが1.2倍
自身がブロックしている敵の受ける魔法ダメージが1.2倍<aw>+0.05倍</aw>になり、スタン時間+20％

Attacks always become magic element
Stuns attacked enemies (build-up: small), and damage dealt to Stunned enemies ×1.2
Magic damage taken by enemies she's blocking becomes ×1.2<aw>+0.05</aw>, and their Stun duration +20%
race.335.name: ちょっと幸せな学園生活
A Slightly Happy School Life
race.335.bonus: ブロック中の敵が受ける魔法ダメージ＋0.05倍
Magic damage taken by blocked enemies +0.05
skill.335.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、攻撃が4連射の遠距離攻撃に変化
攻撃時に対象の現在HP1%分の追加ダメージが発生する

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], attacks become 4 consecutive ranged shots
On attack, deals additional damage equal to 1% of the target's current HP
skill.335.name: 舞い奪う呪剣
Cursed Blade That Dances and Steals
unit.335.profile: モンスター娘学園に通いつつ、他の生徒と関わりを持とうとしない、孤高のぼっち系ファフニール娘。一人暮らしをしており、基本放課後は引きこもっている。できれば一生引きこもっていたいが、学園に行かないと先生が構ってくれないので、それだけの理由で渋々毎日欠かさず学園に通っている。ただ優しい先生のことだから、もしも本当に不登校になれば心配して出向いてくれるのではないかと思い、最近は少しずつ不登校フラグを匂わせ始めている。

Fafnir Girl attends Monster Girl Academy but never tries to connect with other students, a solitary loner through and through. She lives alone, and basically holes up in her room after school. She'd love to stay a shut-in forever if she could, but since the teacher won't pay her any attention unless she goes to school, that's the only reason she reluctantly drags herself there without fail every day. Still, since her teacher is so kind, she's begun to think that maybe, if she really did stop coming to school, the teacher might worry and come visit her — so lately she's been dropping little hints of truancy here and there.
unit.336.title: シーエルフ娘
Sea Elf Girl
race.336.text:
攻撃後の待ち時間が増加するが25%<aw>+5%</aw>の確率で敵の防御力を無視
自身が水属性マス配置時にクリティカル率+30％

While deployed on a Water element tile, own Crit rate +30%
race.336.name: 海淵のスナイパー
Sniper of the Ocean Depths
skill.336.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
種族特性の防御無視の確率が倍化し
自身を水属性マス配置状態にする

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
The race trait's DEF-ignore chance doubles
Treats herself as deployed on a Water element tile
skill.336.name: タイダルスナイプ
Tidal Snipe
unit.336.profile: 質素で閉鎖的な環境での生活を美徳とし、海底に住まうシーエルフ娘。そんな閉鎖的な生活を送る集落から飛び出してきた。超絶箱入りモンスター娘なので目の前に広がる新しい世界に期待と不安で胸がいっぱいな様子。初めての砂浜、初めての友人、そして運命の王子様……彼女の好奇心は留まることは無いようだ。海の底にはない文化や交流を日々学んでいるらしいが、その認識が本来のものとズレているのもご愛敬。

Sea Elf Girl lives on the ocean floor, where a simple, closed-off way of life is considered a virtue. She's the one who broke free from that insular community. Being an extremely sheltered monster girl, she seems to be filled with both excitement and anxiety over the new world unfolding before her. Her first beach, her first friend, and even a destined prince... her curiosity apparently knows no bounds. She seems to be learning about culture and social exchange that don't exist at the bottom of the sea every day, though it's endearing how her understanding of it all is a bit off from the real thing.
unit.337.title: シームルグ娘
Simurgh Girl
race.337.text:
飛行して移動
再出撃時間50%<aw>+20%</aw>短縮

race.337.name: 美しき再誕
Beautiful Rebirth
skill.337.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
種族特性の肩代わり効果が35%になり
自身のHPが0にならない

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
The race trait's damage-sharing effect becomes 35%
Own HP cannot reach 0
skill.337.name: 鳥王の加護
Blessing of the Bird King
unit.337.profile: 転生を繰り返すことで数多の知識を受け継いできた霊鳥、シームルグ娘。まだ幼く甘えたい盛りだが、ついつい背伸びしてしまう明るく元気なおませさん。前世の記憶は成長過程で思い出していくため、今は忘れてしまっているが、知識は既に多く備わっていて、ゲシュペンス島のあらゆることを知っているのだとか。好奇心も旺盛で、特に生殖には一段と興味津々な模様。

Simurgh Girl, a sacred bird who has inherited vast knowledge through repeated reincarnation. She's still young and at the age where she wants to be doted on, yet she's a bright, energetic little precocious girl who can't help acting more grown-up than she is. Her memories from past lives will return to her gradually as she grows, so she's forgotten them for now, but she's already equipped with plenty of knowledge, apparently knowing all about everything on Gespenst Island. She's also brimming with curiosity, and seems especially, intensely interested in reproduction.
unit.338.title: リトルグリーンマン娘
Little Green Man Girl
race.338.text:
編成時、味方の<t=エイリアン>エイリアン</t>/闇属性モンスター娘それぞれの攻撃力+8％<aw>+2%</aw>
クラス特性による攻撃力上昇が発動後、次の攻撃がクリティカル率+20%、クリティカルダメージ+50%

When in the party, allied <t=エイリアン>Alien</t> and Dark element monster girls' ATK +8%<aw>+2%</aw> each
After the class trait's ATK increase activates, the next attack's Crit rate +20%, Crit damage +50%
race.338.name: レイジーデストロイヤー
Lazy Destroyer
race.338.bonus: 編成時、味方のエイリアン/闇属性モンスター娘それぞれの攻撃力+2％
When in the party, allied Alien and Dark element monster girls' ATK +2% each
skill.338.text:

この攻撃で撃破した時、撃破した敵の基本攻撃力100%の魔法ダメージを周囲に与える

Cost [cost]; on skill activation, attacks all nearby enemies at ATK ×[MAG,0,0], 1 time(s) only
On kill with this attack, deals magic damage equal to 100% of the defeated enemy's base ATK to nearby enemies
skill.338.name: コズミックエッジ
Cosmic Edge
unit.338.profile: 「メンドクサイ」から惑星破壊を決意する、リトルグリーンマンの王女。気まぐれで破壊衝動を起こすが、基本的にはゲームのほうが大事。触角で相手の思考を読む能力を持つが、よく解釈を間違える。愛玩動物として美少年を抱き枕にするが、他人からの抗議はすべてスルー。結局、全てが「メンドイ」。

A Little Green Man princess who decides to destroy planets simply out of 'it's too much trouble.' She has fits of destructive impulse on a whim, but at the end of the day, her games matter more. She has the ability to read minds with her antennae, but frequently misreads them. She keeps handsome boys as pets, using them as body pillows, and completely ignores any complaints from others about it. In the end, everything just comes down to 'too much trouble.'
unit.339.title: モスマン娘
Mothman Girl
race.339.text:
移動速度+100、移動中は攻撃を行わなくなるが、スキルが解除されない
配置時、移動速度の50％<aw>+20%</aw>分攻撃力が増加
移動中は通過地点に持続魔法ダメージを一定時間発生させ、まれに相手を暗闇にする
持続ダメージは発動時の攻撃力の60%

On deployment, ATK increases by 50%<aw>+20%</aw> of Move speed

Continuous damage is 60% of ATK at activation

Soaring Scale Dust
race.339.bonus: 配置時、移動速度の+20%分攻撃力が増加
On deployment, ATK increases by +20% of Move speed
skill.339.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
敵の遠距離攻撃の対象にならず、種族特性の移動速度と持続ダメージが1.5倍
持続ダメージの発生間隔を短縮

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Cannot be targeted by enemy ranged attacks, and the race trait's Move speed and continuous damage ×1.5
Shortens the continuous damage interval
skill.339.name: 闇夜の紅眼
Crimson Eyes of the Dark Night
unit.339.profile: 真っ赤な瞳と凄まじい飛行速度を誇るモンスター娘。『不吉の象徴』呪われた存在とされているが、当人はそう吹聴されていることを特に気にしていない様子。そんなことよりも、自身に搭載された『エッチ災難センサー』を使い、周囲をエッチな災難から守ることに全力である。「きぃきぃ」とネズミやコウモリに似た声で暗闇から飛んでくる姿は、少し……いや、かなりホラー。

A monster girl boasting blood-red eyes and terrifying flight speed. She's regarded as 'a symbol of ill omen,' a cursed being, though she herself doesn't seem to mind that reputation being spread around at all. More than that, she's fully devoted to using her built-in 'lewd disaster sensor' to protect everyone from lewd calamities. The sight of her flying out of the darkness with a squeaking cry like a mouse or a bat is a little... no, actually quite terrifying.
unit.340.title: アースドラゴン娘
Earth Dragon Girl
race.340.text:
最大HP+100%<aw>+20％</aw>、ブロック数+2<aw>+1</aw>、近接マスに配置可能
その代わりコスト+5
回復を行った時、自身も基礎攻撃力100%分、回復する

Max HP +100%<aw>+20%</aw>, Block +2<aw>+1</aw>, can be deployed on melee tiles
In exchange, Cost +5
When healing, also heals herself for 100% of base ATK
race.340.name: 大地の竜脈
Earth's Dragon Vein
skill.340.text:
[duration]秒、最大HPが[MAG,0,0]倍、攻撃力[MAG,1,0]倍
回復対象数+[0,2,0]
敵の攻撃を引き付けて、受ける物理魔法ダメージ30％減少

For [duration]s, Max HP ×[MAG,0,0], ATK ×[MAG,1,0]
Healing targets +[0,2,0]
Draws enemy attacks, and physical/magic damage taken -30%
skill.340.name: 地堅牢
Earthen Bastion
unit.340.profile: 生命力と豊かな実りを司り、島とモンスター娘の繁栄に力を貸すアースドラゴン娘。別名「ゲシュペンス島の地母神」特定の知識が豊富なため、毎日モンスター娘たちからの相談が絶えない。また彼女の施すマッサージは感度アップに効果ありと評判だとか。豪快な姉御肌でセクハラ好きだが、逆に責められると弱いらしい。

Earth Dragon Girl presides over vitality and bountiful harvests, lending her power to the prosperity of the island and its monster girls. Also known as 'the Earth Mother of Gespenst Island,' her extensive knowledge in certain areas means she's never short of monster girls seeking her advice every day. Her massages are also reportedly reputed to boost sensitivity. She's a bold, big-sisterly type who loves a bit of harassment, but is apparently weak when the tables are turned on her.
unit.341.title: ラージノーズグレイ娘
Large-Nose Grey Girl
race.341.text:
編成時、味方の<t=エイリアン>エイリアン</t>/光属性モンスター娘それぞれの攻撃力+8％<aw>+2%</aw>
<t=グレイクローントークン>グレイクローントークン</t>を使役
自身が配置中、自身の射程内の味方が敵を5体撃破する毎にその味方のいるマスにトークンを召喚する
トークンが召喚されるたびにクローンエナジーを獲得する
スキル発動中にクローンエナジーが5以上ある場合、全て消費し自身射程内の味方のいる全てのマスにトークンを召喚する
スキルでのトークン召喚ではクローンエナジーを獲得しない

When in the party, allied <t=エイリアン>Alien</t> and Light element monster girls' ATK +8%<aw>+2%</aw> each
Commands <t=グレイクローントークン>Grey Clone Token</t>
While deployed, every time an ally in own range defeats 5 enemies, summons a Token to that ally's tile
Gains Clone Energy each time a Token is summoned
If Clone Energy is 5 or more while the skill is active, consumes it all and summons Tokens to every tile with allies in own range
Summoning Tokens through the skill does not grant Clone Energy
race.341.name: マッドネスラボラトリ
Madness Laboratory
race.341.bonus: 編成時、味方のエイリアン/光属性モンスター娘それぞれの攻撃力+2％
When in the party, allied Alien and Light element monster girls' ATK +2% each
skill.341.text:
消費コスト[cost]
[duration]秒、自身と自トークンの攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍
射程[MAG,1,0]倍、トークン所持数+2

Cost [cost]
For [duration]s, ATK of self and own Token ×[MAG,0,0]
Range ×[MAG,1,0], Token capacity +2
skill.341.name: オブジェクトアナライズ
Object Analyze
unit.341.profile: 盛り上がった鼻が特徴のヘルメットと白衣を着用しているラージノーズグレイ娘。多くのリトルグレイ娘たちを自分の遺伝子をもとに作ったという優秀な科学者であり、宇宙中に「マッドサイエンティスト」として名をとどろかせている。彼女の目的はどんな環境でも生きることができる完璧な生命体をつくること。その理想のためには非人道的な実験も厭わないという。そんな彼女にとってゲシュペンス島は摩訶不思議で優秀な個体の宝庫らしく、テンションをあげている。いつか優秀な個体を集めた集合体をつくろうとひそかに企んでいるらしい。

Large-Nose Grey Girl wears a helmet featuring a distinctively bulging nose along with a lab coat. She's a brilliant scientist said to have created many of the Little Grey Girls from her own genes, and her name resounds across the cosmos as a 'mad scientist.' Her goal is to create a perfect life form capable of surviving in any environment, and she apparently won't shy away from inhumane experiments in pursuit of that ideal. To her, Gespenst Island seems like a treasure trove of mysterious and superior specimens, which has her thrilled with excitement. She's apparently secretly scheming to one day create a collective made up of nothing but superior specimens.
unit.342.title: デスワーム娘
Death Worm Girl
race.342.text:
射程+70<aw>+20</aw>
攻撃間隔が増加するが、範囲攻撃化
攻撃時にまれに敵を猛毒状態にする

Range +70<aw>+20</aw>
Attack interval increases, but attacks become area attacks
On attack, rarely inflicts Deadly Poison on the enemy
race.342.name: 砂塵の砲撃手
Gunner of the Desert Dust
skill.342.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
攻撃の範囲が増加し、敵の魔法防御力を減少させる

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Attack area increases and reduces the enemy's MDEF
skill.342.name: デスワームカノン
Death Worm Cannon
unit.342.profile: 機敏な感覚が更に鋭利になった結果、サンドワーム娘から進化したデスワーム娘。どうやら初心に戻り、最も効率的かつ理想的な姿になるために「退行進化」を行なった末、この小さな姿になったのだとか。嗅覚、聴覚、味覚が通常時より発達し、優れた攻撃能力も獲得。小さくても頼もしさは以前よりも増大した。

Death Worm Girl, who evolved from Sandworm Girl as her keen senses grew even sharper. It seems that in order to return to basics and reach her most efficient, ideal form, she underwent a 'regressive evolution,' ending up in this smaller shape. Her sense of smell, hearing, and taste have all developed beyond their usual levels, and she's gained superior attack capabilities as well. Small as she may be, she's more reliable than ever.
unit.343.title: ラタトスク娘
Ratatoskr Girl
race.343.text:
移動速度+100<aw>+30</aw>
配置時、移動完了後、またはスキル開始時に、自身を除く射程内の味方に30秒、1秒ごとに対象の最大HP1%分を毎秒回復する効果を与える（この効果は重複しない）

Move speed +100<aw>+30</aw>
On deployment, after completing movement, or on skill start, grants allies in range excluding self an effect for 30s that heals them each second for 1% of their Max HP every 1s (this effect does not stack)
race.343.name: 世界樹のつなぎ手
Bridge of the World Tree
skill.343.text:
[duration]秒、射程[MAG,0,0]倍、移動コストが0になり、移動してもスキルが解除されない
種族特性の味方への付与効果に攻撃力+60％、CRI率+20％を追加

For [duration]s, Range ×[MAG,0,0], Move cost becomes 0, and moving does not cancel the skill
Adds ATK +60% and Crit rate +20% to the race trait's effect granted to allies
skill.343.name: チアメッセンジャー
Cheer Messenger
unit.343.profile: 創世記の少年が植えたという『ショタイ樹ショタドラシル』に住むモンスター娘。ショタドラシルが枯れないように世話をしている。またマメさと素早さを活かして「メッセンジャー」を買って出ることが多いが、あまり記憶力が良くないので相手には全く違う内容が伝わってしまうことが多々あるようだ。悪意はないのだが、そのせいで連絡を取り合った両者の仲を険悪なものにしてしまうこともしばしば。木の実全般に目がなく、木の実ソムリエでもあるらしい。ベスト木の実はショタドラシルが落とすティアシード。

A monster girl who lives in the 'Shotai Tree, Shotadrasil,' said to have been planted by the boy from Genesis. She takes care of it so it never withers. She also often volunteers as a 'messenger,' making use of her diligence and quickness, but since her memory isn't very good, she frequently ends up delivering something entirely different from what was actually said. There's no malice in it, but as a result, she's often ended up souring relations between the two parties trying to communicate through her. She has a weakness for nuts and berries of every kind, and is apparently even something of a nut sommelier. Her favorite of all is the tear seed that falls from Shotadrasil.
unit.344.title: 玄武娘
Genbu Girl
race.344.text:
レンタルを含めず水属性が8体以上編成されている時、全モンスター娘の攻撃力と物理防御力+7%<aw>+2％</aw>
常に受ける物理ダメージを25％減少
配置中、現在物理防御力の100％分攻撃力が増加

When 8 or more Water element units are in the party, excluding rentals, all monster girls' ATK and DEF +7%<aw>+2%</aw>
Always reduces physical damage taken by 25%
While deployed, ATK increases by 100% of current DEF
race.344.name: 水頑堅亀
Steadfast Water Tortoise
race.344.bonus: 水属性が8体以上編成されている時全モンスター娘の攻撃力と物理防御力+2％上昇
When 8 or more Water element units are in the party, all monster girls' ATK and DEF +2%
skill.344.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、物理防御力[MAG,1,0]倍
攻撃が遠距離攻撃になる
種族特性の物理ダメージ軽減効果が倍になり、敵の攻撃を引き付ける

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], DEF ×[MAG,1,0]
Attacks become ranged attacks
The race trait's physical damage reduction doubles, and draws enemy attacks
skill.344.name: 揺蕩う守護
Drifting Protection
unit.344.profile: 亀の甲羅を持ち、蛇を体にまとっている妖怪系モンスター娘。スピードはないが防御力高めの戦士。守り神と言われる四神娘のひとりではあるが、決して仲間ではないと言い張り、露悪的な中二病を気取っている。しかし、根はお人よしのためピンチにはついかけつけてしまうようだ。特技は亀の甲羅を使った占いで、占い中は口調が変わり、性格も豹変するらしい。

A yokai-type monster girl with a turtle shell and a snake wrapped around her body. A warrior who lacks speed but boasts high defense. Though she's one of the Four Guardian Girls said to be protective deities, she stubbornly insists she's never part of any group and puts on airs of deliberately villainous, chuunibyo-style edginess. Deep down, however, she's kind-hearted, so she can't help rushing to help whenever someone's in a pinch. Her specialty is fortune-telling using her turtle shell, and apparently her tone and personality both completely change while she's telling fortunes.
unit.345.title: 青龍娘
Seiryu Girl
race.345.text:
レンタルを含めず風属性が8体以上編成されている時、全モンスター娘の攻撃力+7%<aw>+3％</aw>、コスト-1
自身が敵を撃破時、自身の最大HP100%分回復し、さらにコストが1回復する

When 8 or more Wind element units are in the party, excluding rentals, all monster girls' ATK +7%<aw>+3%</aw>, Cost -1
On kill, restores own HP by 100% of Max HP, and also recovers 1 Cost
race.345.name: 流風撃龍
Flowing Wind Strike Dragon
race.345.bonus: 風属性が8体以上編成されている時全モンスター娘の攻撃力+3％上昇
When 8 or more Wind element units are in the party, all monster girls' ATK +3%
skill.345.text:
即座にコストが[0,0,0]回復
その後[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,1,0]倍に上昇、敵3体に遠距離攻撃を行い、射程内の味方のHPを1秒毎に対象の最大HPの[0,6,0]％分回復

Immediately recovers [0,0,0] Cost
Then for [duration]s, ATK rises to ×[MAG,1,0], performs a ranged attack against 3 enemies, and heals allies in range for [0,6,0]% of their Max HP every 1s
skill.345.name: 荒ぶ旋風
Raging Whirlwind
unit.345.profile: 四神娘のひとりで風を操る青龍娘。正義のヒーローの緑担当として役割を担っているが、本人は自信がなく、仲間の影に隠れがち。しかし、作戦立案の勘は鋭く、無意識の一言が戦況を左右することもある。風を読む力に長け、空を舞う落とし物を見つけるのが得意だが、なぜか特定の書物を拾う確率が異常に高い。

Seiryu Girl, one of the Four Guardian Girls, who controls the wind. She's tasked with the role of 'the green one' among heroes of justice, but she herself lacks confidence and tends to hide in her comrades' shadows. That said, her instincts for planning strategy are sharp, and an offhand remark of hers can sometimes shift the tide of battle. She's skilled at reading the wind and good at spotting things drifting through the sky, but for some reason, her odds of picking up a certain type of book are abnormally high.
unit.346.title: ブリアレオース娘
Briareos Girl
race.346.text:
クリティカル率+30<aw>+10</aw>%、クリティカルダメージ+50%
常に敵2体を攻撃する
地上の敵への与えるダメージ2倍
4回攻撃するたびに次の攻撃が範囲攻撃に変化

Crit rate +30<aw>+10</aw>%, Crit damage +50%
Always attacks 2 enemies
Damage dealt to ground enemies ×2
Every 4 attacks, the next attack becomes an area attack
race.346.name: 百腕の強者
Hundred-Armed Mighty One
skill.346.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,1,0]倍、射程[MAG,0,0]倍
攻撃速度が上昇し、攻撃間隔が減少する
種族特性の範囲攻撃が常に発生する

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,1,0], Range ×[MAG,0,0]
Attack speed increases and attack interval decreases
The race trait's area attack always triggers
skill.346.name: 激流射・疾
Torrent Shot: Swift
weapon.346.name: アイガイオーン
Aigaion
weapon.346.text: スキル発動中、敵の遠距離攻撃の対象にならない
While skill is active, cannot be targeted by enemy ranged attacks
unit.346.profile: おっちょこちょいな性格を直すため、滝行を経て進化したブリアレオース娘。腕力が強化され、岩だけでなく水の塊も投げられるようになった。肝心の性格についてだが、自信がついて、明るくより調子に乗りやすくなった反面、少しでも貶されるとどん底に落ち込むなど、感情の振れ幅が激しくなってしまい、結果以前と同じ引きこもり気質はそのままになっているようだ。

Briareos Girl, who evolved after undergoing waterfall training to fix her clumsy personality. Her arm strength has been enhanced, letting her hurl not just boulders but also masses of water. As for the personality itself, she's gained confidence and become cheerier and quicker to get carried away, but on the flip side, the slightest put-down now sends her crashing into the depths of despair — her emotional swings have only grown more intense, and as a result, she seems to have ended up with the same shut-in tendencies as before.
unit.347.title: 妖狐剣客
Fox Spirit Swordsman
race.347.text:
自身が敵撃破時、攻撃力が20%上昇（最大10回/撤退死亡時リセット）
攻撃時まれに相手を<t=火傷>火傷</t>状態にする、スキル時は確率上昇
火傷状態の敵に与えるダメージ1.2<aw>+0.1</aw>倍

On kill, ATK increases by 20% (up to 10 times, resets on retreat or death)
On attack, rarely inflicts <t=火傷>Burn</t> on the target; the chance increases while skill is active
Damage dealt to Burning enemies ×1.2<aw>+0.1</aw>
race.347.name: 一心
Single-Minded
race.347.bonus: 火傷状態の敵に与えるダメージ+0.1倍
skill.347.text: スキル発動時、1度だけ攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍で範囲内の敵に２連続で直進し触れた敵全てを攻撃する遠距離攻撃を行う
On skill activation, 1 time(s) only, performs a ranged attack at ATK ×[MAG,0,0] against enemies in range, traveling straight 2 times in succession and hitting all enemies it touches
skill.347.name: 狐炎剣
Fox Flame Blade
weapon.347.name: カンムイの剣
Sword of Kanmui
weapon.347.text: 火傷状態の敵を攻撃時に対象の現在HP5%分の追加ダメージが発生
When attacking Burning enemies, deals additional damage equal to 5% of the target's current HP
unit.347.profile: かつて「陰陽の徒」と呼ばれる組織に身を置き、治安維持に尽力していた妖狐の剣客。現在は「シキノワ」の神社で静かに暮らしながら、平和の訪れを信じ、時には剣を取る。清廉な心と確かな剣技を持ちながらも、どこか抜けた一面もあり、しばしば空回りすることも。それでも、誰かの笑顔を守るための信念だけは、けっして揺らぐことはない。

A fox spirit swordsman who once belonged to an organization called 'the Onmyo Order,' dedicating herself to maintaining public order. She now lives quietly at the 'Shikinowa' shrine, believing peace will come, and occasionally takes up her sword. Despite her pure heart and solid swordsmanship, she has a somewhat scatterbrained side, and often ends up spinning her wheels. Even so, her conviction to protect someone's smile never wavers.
unit.348.title: カーバンクルドラゴン娘
Carbuncle Dragon Girl
race.348.text:
編成時、味方の<t=ドラゴン>ドラゴン</t>/光属性モンスター娘それぞれの攻撃力+8％<aw>+2%</aw>
配置中、一定時間毎に全味方のHPを自身の基本攻撃力の5%分回復し続ける
自身の基本攻撃力100％分のバリアを、スキル発動時自身に、敵を5体撃破ごとに自身を除く全味方に付与する

When in the party, allied <t=ドラゴン>Dragon</t> and Light element monster girls' ATK +8%<aw>+2%</aw> each
While deployed, keeps healing all allies at set intervals for 5% of own base ATK
Grants a Barrier equal to 100% of own base ATK — to herself on skill activation, and to all allies excluding herself for every 5 enemies defeated
race.348.name: カーバンクルフォース
Carbuncle Force
race.348.bonus: 編成時、味方のドラゴン/光属性モンスター娘それぞれの攻撃力+2％
When in the party, allied Dragon and Light element monster girls' ATK +2% each
skill.348.text:
スキル発動時に1度だけ攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍で
広範囲の敵5体を攻撃
敵が2～3体の時は2連撃、1体の時は5連撃になる

On skill activation, 1 time(s) only, attacks 5 enemies in a wide area at ATK ×[MAG,0,0]
When there are 2-3 enemies, becomes 2 consecutive hits; when there are 1, becomes 5 consecutive hits
skill.348.name: ジュエリーフラッシュ
Jewelry Flash
unit.348.profile: 進化によって強大な魔力を得たカーバンクルドラゴン娘。以前のように臆することなく戦えるようになり、密猟者や魔物にも堂々と立ち向かう。その一方で、額の宝石に宿る魅了の力がさらに増し、戦闘中に不用意に発動させないよう慎重になっている。しかし、ふとした拍子に魔力があふれ出してしまい、思わぬ騒動を巻き起こすことも。

Carbuncle Dragon Girl, who gained tremendous magical power through evolution. She can now fight without hesitation like before, standing boldly against poachers and monsters alike. At the same time, the charm power dwelling in the gem on her forehead has grown even stronger, so she's grown careful not to trigger it carelessly in battle. Even so, her magic sometimes overflows unexpectedly, stirring up unforeseen chaos.
unit.349.title: 鳴嫁のコカトリス娘
Singing Bride Cockatrice Girl
race.349.text:
毒無効
最大HP+40％、代わりに移動速度-30％
攻撃時に5%の確率で攻撃した敵を石化、
石化状態の敵に与えるダメージ1.5倍<aw>+0.2倍</aw>

Immune to Poison
Max HP +40%, but Move speed -30%
On attack, has a 5% chance to inflict Petrify on the attacked enemy
Damage dealt to Petrified enemies ×1.5<aw>+0.2</aw>
race.349.name: ペトリブーケ
Petri Bouquet
race.349.bonus: 石化状態の敵に与えるダメージ+0.2倍
skill.349.text:
スキル発動時、射程内の敵を石化させる
その後[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
攻撃対象数+2

On skill activation, inflicts Petrify on enemies in range
Then for [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Targets +2
skill.349.name: レセプションフラッシュ
Reception Flash
unit.349.profile: 花嫁衣装に身を包み、幸せを振りまくコカトリス娘。求愛の証として編みこまれた羽根は「いっぱい舞ったら大吉！」という伝説付き。でも緊張すると石化能力が暴走しやすく、誓いのキスの直前に新郎が石像になることも。なお、大きなリボンブーケは「愛情の一撃」という名の護身用。羽根をばっさばっさ振る求愛ポーズも、毎回羽ばたきすぎて部屋が羽根まみれに。幸せの舞いが今日も止まらない。

Cockatrice Girl, dressed in a wedding gown and spreading happiness wherever she goes. The feathers woven in as proof of courtship come with a legend: 'the more they flutter, the greater the luck!' But when she gets nervous, her petrification ability tends to go out of control, occasionally turning the groom into a statue right before the vow kiss. Incidentally, her large ribbon bouquet doubles as self-defense, dubbed the 'strike of love.' Even her courtship pose of flapping her feathers wildly ends up shedding so many feathers that the room fills up with them every time. Her dance of happiness just won't stop today either.
unit.350.title: 浜夏のジャバウォック娘
Summer Beach Jabberwock Girl
race.350.text:
突進して移動し移動中にスキル解除されない
移動コストが+2になるが、移動中の与えるダメージ2倍、移動速度が2.5倍
ダメージを受けると最大HPが上昇（累積1万ダメージで最大60%<aw>+10%</aw>上昇）

Charges to move; moving does not cancel the skill
Move cost becomes +2, but damage dealt while moving ×2, Move speed ×2.5
Max HP increases upon taking damage (rises by up to 60%<aw>+10%</aw> for every 1 × 10,000 cumulative damage taken)
race.350.name: スイカスプラッシュ
Watermelon Splash
race.350.bonus: 体力減少時のHP上昇最大値+10%
Max HP increase cap when taking damage +10%
skill.350.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、移動速度+150
基本HPの20%分攻撃力が上昇

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Move speed +150
ATK increases by 20% of base HP
skill.350.name: ソニックスイム
Sonic Swim
unit.350.profile: 水着姿で浜辺に降り立ったジャバウォック娘。砂に謎の模様を描いては「これで波とおしゃべりできる」と満足げ。だが実際に聞こえるのは貝のきしみ音ばかりで、毎回なぜか全力でツッコミを受ける。貝殻と会話しながら幻影のビーチチェアで昼寝し、目覚めては紅茶を入れるループが止まらない。戦いより昼下がりが本番らしい。

Jabberwock Girl, landing on the beach in a swimsuit. She draws mysterious patterns in the sand, satisfied that 'now I can chat with the waves.' In reality, though, all that can actually be heard is the creaking of shells, which somehow earns her a full-force retort every single time. She naps in a phantom beach chair while chatting with seashells, then wakes up and brews tea, over and over in an endless loop. It seems that lazy afternoons, not battle, are her true calling.
unit.351.title: 碧海のファロルーチェ娘
Azure Sea Farolucce Girl
race.351.text:
常に飛行して移動し、毒状態にならない
編成時、全モンスター娘の攻撃力と魔法防御力+7%<aw>+2%</aw>
自身の受ける魔法ダメージを20%減少、自身が敵を撃破時さらに減少値+2％
（最大10回/死亡撤退後も継続）

Always flies to move, and is immune to Poison
When in the party, all monster girls' ATK and MDEF +7%<aw>+2%</aw>
Reduces magic damage taken by self by 20%; on kill, the reduction further +2%
(up to 10 times, persisting even after death or retreat)
race.351.name: サンシャインサマー
Sunshine Summer
race.351.bonus: 編成時、全モンスター娘の攻撃力と魔法防御力+2%
When in the party, all monster girls' ATK and MDEF +2%
skill.351.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍
自身の攻撃力20%分、全味方のHPを毎秒回復
射程内の自身を除く味方が受ける魔法ダメージを10%減少

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0]
Heals all allies' HP every second for 20% of own ATK
Reduces magic damage taken by allies in range excluding self by 10%
skill.351.name: ブリリアントウィップ
Brilliant Whip
unit.351.profile: 神々しい輝きをまとい、ゲシュペンス島のビーチに舞い降りたファロルーチェ娘。今日もおねショタと獣神ファロルーチェの素晴らしさを世界に広めるため、ビーチを奔走している。水着を着たおかげもあり、最近ではその勢力を海棲モンスター娘にまで広げているらしい。

Farolucce Girl, cloaked in divine radiance, descending upon the beaches of Gespenst Island. Today too, she's running all across the beach to spread word of the wonders of onee-shota and the beast god Farolucce to the world. Thanks in part to her swimsuit, she's apparently even managed to extend her influence to sea-dwelling monster girls lately.
unit.352.title: 爽蒼のワードラゴン娘
Cool Azure War Dragon Girl
race.352.text:
自身が回復した対象が、10秒<aw>+2秒</aw>間対象の最大HP1%を毎秒回復する
射程内の敵は移動速度と攻撃速度が減少
スキル中は姿が獣化しパワーアップ

Targets she heals continue to heal for 1% of their Max HP every second for 10s<aw>+2s</aw>
Enemies in range have reduced Move speed and Attack speed
While skill is active, transforms into a beast form and powers up
race.352.name: ドラゴンバケーション
Dragon Vacation
race.352.bonus: 付与する回復の効果時間+2秒
Duration of the healing effect granted +2s
skill.352.text:
効果時間無限（移動・撤退・死亡で解除）
攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍、回復対象数+2
射程内の味方のクリティカル率とクリティカル率上限+20％

Unlimited duration (ends on move, retreat, or death)
ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0], healing targets +2
Crit rate and Crit rate cap of allies in range +20%
skill.352.name: 流激涼舞
Torrential Cool Dance
unit.352.profile: 水着で修行に励むワードラゴン娘。風鈴は飾りではなく戦の道具だと、風鈴付きの錫杖を手に海風を操ろうとするも、肝心の音色が心地よすぎて、自分がリラックスしてしまうのが最大の弱点。スイカ割りもこの錫杖で挑むが、「風鈴が鳴るたび集中力が乱れる！」と毎回割れない。気合いと熱砂は相性が悪いらしい。

War Dragon Girl, training hard in her swimsuit. Insisting that her wind chime is a tool of war and not mere decoration, she wields a chime-adorned staff to try to control the sea breeze — but her greatest weakness is that the sound is just too pleasant, leaving her relaxed instead. She also tries her hand at watermelon-splitting with the same staff, but 'every time the chime rings, my focus breaks!' — so she never manages to split it. Determination and hot sand apparently just don't mix well.
unit.353.title: メリュジーヌ娘
Melusine Girl
race.353.text:
クリティカル率、クリティカル率上限+20%

Lovely Serpent Dragon

skill.353.name: サーペントテイル
Serpent Tail
unit.353.profile: 上半身は美女、下半身は蛇の姿を持ち、さらにドラゴンの翼を備えた神秘的なモンスター娘。静かな空気をまとい、気品あふれる風格が特徴。かつて創世記の少年に恋をしたものの、とある呪いのため遠くから見守ることしかできなかったらしい。呪いが強まる月のない夜は、誰も近づかない洞窟にこもっているようだ。落ち着いた雰囲気を持つが、甘えん坊な一面もあり、実はウンディーネ娘のプネーマと並ぶほど異性に人気があるが、本人はそのことに気づいていない。

A mystical monster girl with the upper body of a beautiful woman and the lower body of a serpent, further equipped with dragon wings. She carries a quiet air and a character brimming with elegance. She once fell in love with the boy from Genesis, but due to a certain curse, she could apparently only watch over him from afar. On moonless nights, when the curse grows stronger, she seems to shut herself away in a cave no one approaches. She carries a calm atmosphere, but also has a side that craves affection, and is in fact popular with the opposite sex on par with Undine Girl Pneuma — though she herself hasn't noticed.
unit.354.title: ネクロマンサー
Necromancer
race.354.text:
射程内の味方の毒・スタン<aw>石化</aw>状態を即座に回復する
更に、射程内の味方の再出撃時間30%短縮
（再出撃時間短縮は重複不可）

Also shortens the Redeploy time of allies in range by 30%
(Redeploy time reduction does not stack)
race.354.name: 才女なのじゃ！
I'm a Woman of Talent!
race.354.bonus: 状態異常回復効果に石化追加
Adds Petrify to the ailment cure effect
skill.354.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力と射程[MAG,0,0]倍、回復対象数+3
射程内の敵は一部の回復効果を受けられない状態かつ一定時間毎に敵自身の現在HPが3％ずつ減る

For [duration]s, ATK and Range ×[MAG,0,0], healing targets +3
Enemies in range are unable to receive some healing effects, and their current HP decreases by 3% at set intervals
skill.354.name: アンデットライズ
Undead Rise
unit.354.profile: あどけない見た目とは違い、１００年以上の年月を生きているサキュバスのネクロマンサー。三大魔芸の大家「アルテイスト家」の生き残りであり、没落した御家を再興すべく「究極のゾンビ」の完成を目指している。そのため風呂や食事なども忘れて研究に没頭してしまい、相棒のフレデリカに呆れられている。魔芸の求道に全てを捧げてきたためか、サキュバスとしての技はまるでダメらしい。

Unlike her innocent appearance suggests, this succubus necromancer has lived for over 100 years. She's the sole survivor of the 'Arteist family,' one of the three great houses of magical arts, and aims to complete the 'ultimate zombie' in order to restore her family's fallen name. Because of this, she often forgets to eat or bathe, utterly absorbed in her research, much to the exasperation of her partner Frederica. Perhaps because she's devoted everything to her pursuit of magical arts, her skills as a succubus are apparently completely hopeless.
unit.355.title: アイドル
Idol

出撃コスト-2
配置時、射程内の敵を短時間スタンさせる(蓄積値:超特大)
射程内の敵の攻撃力を自身の攻撃力15％<aw>+3％</aw>分減少

Deploy cost -2

Idol Young Lady

[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0]

skill.355.name: テンタクルバインド
Tentacle Bind
unit.355.profile: 妖魔貴族の娘で、気高くプライドの高いモンスター娘。高飛車でツンツンしているが、根は負けず嫌いで努力家。今は「アイドル」として頂点を目指し、踊りや歌の練習に励んでいる。ライバルとみなした相手には容赦がなく、無意識に触手で締め上げようとするため、周囲からたびたび止められている。オーディションにはことごとく落ちているが、その理由は「審査員を手籠めにしようとしたから」という致命的なミスによるものらしい。アイドルの本質はまだ理解していないが、本人は至って本気である。

The daughter of a fiend noble family, a proud and haughty monster girl. She's condescending and prickly, but at heart she's a hard worker who hates to lose. Right now, she's aiming for the top as an 'idol,' throwing herself into practicing dance and song. She shows no mercy to anyone she considers a rival, unconsciously trying to strangle them with tentacles, so those around her frequently have to hold her back. She's failed every single audition without exception, apparently due to the fatal mistake of 'trying to seduce the judges.' She still doesn't understand the true essence of being an idol, but she herself is completely serious about it.
unit.356.title: 魔導師
Magus

Magical Lust Demon

skill.356.name: バストユニオン
Bust Union
unit.356.profile: 強大な魔力を持つウィッチだが、研究のためなら多少の倫理や常識は二の次。興味を持ったことには徹底的に食らいつくが、興味のないことには驚くほど無関心。サキュバスらしからぬ冷静さを持ち、戦闘ではその強大な魔力と、得意の足技で敵を蹂躙することを好む。なお、過去の実験で魔導書を爆発させた回数は、本人いわく「そんなに多くはない」らしい。もちろん、実験台が「踏みつけ」によるものだったことも、決して少なくはない。

A witch with tremendous magical power, but for the sake of research, ethics and common sense come a distant second. She digs in relentlessly on anything that interests her, while showing shocking indifference to anything that doesn't. She has a composure unusual for a succubus, and in battle prefers to trample her enemies with both her overwhelming magic and her favored leg techniques. Incidentally, according to her, the number of times she's blown up a grimoire during past experiments 'isn't really that many.' Of course, it's also no small number of times that the test subject just happened to be someone she 'stomped on.'

Queen Harpy

Queen of Bird Spirits
race.357.bonus: クリティカル率と上限+5%

攻撃が範囲攻撃に変化
射程内の味方に物理/魔法攻撃を35％の確率で回避する効果を付与する

skill.357.name: 女王嵐舞
Queen's Storm Dance
unit.357.profile: ハーピー族の女王。実力は相当だが戦いを好まない性格で、一族から慕われている。同胞たちと共に一族を繁栄に導くため精進を重ねているが、掃除だけは大の苦手でなぜか余計に散らかしてしまうことを気にしている。かつて一族と自身を救ってくれたルカを助けるために仲間となった。恩義を感じてはいるものの、未来に子孫を多く残すため、期待しつつそのチャンスを狙っている。

The queen of the Harpy tribe. Her strength is considerable, but she dislikes fighting by nature, and is adored by her people. Together with her kin, she keeps working hard to lead her tribe to prosperity, though cleaning is her one weak point — she's bothered by how she somehow always ends up making more of a mess instead. She once became an ally in order to help Luca, who saved both her tribe and herself. While she feels indebted to him, she's also hopefully watching for her chance, hoping to leave behind plenty of descendants in the future.
unit.358.title: 遊岸のコボルト娘
Seaside Kobold Girl
race.358.text:
最大HP、攻撃力、物理防御力が低い代わりにコストが-4
射程内の敵の移動速度を減少させる

Curse: reduces the enemy's Attack speed for 20s

Kobold Vacation (Swimsuit)
race.358.bonus: 配置中コボルト族の攻撃力+5%

[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
呪詛状態の敵の攻撃後の待機時間を増加

skill.358.name: ぷかぷかドルフィン
Floaty Floaty Dolphin
curse.5.text: 敵の攻撃速度を減少させる
unit.358.profile: 水着に着替え、海辺の鉱物を探しに来たコボルト娘。泳ぎは苦手なのでビーチでは相棒のイルカくんと常に一緒に行動している。なので海での遊びはもっぱら砂遊びがメイン。砂浜に穴をたくさん掘っているのは、潮干狩りがしたいわけではなく、ショタの汗を好むという魔石が目当てらしい。

Kobold Girl, changed into a swimsuit, came to search for minerals along the seashore. Since she's not a strong swimmer, she always sticks close to her partner, Dolphin-kun, while at the beach. As a result, her seaside fun is mostly limited to playing in the sand. The reason she's digging so many holes in the sand isn't to go clam-digging — she's apparently after a magic stone said to favor the scent of shota sweat.

Flower Festival Oberon Girl

The Fairy King's Prank
race.359.bonus: 敵を倒すたびにACTゲージが+3%上昇
ACT gauge +3% each time it defeats an enemy
skill.359.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、攻撃速度[MAG,1,0]倍
魔法攻撃に変化し、スタン値を蓄積（中）
射程内の敵が受けるスタン時間+30%、スタン中の敵への与えるダメージ1.5倍

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Attack speed ×[MAG,1,0]
Attacks change to magic attacks, building up Stun (medium)
Stun duration on enemies in range +30%, damage dealt to Stunned enemies ×1.5
skill.359.name: フェアリートリック
Fairy Trick
unit.359.profile: ハロウィン仕様の魔女衣装に身を包み、いたずら心全開で現れた妖精王リュミヴェル。魔法の鞭は飾りではなく、本気のアイテムらしい。「交渉は威厳と甘さが鍵」と、お菓子の要求も忘れない。だが調子に乗ってパンプキンを爆発させたり、魔法で自爆したりと、少々空回り気味。その姿すら「演出」と言い切る、自由きままな王様。

Fairy King Lumivel, dressed in a Halloween witch outfit and bursting with mischief. Her magic whip is apparently no mere decoration, but a genuine weapon. Insisting that 'negotiation is all about dignity and sweetness,' she never forgets to demand candy. That said, she gets carried away sometimes, blowing up pumpkins or accidentally magic-bombing herself, so things tend to spin out of control a little. Even that, though, she flatly calls 'part of the performance' — a truly free-spirited king.
unit.360.title: 戯夜宴ティターニア娘
Night Festival Titania Girl

飛行して移動し、物理攻撃と魔法攻撃を40<aw>+10</aw>%の確率で回避
スキル中または<t=カースドテリトリー>カースドテリトリー</t>時、自身の射程が配置中の味方のモンスター娘1体につき3％増加する
敵に呪詛を付与した時、自身の次回のスキル準備時間を1体につき5秒短縮
スキル中、呪詛状態または暗闇の敵に対して味方全体が与えるダメージ1.3倍
呪詛：20秒間、敵の魔法防御力を40％、移動速度を80％減少させる

Flies to move, and has a 40%<aw>+10%</aw> chance to evade physical and magic attacks
While skill is active or <t=カースドテリトリー>Cursed Territory</t>, own Range increases by 3% for every 1 deployed ally monster girls
When inflicting Curse on an enemy, own next Skill Cooldown shortens by 5s per 1
While skill is active, all allies deal ×1.3 damage to Cursed or Darkened enemies

A Mischievous Night's Dream
race.360.bonus: 物理攻撃と魔法攻撃を10%の確率で回避
