攻撃時、確率で暗闇を付与し、
呪詛状態の敵は暗闇発生が超高確率に強化
skill.360.name: スプーキードール
Spooky Doll

Reduces the enemy's MDEF by 40% and Move speed by 80% for 20s
unit.360.profile: ハロウィンを統べる妖精女王、オプスカリテ。闇夜に映えるその衣装は、ただの仮装ではなく妖精たちの魔力を束ねる象徴でもある。舞踏会の支配者として、招かれた者すべてに微笑みと「お仕置き」を与えるが、本人はそれを祝福と信じて疑わない。気まぐれな「いたずら裁判」の開催も多発しており、森の住人たちは今日も震えて待つ──うれしさと怖さが半分ずつで。

Obscurite, the fairy queen who rules over Halloween. Her outfit, striking against the dark night, is not mere costume but also a symbol binding together the magical power of the fairies. As mistress of the ball, she grants a smile and a 'punishment' to every guest she invites, though she herself believes without a doubt that it's a blessing. Her capricious 'prank trials' are held frequently, and the forest's residents wait trembling once again today — half in delight, half in terror.
unit.361.title: ガンダルヴァ娘
Gandharva Girl
race.361.text:
飛行して移動する
射程内の敵の攻撃力と移動速度を20%減少
物理と魔法攻撃を40<aw>+10</aw>%で回避する

Flies to move
Reduces the ATK and Move speed of enemies in range by 20%
Evades physical and magic attacks with a 40%<aw>+10%</aw> chance
race.361.name: 天上の奏者
Celestial Musician
race.361.bonus: 物理/魔法攻撃を10%で回避する
Evades physical/magic attacks with a 10% chance
skill.361.text:
[duration]秒、射程[MAG,0,0]倍、
射程内の敵の被ダメージが15%上昇し、
射程内の味方に物理/魔法攻撃を30％の確率で回避する効果を付与する

For [duration]s, Range ×[MAG,0,0],
damage taken by enemies in range increases by 15%,
and grants allies in range a 30% chance to evade physical/magic attacks
skill.361.name: 幻惑のラーガ
Enchanting Raga
unit.361.profile: 魅惑と混沌を振りまくガンダルヴァ娘。霊薬の守護者という立場を完全に忘れたように、音楽と香りにうつつを抜かす毎日。高慢かつ飾らない言動は混乱を呼ぶが、不思議と誰も否定できない。理由は簡単。誰もが彼女の舞に、香りに、音に、もうとっくに酔わされているからだろう。なお、香りを封じた小瓶は「モテ香水」として闇市場で高騰中らしい。

Gandharva Girl, scattering enchantment and chaos wherever she goes. Seemingly having entirely forgotten her post as guardian of the elixir, she spends her days lost in music and fragrance. Her arrogant, unfiltered way of speaking causes plenty of confusion, but strangely, no one can ever bring themselves to deny her. The reason is simple: everyone's already been thoroughly intoxicated by her dance, her scent, and her music. Incidentally, small vials sealing her fragrance are apparently skyrocketing in price on the black market as a 'love potion perfume.'
unit.362.title: 世界を超える者
World Transcender
race.362.text:
近接マスに配置可能、飛行して移動する
配置時、敵からのダメージを合計5000<aw>+2000</aw>まで防ぐバリアを自身に付与
常に攻撃が敵の防御力を無視し、一定時間攻撃した敵の移動速度を下げ、攻撃後の待ち時間を増加させる

Can be deployed on melee tiles, flies to move
On deployment, grants self a Barrier that blocks up to 5000<aw>+2000</aw> total damage from enemies
Attacks always ignore the enemy's DEF, and reduce the Move speed and increase the attack cooldown of attacked enemies for a set duration
race.362.name: 異世界戦士
Warrior from Another World
race.362.bonus: 出撃時に敵からのダメージを合計2000まで防ぐバリアを自身に付与
On deployment, grants self a Barrier that blocks up to 2000 total damage from enemies
skill.362.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,5,0]倍、クリティカル率+100％、攻撃した敵の移動速度を95%減少
一度だけ超広範囲の敵8体に5連射、その後敵1体に4連射攻撃を行う

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,5,0], Crit rate +100%, reduces the Move speed of attacked enemies by 95%
Once only, fires 5 consecutive shots at 8 enemies across an extremely wide area, then 4 consecutive shots at 1 enemies
skill.362.name: 封印銃ティルナノグ
Sealing Gun Tir na nOg
unit.362.profile: 異世界からやってきた時空を超える船の操縦士兼エージェント。世界規模の災厄に対抗するため人工的に育てられた人間であり、研究所の人間を「父さまたち」と呼んでいる。かつては異変を解決する中で知り合った者の記憶を消去していたが、現在はもうその必要は無く、仲間達と交流を深めている。古代文明の超技術によって造られた『封印銃ティルナノグ』を扱う。

A pilot and agent of a ship that crosses time and space, come from another world. She is a human artificially raised to counter world-scale disasters, and calls the researchers who raised her 'Fathers.' She once erased the memories of anyone she met while resolving anomalies, but that's no longer necessary now, and she's been deepening her bonds with her comrades. She wields the 'Sealing Gun Tir na nOg,' crafted with the ultra-technology of an ancient civilization.
unit.363.title: 金華猫娘
Jinhua Cat Girl
race.363.text:
クリティカル率+20％、クリティカルダメージ+50％
物理/魔法攻撃を20<aw>+5</aw>%で回避

Crit rate +20%, Crit damage +50%
Evades physical/magic attacks with a 20%<aw>+5%</aw> chance
race.363.name: 妖惑の化猫
Bewitching Cat Spirit
race.363.bonus: 物理/魔法攻撃の回避率+5％

[duration]秒、攻撃力 [MAG,0,0]倍

Resplendent Whip

The bonus effect of being deployed on a Light element tile is ×2
unit.363.profile: 家守りの縁起物として語られる伝承を持つ金華猫娘。変化の力を使い、相手の理想に化けてからかうのが得意だが、なぜか姿はいつも子ども体型になってしまう。本人はそれが“完成形”だと信じて疑わず、むしろ自信満々。気まぐれな性格で話を最後まで聞かないことも多いが、特別な相手には甘えたがり。ミンユエ特製のジュースは笑いが止まらなくなる上、なぜか彼女の姿が見えなくなるという恐怖の副作用つき。

Jinhua Cat Girl, a figure of legend spoken of as a lucky charm for guarding homes. She's skilled at using her shapeshifting powers to transform into someone's ideal type and tease them, but for some reason, she always ends up in a childlike shape. She herself believes without a doubt that this is her 'perfect form,' and is in fact brimming with confidence about it. She's fickle by nature and often doesn't listen to the end of what people say, but she craves affection from anyone special to her. Minyue's special homemade juice leaves you unable to stop laughing, and comes with the terrifying side effect of somehow making her vanish from sight.

Hunting Soul
unit.364.profile: 宇宙をさすらう賞金稼ぎのレプティリアン娘。冷徹なハンターとして知られるが、ターゲットは「えっちな形の蛇口」「淫らに光る水晶」など、性的に歪んだオブジェも混ざっているらしい。尻尾は高性能センサーを兼ねており、熱源に過敏に反応する。そのため、ごくまれに“妙な生き物”から求愛行動を受けてしまうことも。「賞金稼ぎ七つ道具」はすべて自作で殺意高め。誰も使いこなせない凶器と化している。

Reptilian Girl, a bounty hunter wandering the cosmos. Known as a coldly ruthless huntress, though her targets apparently sometimes include sexually questionable objects, like 'a suggestively shaped faucet' or 'a crystal glowing lewdly.' Her tail also serves as a high-performance sensor, reacting hypersensitively to heat sources. As a result, on very rare occasions, she ends up on the receiving end of courtship from some 'strange creature.' Her 'Seven Tools of the Bounty Hunter' are all handmade and dangerously lethal — weapons that have become impossible for anyone else to wield.

Milues Army

unit.365.profile: 異世界からやってきた軍人。ミルエス軍という組織に所属する精鋭。文武両道で同僚や仲間達からの信頼も厚い。真面目でクールな性格だが、気苦労も多く、他人に頼るのが苦手な一面もある。同じ世界から来たラビィは幼なじみで、いつも明るく元気な彼女を信頼している。虫が大の苦手で見るだけでも震え、触ろうものなら気絶してしまうほどだという。

A soldier who came from another world, an elite member of the organization known as the Milues Army. Skilled in both scholarship and combat, she commands deep trust from her colleagues and comrades. She has a serious, cool personality, but also carries a lot of worries and has trouble relying on others. Labi, who came from the same world, is her childhood friend, and she trusts the ever-bright and energetic girl completely. She's terrified of bugs, trembling at the mere sight of one, and is said to faint outright if she ever touches one.
unit.366.title: マーシアン娘
Martian Girl

Whip of Hellfire
unit.366.profile: カセイの過酷な環境で育った孤高の観測者。生存のための知識と技術を独学で身につけ、火と共に生きる術を体得したマーシアン娘。その反動か、他者を信用せず「全部自分でやる」が口癖。しかし内心では仲間との交流に強い憧れがあり、さりげない優しさに触れると触手を震わせて喜ぶ。言葉の端々に古風な言い回しが混じるのは、翻訳機の設定が「戦国風」になっているかららしい。

A solitary observer raised in the harsh environment of Mars. Martian Girl taught herself the knowledge and skills needed to survive, mastering the art of living alongside fire. Perhaps as a reaction to that upbringing, she doesn't trust others, and 'I'll do it all myself' is her catchphrase. Deep down, though, she harbors a strong longing to connect with others, and her tentacles tremble with joy at the slightest bit of casual kindness. The old-fashioned phrasing that slips into her speech now and then is apparently because her translator is set to 'Sengoku style.'

unit.367.profile: かつて「この世の動物たちの長」と呼ばれ、病を見抜く神獣として崇められた白沢娘。その知識欲は今なお健在だが、最近の研究対象はなぜか「異種間交配の構造解析」や「快楽増幅儀式」など、性的にギリギリな領域へと偏りつつある。本人は常に真面目で、学術的好奇心から語るその口調に、悪気も羞恥も一切ない。額の第３の目には幻視の力が宿り、相手の“もっとも気にしていること”を見抜いてしまうが、それをも観察対象の記録として活用しているようだ。「知識は力なり」と信じるその姿勢に、誰かの胃はいつも冷や汗まみれである。

Once called 'the leader of all the world's animals' and revered as a divine beast able to detect illness, Hakutaku Girl still burns with the same thirst for knowledge today — but lately, her research subjects have, for some reason, been drifting into precariously sexual territory, like 'structural analysis of interspecies crossbreeding' or 'pleasure amplification rituals.' She herself is always earnest, and her tone, driven purely by academic curiosity, carries not a trace of ill intent or shame. Her 3th eye on her forehead holds the power of clairvoyance, letting her see through to whatever a person 'cares about most' — and she apparently uses even that as material for her observational records. Her conviction that 'knowledge is power' leaves everyone around her perpetually breaking out in a cold sweat.

unit.368.profile: 進化によって力もプライドもスケールアップしたブラックドラゴン娘。ソレイアの教えを忠実に守ろうとするあまり、「部下には首輪を贈るべき」「健康診断も指導者のつとめ」など、妙な方向に努力中。ご褒美と称して首輪を押し付けたり、背中に乗って忠誠心を測ったりと、やや迷惑気味な愛情表現は健在。本人は大真面目である。

Black Dragon Girl, whose power and pride have both scaled up through evolution. In her earnest effort to faithfully uphold Soleia's teachings, she's putting in effort in some rather odd directions, like 'a leader should give her subordinates collars' and 'health checkups are also a leader's duty.' She's still at it, calling it a 'reward' as she forces collars onto people, or riding on their backs to gauge their loyalty — her rather intrusive expressions of affection remain fully intact. She herself is dead serious about it all.

Silver Moon Demigod

Bastion of the War God
unit.369.profile: 異世界からやってきた銀月の亜神。普段から人類を愚か扱いしている冷徹な性格だが、それは自分が守るべき存在だと思っているがゆえの慈悲深さの裏返しでもある。ただ、それを指摘すると照れ隠しに斬ろうとしてくるので注意が必要。月の他に工芸と恋愛も司り、ゲシュペンス島ではモンスター娘たちからよく相談を受けているが、その欲望の底なしさに度肝を抜かれているようだ。

A demigod of the silver moon, come from another world. She has a coldly ruthless personality, habitually treating humanity as foolish, but that's also the flip side of a deep compassion born from seeing them as something she must protect. That said, if you point this out to her, she'll try to cut you down out of embarrassment, so caution is advised. Besides the moon, she also presides over craftsmanship and romance, and on Gespenst Island she's often approached by monster girls seeking advice — though she seems utterly stunned by the bottomless depths of their desires.
unit.370.title: ドラゴニュートプリースト娘
Dragonewt Priestess Girl

Priestess of the Flame Precept

When in the party, allied Dragon monster girls' ATK and HP +2% each

Prayer of the Fire Dragon
unit.370.profile: 火山の祠で祈りを捧げるドラゴニュートプリースト娘。クールな巫女を気取っているが、すぐに熱くなって素が出るタイプ。祈祷中でも妄想にふけり、祝詞にチファとの勝率を混ぜるほど集中力は不安定。怒ると錫杖が飛ぶが、本人いわく「神罰が下っただけ」とのこと。張り合いと反省を繰り返す、努力家の不器用さん。

Dragonewt Priestess Girl, offering prayers at a volcanic shrine. She puts on airs of being a cool shrine maiden, but she's the type to heat up quickly and let her true self show. Even mid-prayer she drifts off into daydreams, her focus so unstable that she ends up mixing her win rate against Chifa into her sacred chants. When she gets angry, her staff goes flying, though according to her, 'that's just divine punishment.' A hardworking but clumsy girl, forever cycling between rivalry and regret.
unit.371.title: ダンジョン娘
Dungeon Girl
race.371.text:
最大HPと物理防御力+50%、その代わり攻撃力-20%
ダンジョンでは更に最大HP+30％
戦闘中1度だけ、HPが0になるとHP全回復で復活
被弾時、物理防御力が10％上昇（最大20回/撤退死亡時リセット）
<aw>ブロック中の敵の攻撃力を30%減少させる</aw>

In dungeons, Max HP is further +30%
1 time(s) per battle only, fully revives with HP restored when HP reaches 0
On taking a hit, DEF increases by 10% (up to 20 times, resets on retreat or death)
<aw>Reduces the ATK of blocked enemies by 30%</aw>

Guardian of the Deepest Chamber
race.371.bonus: ブロック中の敵の攻撃力を30%減少させる
Reduces the ATK of blocked enemies by 30%

skill.371.name: ダンジョンプレベント
Dungeon Prevent
unit.371.profile: ダンジョンの最奥にたたずむ、伝説の守護者モンスター娘。聖域を守る存在としてダンジョンに長く君臨するも、誰とも戦ったことがない不戦の守護娘。理知的な外見とは裏腹に、妄想癖が深刻で「婚約」「新居設計」「夜の儀式」といった言葉が日記に踊る。しかもそれを“訓練記録”と言い張る強メンタルの持ち主。侵入者はすべてトラップによって排除されてしまうため、日々は想像と妄想で過ごしているようだ。

A legendary guardian monster girl who stands in the deepest chamber of a dungeon. She's long reigned over the dungeon as its sacred protector, yet has never actually fought anyone — a guardian who's never seen battle. Despite her intellectual appearance, she has a severe daydreaming habit, with words like 'engagement,' 'new home design,' and 'nightly rituals' scattered across her diary. What's more, she insists on calling it her 'training log,' a testament to her sheer mental fortitude. Since every intruder ends up eliminated by traps, her days are apparently spent entirely in imagination and fantasy.
unit.372.title: 天城のデーモンロード娘
Amagi Demon Lord Girl

Demon Lord Gagnolet

skill.372.name: 悪魔のラプントゥー
Demon's Raptonu
unit.372.profile: 異世界の城娘・ラピュータのコスチュームを身に着けたダムストー。憧れの銃を装備したことで、いつもよりちょっぴりテンションは高めになっている。はしゃぎっぷりを指摘すると、すぐしょんぼりしてしまうところは相変わらず。宙に浮かぶと良いアイディアが下りてくるようになったらしく、ゲーム制作に情熱を燃やしている。ちょっと発言が物騒になっているようだが、その理由は定かではない。

Damstoh, wearing the costume of the otherworldly castle girl Laputa. Having equipped the gun she's always admired, she's a little more excited than usual. Point out how giddy she's being, though, and she still immediately deflates just like always. It seems that floating in midair helps good ideas come to her, and she's now burning with passion for game development. Her remarks have gotten a bit ominous lately, though the reason for that isn't entirely clear.
unit.373.title: 北姫のシルバードラゴン娘
Northern Princess Silver Dragon Girl
race.373.text:
攻撃力+30％、常に魔法攻撃になる
クリティカル率+20<aw>+5</aw>％、クリティカルダメージ+40<aw>+10</aw>％
攻撃した敵を一定確率で凍結させる
凍結状態の敵へ与えるダメージ1.3倍
射程内の味方の毒・スタン・火傷状態を即座に回復する

ATK +30%, attacks always become magic element
Crit rate +20<aw>+5</aw>%, Crit damage +40<aw>+10</aw>%
Has a set chance to inflict Freeze on attacked enemies
Damage dealt to Frozen enemies ×1.3
Instantly cures Poison, Stun, and Burn on allies in range
race.373.name: 聖銀のプリンセス
Princess of Sacred Silver
race.373.bonus: クリティカル率+5％、クリティカルダメージ+10％
skill.373.text:
スキル発動時、1度だけ周囲の敵を凍結させる
その後、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍で敵1体に、5連続の遠距離攻撃を行う
中確率で敵を即死させる

On skill activation, 1 time(s) only, inflicts Freeze on nearby enemies
Then performs 5 consecutive ranged attacks against 1 enemies at ATK ×[MAG,0,0]
Has a moderate chance to instantly kill the enemy
skill.373.name: 魔剣フラガラッハ
Demon Blade Fragarach
unit.373.profile: 異世界の王女・シビラのコスチュームを身につけた、シルバードラゴン娘。この服を纏うと勇気に満たされ、見事な剣術を扱えるようになる他、大好きな相手と共に建国したくなる意欲が溢れ出すらしい。元々好きだった人間の研究に加え、良い国家運営のための妃教育も独学で頑張っているらしい。

Silver Dragon Girl, wearing the costume of the otherworldly princess Sibylla. Wearing this outfit fills her with courage, letting her wield masterful swordsmanship, and apparently overflows her with the desire to found a nation together with the one she loves most. On top of her original passion for studying humans, she's apparently also working hard, entirely self-taught, to learn the education befitting a queen for good statecraft.
unit.374.title: 慈雨のプリンシパリティ娘
Gentle Rain Principality Girl
race.374.text:
飛行して移動、敵撃破時にコスト+3
射程内の敵の攻撃力を20<aw>+10</aw>％減少
配置時、自身配置マスと射程内のランダム3マスを闇属性に変更する
スキル中、射程内の味方のスタン・暗闇無効化

Flies to move, Cost +3 on kill
Reduces the ATK of enemies in range by 20%<aw>+10%</aw>
On deployment, changes her own tile and 3 random tiles in range into Dark element tiles
While skill is active, nullifies Stun and Darkness on allies in range
race.374.name: 雷嵐の番人
Watcher of the Thunderstorm
race.374.bonus: 射程内の敵の攻撃力を10％減少
Reduces the ATK of enemies in range by 10%
skill.374.text:
効果時間無限（移動・撤退・死亡で解除）
攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍、攻撃対象数+2
自身が闇属性マス配置中、与えるダメージ1.3倍

Unlimited duration (ends on move, retreat, or death)
ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0], targets +2
While deployed on a Dark element tile, damage dealt ×1.3
skill.374.name: 慈悲の嵐雨
Merciful Storm Rain
unit.374.profile: 異世界の亜神・アスバールのコスチュームを身につけた、プリンシパリティ娘。嵐雨を操る力を手に入れた。元々愛されることこそ至高という考えだった彼女だが、豊穣を司る神の影響を受け、愛し合うことで愛を育むこともまた価値を持つと考えるようになった。漆黒の翼を持つことから周囲には堕天したと勘違いされることも多いが彼女自身は否定している。積極性が以前より増したらしく、たまに冗談を言って周囲をからかうことが増えた。

Principality Girl, wearing the costume of the otherworldly demigod Asbahl, gaining the power to control storm and rain. She once believed that being loved was the highest ideal of all, but under the influence of a god of fertility, she's come to believe that nurturing love through mutual affection also holds its own value. Because she now has jet-black wings, people around her often mistake her for having fallen, though she herself denies it. She's apparently grown more proactive than before, and has started cracking the occasional joke to tease those around her.
unit.375.title: 煽怒のニーズホッグ娘
Wrathful Nidhogg Girl
race.375.text:
編成時、全モンスター娘の攻撃力+7<aw>+3</aw>%、自身の最大HPｰ15％
攻撃対象数+2、毒・火傷無効
配置中、毒か火傷状態のいずれかの敵の移動速度を30%減少
毒か火傷状態のいずれかの敵に与えるダメージ1.3倍

When in the party, all monster girls' ATK +7<aw>+3</aw>%, own Max HP -15%
Targets +2, immune to Poison and Burn
While deployed, reduces the Move speed of enemies with either Poison or Burn by 30%
Damage dealt to enemies with either Poison or Burn ×1.3
race.375.name: 邪呪の城塞
Fortress of the Evil Curse
race.375.bonus: 編成時、全モンスター娘の攻撃力+3%
When in the party, all monster girls' ATK +3%
skill.375.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、3連射の遠距離攻撃を行う
攻撃時、高確率で猛毒・火傷を付与する
スキル中HPが0にならない

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], performs 3 consecutive ranged shots
On attack, has a high chance to inflict Deadly Poison and Burn
HP cannot reach 0 while skill is active
skill.375.name: 堕天の崇毒
Fallen Venom of Worship
unit.375.profile: 異世界の城娘・ディーテのコスチュームを身につけた、獣神ニーズホッグ娘。地獄の炎を操る力で、今日もショタを怒らせようと奮闘している。サディスティックな性格もより強くなっており、うっかり火加減を間違えてしまうこともしばしば起こる。ショタをマジオコさせるためであれば意外と努力を惜しまず、周りのモンスター娘たちに炎の扱い方やショタの弱点を聞き回っている。

The beast god Nidhogg Girl, wearing the costume of the otherworldly castle girl Dite. Wielding the power to control hellfire, she's hard at work today too, trying to make some shota boy genuinely angry. Her sadistic streak has grown even stronger, and she often ends up accidentally misjudging her fire's intensity. When it comes to making a shota truly furious, she surprisingly spares no effort, going around asking the other monster girls how to handle flames and what shota boys' weak points are.
unit.376.title: プシュキニア娘
Puschkinia Girl
race.376.text:
攻撃力+20％、魔法防御力+200％、出撃コスト+3
常に魔法ダメージを35<aw>+10</aw>％軽減する、スキル中は軽減効果が倍化
凍結状態の敵への与えるダメージが1.3倍

ATK +20%, MDEF +200%, Deploy cost +3
Always reduces magic damage taken by 35%<aw>+10%</aw>; while skill is active, the reduction doubles
Damage dealt to Frozen enemies ×1.3
race.376.name: 帝国最終兵器プシュキニア
Imperial Ultimate Weapon Puschkinia
race.376.bonus: 常に魔法ダメージを10％軽減する
Always reduces magic damage taken by 10%
skill.376.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、攻撃回数が1回になり、攻撃時に相手を中確率で凍結状態にする
周囲の敵に攻撃力200%分の魔法攻撃を行い、さらに広範囲の敵５体に魔法の氷柱を落とす

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], attack count becomes 1, and on attack has a moderate chance to inflict Freeze on the target
Performs a magic attack equal to 200% of ATK against nearby enemies, and also drops magic icicles on 5 enemies across a wide area
skill.376.name: フロストバーン
Frostburn
unit.376.profile: 古くより樹氷宮殿を守護してきたゴーレム「プシュキニア」だったモンスター娘。普段は帝国の第４皇女カティナに従い、獣神ビッキーヌをママと呼び慕っている。生命の尊さに疎いが、せっかく受肉したからには学んでいきたいと思っており、ゲシュペンス島に来てからは散歩が日課になった。自身のビットに「プシュ」と「キニア」と名前をつけ、相棒として信頼しつつ、大切に可愛がっている。

A monster girl who was once the golem 'Puschkinia,' long guarding the ice-tree palace. She normally serves the empire's 4th princess, Katina, and fondly calls the beast god Bikkinu 'Mama.' She's not well-versed in the preciousness of life, but now that she's finally taken physical form, she wants to learn about it, and taking walks has become a daily habit since coming to Gespenst Island. She's named her own bits 'Push' and 'Kinia,' trusting them as her partners while cherishing and adoring them dearly.
unit.377.title: トゥルーヴァンパイア娘
True Vampire Girl
race.377.text:
ワープして移動するが、移動コスト+<naw>5</naw><aw>3</aw>
配置人数に含まれないが、配置後30秒後に死亡する
移動してもスキルが解除されない
スキル中はブロック数が0になり、遠距離攻撃の対象にならない
スキルを使用するたびに、次回スキル中に与えるダメージが上昇（最大3倍・2回/死亡撤退後も継続）
敵撃破時にコスト+2

Warps to move, but Move cost +<naw>5</naw><aw>3</aw>
Does not count toward the deployment limit, but dies 30s after being deployed
Moving does not cancel the skill
While skill is active, Block becomes 0 and cannot be targeted by ranged attacks
Each time the skill is used, damage dealt during the next skill activation increases (up to ×3, 2 times, persisting even after death or retreat)
On kill, Cost +2
race.377.name: 至純のノスフェラトゥ
Nosferatu of Purest Blood
skill.377.text:
[duration]秒、広範囲の敵10体に[MAG,4,0]連続攻撃を行う
攻撃時、自身の攻撃力が5秒間6%上昇

For [duration]s, performs [MAG,4,0] consecutive attacks against 10 enemies across a wide area
On attack, own ATK increases by 6% for 5s
skill.377.name: ブラッドクライ
Blood Cry
weapon.377.name: ブラッディネイル
Bloody Nail
weapon.377.text: 再出撃時間が50%短縮、自身が死亡時に周囲の敵を5秒停止させる
Redeploy time -50%; on death, stops the movement of nearby enemies for 5s
unit.377.profile: 真なるヴァンパイア娘へ進化を遂げ、女王として君臨する気満々のヴェラートゥ。だが「儀式には接触が必要よ？」と勝手に布団へ潜り込んだり、「お前専用の眷属契約」と称してカクテルを作ったりと、発想がズレている。血よりスキンシップの方が多いあたり、支配と甘やかしの区別が曖昧なようだ。

Verato, who evolved into a true Vampire Girl and is fully intent on reigning as queen. However, her ideas are a bit off — sneaking into someone's futon uninvited, saying 'the ritual requires physical contact, you know?', or mixing up a cocktail she calls 'a servant contract made just for you.' Given how much more physical affection there is than actual bloodsucking, the line between dominance and spoiling seems pretty blurry for her.
unit.378.title: シーサーペント娘
Sea Serpent Girl
race.378.text:
物理/魔法攻撃を20<aw>+10</aw>%で回避、水属性マス配置時は確率倍化
攻撃した敵の攻撃後の待ち時間を一定時間30％増加させる
スキル発動中、自身を水属性マス配置中の状態にし、
さらに、射程内の味方のHPを1秒毎に対象の最大HP3％分回復

Evades physical/magic attacks with a 20%<aw>+10%</aw> chance; the chance doubles when deployed on a Water element tile
Increases the attack cooldown of attacked enemies by 30% for a set duration
While skill is active, treats herself as deployed on a Water element tile,
and also heals allies in range for 3% of their Max HP every 1s
race.378.name: 深淵の大海蛇
Great Sea Serpent of the Abyss
race.378.bonus: 物理/魔法攻撃を10%で回避
Evades physical/magic attacks with a 10% chance
skill.378.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
攻撃着弾地点に渦潮が発生し持続物理ダメージを与え、移動速度を大きく減少させる
持続ダメージは発動時の攻撃力の18%

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Creates a whirlpool at the point of impact that deals continuous physical damage and greatly reduces Move speed
Continuous damage is 18% of ATK at activation
skill.378.name: アビスストーム
Abyss Storm
unit.378.profile: 海の底に潜み、めったなことでは人前に姿を現さないモンスター娘。１日の多くの時間を海底の洞窟で過ごし、妄想にふけっている。特技は質感までも再現する蜃気楼を生み出せることで、美少年のアレを蜃気楼で生み出そうとした結果、七つの頭をもつ巨大蛇を生み出してしまい、ゲシュペンス島近海を騒がさせた。何かは知らないが、特別なモノの１級鑑定士らしい。

A monster girl who lurks at the bottom of the sea, rarely showing herself in front of others. She spends most of her day in an underwater cave, lost in fantasy. Her specialty is creating mirages so vivid they even reproduce texture — and when she tried to conjure a certain part of a handsome boy with one, she accidentally created a giant seven-headed serpent instead, causing an uproar in the waters near Gespenst Island. Whatever it is exactly, she's apparently a first-class appraiser of a certain special something.
unit.379.title: 冒険者
Adventurer
race.379.text:
非スキル中は、攻撃時に40<aw>+10</aw>%の確率で2連撃の追加攻撃が発生
非スキル中の追加攻撃とスキル中の与えるダメージが1.2倍
自身が敵撃破時にスキル準備時間を4秒短縮する
自身のHPが50%以下の時、自身のHPを毎秒3%回復

While not skilling, attacks have a 40%<aw>+10%</aw> chance to trigger 2 additional consecutive hits
Damage dealt by additional attacks while not skilling, and damage dealt while skilling, ×1.2
On kill, shortens Skill Cooldown by 4s
When own HP is 50% or below, recovers 3% of own HP each second
race.379.name: コンビネーション
Combination
race.379.bonus: 通常攻撃・追加攻撃時に10％で追加攻撃が発生し、最大4連撃
On normal and additional attacks, has a 10% chance to trigger another additional attack, up to 4 hits in succession
skill.379.text:
スキル発動時、1度だけ攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍で周囲の敵に4連続攻撃
攻撃中は敵の攻撃を全て回避

On skill activation, 1 time(s) only, attacks nearby enemies 4 times in succession at ATK ×[MAG,0,0]
Evades all enemy attacks while attacking
skill.379.name: フルコンボ
Full Combo
weapon.379.name: ラビィのグローブ
Labi's Gloves
weapon.379.text: 自身の攻撃で敵撃破時に攻撃速度が5%増加（最大20回/死亡撤退後も継続）
On kill by own attack, Attack speed increases by 5% (up to 20 times, persisting even after death or retreat)
unit.379.profile: 異世界からやってきた人間の冒険者。ベーレテリアという国に住み、「なんでも屋」として依頼を受けて生計を立てつつ、マナと呼ばれるエネルギーを集めている。いつも明るく楽観的な性格で、鍵のついた扉は蹴って壊す豪快な少女だが、綺麗な宝石が好きで料理が得意など女の子らしい一面もある。胸が薄く足が太いことをちょっとだけ気にしているらしい。

A human adventurer who came from another world. Living in a country called Beleteria, she makes her living taking odd jobs as a 'jack of all trades' while gathering energy known as mana. Always bright and optimistic, she's the bold type who'll just kick down a locked door — but she also has her girlish sides, like a love of pretty gems and a talent for cooking. She's apparently a little bothered by her flat chest and thick legs.
unit.380.title: 夜魔
Night Demon
race.380.text:
自身が敵撃破時、まれにスキル準備時間を全て解消する
射程内の敵の攻撃力を自身の基本攻撃力の50<aw>+10</aw>%分減少させる

On kill, rarely clears the Skill Cooldown entirely
Reduces the ATK of enemies in range by 50%<aw>+10%</aw> of own base ATK
race.380.name: クイックキャスト
Quick Cast
race.380.bonus: 射程内の敵の攻撃力を自身攻撃力の10％分減少させる
Reduces the ATK of enemies in range by 10% of own ATK
skill.380.text: スキル発動時、1度だけ攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍で射程内の敵3体に攻撃し、ダメージと共に対象の現在ＨＰ5%の追加ダメージが発生
On skill activation, 1 time(s) only, attacks 3 enemies in range at ATK ×[MAG,0,0], dealing additional damage equal to 5% of the target's current HP along with the attack
skill.380.name: バーニングフレア
Burning Flare
weapon.380.name: フォースロッド
Force Rod
weapon.380.text: スキル発動後、15秒攻撃力+40％
unit.380.profile: ベーレテリアの中心街ヘイヴェンで「なんでも屋」のお手伝いをする夜魔の娘。大人しくて何を考えているのかわかりづらいが、実は甘えん坊な末っ子気質。助けてくれたラビィに心を許し、今では共に暮らし、姉のような存在として慕っている。思ったことはちゃんと口に出すタイプで、正直すぎることも。夜魔としての本能と、恋する乙女としての愛らしさを併せ持つ、ちょっと不思議な魅力の持ち主。

A Night Demon girl who helps out at the 'jack of all trades' shop in Haven, the central town of Beleteria. Quiet and hard to read, she's actually got a spoiled youngest-child streak underneath. She opened her heart to Labi, who saved her, and now lives together with her, looking up to her like an older sister. She's the type who speaks her mind honestly — sometimes a little too honestly. Possessing both the instincts of a Night Demon and the adorable charm of a girl in love, she has a strange, alluring appeal all her own.
unit.381.title: 吸血鬼
Bloodsucker
race.381.text:
配置時に最大HPが2倍に上昇し、その後現在HPが50％まで減少
配置中、現在HPの10<aw>+2</aw>％分攻撃力が上昇する
攻撃時に自身のHPを、自身の基本攻撃力の50％分回復

On deployment, Max HP rises to ×2, then current HP decreases to 50%
While deployed, ATK increases by 10%<aw>+2%</aw> of current HP
On attack, restores own HP by 50% of own base ATK
race.381.name: 血の魔術
Blood Magic
race.381.bonus: 配置中、現在HPの2％分攻撃力が上昇する
While deployed, ATK increases by 2% of current HP
skill.381.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,3,0]倍、攻撃速度が上昇
発動時に周囲の敵に攻撃力500%のダメージを与えるが、自身の現在HP50%分のダメージを受ける

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,3,0], Attack speed increases
On activation, deals damage equal to 500% of ATK to nearby enemies, but takes damage equal to 50% of own current HP
skill.381.name: ブリオンの秘術
Secret Art of Brion
weapon.381.name: ソウルリーパー
Soul Reaper
weapon.381.text: HPが50%以上の時、与えるダメージ1.2倍
When HP is 50% or above, damage dealt ×1.2
unit.381.profile: 影の城ディア・ブリオンの主にして、ラーヴィンでも屈指の魔力を誇る吸血鬼。自ら生み出す紅月の下、気高く尊大なその振る舞いは、まさに孤高の支配者。だが一度信を預けた者には、言葉にせずとも深い慈愛を注ぐ。強さと優しさを内包した誇り高き存在。強者として恐れられる存在でありながら、砂糖たっぷりの紅茶を好み、誰かの世話なしには生活がままならない一面もあるようだ。

Mistress of the shadow castle Dea Brion, and a vampire boasting some of the greatest magical power in Ravin. Beneath the crimson moon of her own making, her noble and haughty bearing is that of a truly solitary ruler. Yet to anyone she's chosen to trust, she pours out deep affection, even without ever saying so in words. A proud being who holds both strength and kindness within her. Despite being feared as a powerhouse, she has a fondness for sugar-laden tea, and apparently can barely manage her daily life without someone looking after her.
unit.382.title: 戯灯瓜ジャックランタン娘
Festive Jack-o'-Lantern Girl
race.382.text:
<t=いたずらカボチャトークン>いたずらカボチャトークン</t>を使役<aw>、トークン所持数+1</aw>
火属性マスに配置中、敵の遠距離攻撃の対象にならない
低確率で攻撃した相手を<t=火傷>火傷</t>状態にする
呪詛：10秒間、火傷耐性が40%減少

Commands <t=いたずらカボチャトークン>Mischief Pumpkin Token</t><aw>, Token capacity +1</aw>
While deployed on a Fire element tile, cannot be targeted by enemy ranged attacks
Has a low chance to inflict <t=火傷>Burn</t> on the attacked target
Curse: reduces Burn resistance by 40% for 10s
race.382.name: 悪戯好きの火妖
Mischievous Fire Spirit
skill.382.text:
[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍

unit.382.profile: 「ハロウィンといえばあたしだよねぇ～」と気合を入れているジャックランタン娘。相棒のカボチャくんと共に、夜になると島中にイタズラを仕込んで周っている。気だるげなところは相変わらずだが、「イタズラして喜ばれるならがんばらないとねぇ～」とムダなヤル気をみせているようだ。

Jack-o'-Lantern Girl, psyching herself up with 'Halloween's totally my thing, y'know~.' Together with her partner Pumpkin-kun, she goes around setting up pranks all over the island once night falls. Her languid attitude remains as ever, but she seems to show a pointless burst of motivation, saying, 'Well, if pulling pranks makes people happy, guess I gotta try my best~.'

Queen Requiem
unit.383.profile: 支配と創作を両立するトロールクィーン娘。従者に囲まれた生活の傍ら、趣味で作るぬいぐるみは“呪い”と“愛”が同居する芸術品。気まぐれに作った人形がモンスター娘そっくりだった、なんて噂も。ドロドロの恋模様を描く、ロイエの人形劇には目がないらしい。意地悪な微笑みと、針のように鋭い観察眼で、今日も心の奥を縫い上げる。

A Troll Queen Girl who balances dominance with creativity. Surrounded by attendants in her daily life, the stuffed dolls she makes as a hobby are works of art where 'curse' and 'love' coexist. Rumor has it that a doll she made on a whim looked just like a real monster girl. She apparently can't get enough of Loie's puppet shows, which depict tangled, messy romances. With a mischievous smile and an observation as sharp as a needle, today too she stitches together the depths of the heart.

unit.384.profile: 鯨のような大きな胴体に犬の耳を持ち、2つに分かれた尾ビレを持つケートス娘。海のおねショタ警察であり、獣神ファロルーチェの命によって、深海の美少年を保護するために、ひとりで海を探し回っていた。当然ながら深海に住む美少年はいなかったが、代わりに死んだ美少年の魂と交流し、来世に運ぶ役割を得ている。テルルとはおねショタ警察の隊長の座をかけて「わんワン」言い争っていた過去があるらしい。海を捜査する際にはおねショタ警察の全員を背中に乗せるらしいが、乗り心地はよくないようだ。

A Cetus Girl with a whale-like large body, dog ears, and a tail fin split into 2 parts. She is a member of the Onee-Shota Police, and by order of the Beast God Farolucce, she was searching the sea alone to protect a beautiful boy from the deep sea. Naturally, no beautiful boy lived in the deep sea, but instead she came to interact with the souls of boys who had passed away, and took on the role of carrying them to their next life. It seems she once had a 'bow-wow' argument with Tellur over who would be captain of the Onee-Shota Police. When investigating the sea, she apparently carries the whole Onee-Shota Police on her back, though the ride doesn't seem very comfortable.

Sea Giant Girl

Ocean Burst
unit.385.profile: 創造のフロストジャイアント娘、破壊のファイアジャイアント娘に対し、秩序を司るシージャイアント娘。争いを嫌い穏やかだが、秩序を乱す物は徹底的に没収する秩序信者。その口癖は「ジャイアントギルティ！」。主人公にはとことん甘く、「ダメ男が好きそう」と噂される始末。没収したエロ本を盗み読みし、水中正座で自罰する律儀さも併せ持つ。アイレン、リーファーと共に風紀向上委員会を結成し、今日も島の風紀を守っている。

Where the Frost Giant Girl governs creation and the Fire Giant Girl governs destruction, the Sea Giant Girl governs order. She dislikes conflict and is calm by nature, but is a devoted believer in order who thoroughly confiscates anything that disrupts it. Her catchphrase is 'Giant Guilty!' She is endlessly soft on the protagonist, to the point that people whisper she 'probably likes no-good men.' She also has the honest streak of secretly reading the confiscated adult magazines and then punishing herself by sitting seiza underwater. Together with Aileen and Reefer, she formed the Public Morals Improvement Committee, and today too she protects the island's public morals.

unit.386.profile: 遠い惑星から来たマーシアン娘。無表情でクールな態度の裏には、マルゼアへの異常な執着心を隠している。観察の名目で何千時間もマルゼアの行動を記録し、その膨大なデータには彼女自身の偏愛が色濃く滲む。マルゼアの好物であるスキュウを真似して食べるうちにクセになり、自らも好んで口にするようになったらしい。驚いた時に思わず漏れる「スキャッパッ！」 は、その長年の模倣の賜物だ。

A Martian Girl who came from a distant planet. Behind her expressionless, cool demeanor, she hides an abnormal obsession with Marzea. Under the pretext of observation, she has recorded Marzea's behavior for thousands of hours, and the massive amount of data is steeped in her own deep infatuation. She apparently became hooked on imitating Marzea by eating Marzea's favorite food, Skew, until she came to enjoy eating it herself. The 'Skyapa!' that slips out of her when she's startled is the fruit of that long imitation.

unit.387.profile: 聖夜にサンタ服をまとった雪女娘。ケダモノたちを一網打尽にするため、カタパルトを持ち出してきた。男嫌いは多少落ち着き、少し言動が柔らかくなっている。気に入ったひとにプレゼントするために作ったという『サンタ雪女娘人形』は、細部に至るまで本人とそっくりらしい。

A Yuki-onna Girl dressed in a Santa outfit for the holy night. She has brought out a catapult to round up all the beasts in one sweep. Her dislike of men has calmed down a little, and her words and actions have softened somewhat. The 'Santa Yuki-onna Doll' she made as a gift for someone she likes is apparently a spitting image of her, down to the smallest detail.

unit.388.profile: 誇り高く他者を自然に見下す鉄扇公主娘。優雅で気品に満ちた立ち居振る舞いの奥には、極めて残忍で好戦的な本性を秘めており、一度敵と認定した相手には徹底的な破滅を与える。その反面、愛する義理の息子や最愛の娘には頬を緩ませ、激甘な一面を惜しみなく見せる。芭蕉扇をひらりと揺らし、気まぐれに風を起こして周囲を振り回すのが密かな愉しみらしい。趣味はお茶をたしなむことで、その優雅な時間を邪魔する者には誰であれ容赦はない。

A proud Princess Iron Fan Girl who naturally looks down on others. Behind her graceful, dignified bearing lies an extremely brutal and combative true nature, and anyone she once marks as an enemy is given utter ruin. On the other hand, she softens for her beloved stepson and her dearest daughter, showing an unabashedly doting side. Her secret pleasure seems to be giving her Banana Leaf Fan a light wave, whimsically stirring up winds to toss everyone around. Her hobby is enjoying tea, and she shows no mercy to anyone who disturbs that elegant time.

unit.389.profile: 忠誠を尽くし祈り続けた末に聖なる力を得て進化したホーリースケルトン娘。フロストジャイアント娘に踏みつけられても欠けないほどの堅牢な骨と、邪悪なアンデッドを天へ送り返す聖剣技をその手にした。進化後は短時間だけ人間の姿に戻ることができ、主の寝室へ忍び込んでは蚊取り線香代わりに蚊を退治し、音痴な子守唄で眠りを誘う。忠義一途で尽くしすぎるその姿は、聖母ならぬ聖骨と言われているとか言われていないとか。

A Holy Skeleton Girl who, after devoting herself to unwavering loyalty and prayer, gained sacred power and evolved. She now wields bones so sturdy they wouldn't chip even if a Frost Giant Girl stepped on them, and a holy sword technique that sends wicked Undead back to the heavens. After evolving, she can return to human form for a short time, sneaking into her master's bedroom to exterminate mosquitoes in place of a mosquito coil, and lulling him to sleep with a tone-deaf lullaby. Her single-minded devotion, serving to excess, has supposedly earned her the nickname 'Holy Bones' instead of 'Holy Mother' — or so it's said, or maybe not.

unit.390.profile: 夜更かしをしても文句を言われない、との理由でサンタになった怠け者のネメアレオ娘。いつもの剣と盾を寝床に置き、代わりに中遠距離で攻撃ができる杖を振るう。接近されても杖で殴ればいいやと考えているようだ。降雪後の星空を、彼女は毎晩楽しみにしている。ちなみに、サンタの仕事は一切していない。

A lazy Nemean Lion Girl who became a Santa for the sole reason that no one complains if she stays up late. She's left her usual sword and shield by her bed and instead wields a staff that lets her attack at mid-to-long range. She seems to figure that if enemies close in, she can just hit them with the staff. Every night she looks forward to the starry sky after the snow falls. Incidentally, she hasn't done a single bit of Santa's work.

unit.391.profile: 宇宙からやってきた、冷酷で残虐な賞金稼ぎのレプティリアン娘。自身も賞金首として指名手配されている。血に塗れた手で握る弓は、長年改造してきた愛用の武器だ。獲物を射貫くために隠密行動をすることが多いからか、言葉数が少ない。そんな彼女だが、宇宙伝説と名付けた武勇伝をするときは、おしゃべりになる。夜な夜な、お手製のはく製コレクションを眺めてはニヤついているらしい。

A cold, ruthless bounty hunter Reptilian Girl who came from space. She herself is also a wanted criminal with a bounty on her head. The bow gripped in her blood-stained hands is her beloved weapon, modified over many years. Perhaps because she often moves stealthily to pierce her prey, she's a woman of few words. That said, she becomes quite chatty when telling the heroic tales she calls her 'Space Legends.' Night after night, she apparently grins to herself while gazing at her handmade taxidermy collection.
unit.392.title: 黒猪精娘
Black Boar Spirit Girl

unit.392.profile: 美食と美酒、美少年を追究する妖怪系モンスター娘。好物を発見すると「ブヒャッハー！」と叫びながら猪突猛進。武芸の心得があるので、猛進すると誰にも止められないようだ。かつては高位の将軍だったらしいが、宴会の席での失態から地位を失ってしまったらしい。特技は大食いと泳ぎとブーイング。口説く際には、下心がにじみ出てしまい、おじさん構文になってしまうようだ。

A Yokai-type monster girl who pursues fine food, fine drink, and beautiful boys. When she finds something she likes, she charges ahead recklessly while shouting 'Buhyahhaa!' Since she has training in the martial arts, once she charges no one can stop her. She was apparently once a high-ranking general, but seems to have lost her position after some blunder at a banquet. Her specialties are big eating, swimming, and booing. When she tries to woo someone, her ulterior motives show through so obviously that she ends up sounding like a sleazy old man.

New Year's Omen Kirin Girl

unit.393.profile: 晴れ着姿で新年の運勢を占う麒麟娘。その占いは「夢に濡れると吉」「縄が絡むと大吉」など、どこか意味深で聞く者を惑わす。本人は真剣そのものだが、言葉の選び方が致命的にズレているため、毎年妙な誤解を抱く者が続出中。もっとも、瑞気をまとう彼女の傍にいれば、どんな誤解も幸福に変わる……はずである。

A Kirin Girl in festive New Year's attire who tells fortunes for the year ahead. Her fortunes, like 'getting wet in a dream is good luck' or 'tangled rope is great luck,' are oddly suggestive and leave listeners puzzled. She herself is completely serious, but her fatally poor choice of words means a growing number of people end up with strange misunderstandings every year. Still, staying by her side, wrapped as she is in an aura of good fortune, should turn any misunderstanding into happiness... probably.
unit.394.title: 賀春のコボルト娘
New Year's Kobold Girl

weapon.394.name: バウバウアックス

unit.394.profile: 晴れ着姿で新年も忙しく駆け回るコボルト娘。年明け早々から鼻をひくつかせ、島の各地に漂う“幸福の香り”を追いかけている。落ち着きのないその姿も、島の者たちにとってはすっかり正月の風物詩。今日も彼女の足音が、ゲシュペンス島に元気を運んでいる。

A Kobold Girl in festive New Year's attire, busily running around even at New Year's. From the very start of the year she twitches her nose, chasing the 'scent of happiness' drifting across the island. Her restless energy has become a fixture of the New Year's season for the island's residents. Today too, the sound of her footsteps carries energy across Gespenst Island.

unit.395.profile: 元々は天界の役人であり、天帝の御側役のひとりだったというモンスター娘。普段はクールで寡黙な性格だが、どこか抜けている部分があり、ちょっとしたドジをやらかしがち。特定の人物がそばにいると、ほぼ１００パーセントの確率でラッキースケベが発生するらしい。器の割れる音や「滑る」「落ちる」といった言葉が苦手で、強い拒否反応を示す。どこに行くにも御簾を携帯しているらしく、いつでも使用できるように備えているようだ。

A monster girl said to have originally been a celestial official, one of the Heavenly Emperor's personal attendants. She's usually cool and taciturn, but has an absent-minded streak and tends to make little blunders. When a certain person is nearby, it seems a lucky perverted accident occurs with almost 100% probability. She's bad with the sound of breaking dishes and words like 'slip' or 'fall,' showing a strong aversion to them. She apparently carries a bamboo blind wherever she goes, always ready to use it at a moment's notice.

unit.396.profile: 下僕たちに作らせた、深紅の衣装をまとうゴブリン娘。いつものものから、下僕たちに贈られた聖夜仕様の霊枝に持ち替えている。彼女が開催するパーティも、下僕たちが全て準備をした。そんな従順な下僕たちが喜ぶプレゼントを、サンタクロースな彼女は熟考している。熟考した結果、プレゼントするのは結局、足の裏になるようだ。

A Goblin Girl dressed in a crimson outfit made for her by her servants. She's swapped her usual staff for a holy-night version, a gift from her servants. The party she's hosting was also entirely prepared by her servants. As a Santa Claus of sorts, she's deep in thought about what present would please her obedient servants. After much deliberation, it seems the gift she'll be giving in the end is the sole of her foot.

unit.397.profile: 大きな翼と鋭い爪を備え、雷を自在に操る力を持つ雷震子娘。物語に登場する主役のような口調で喋り、豪快に笑う。その手には師匠から貰い受けた『金棍』が握られている。金棍と共に雷を振るい、天を駆ける姿はまさにヒーロー。口調は物語のヒーローを真似ているが、素の性格は、子だくさんを夢見る乙女という噂がある。

A Leizhenzi Girl with great wings and sharp claws, wielding the power to freely command lightning. She speaks like the protagonist of a story and laughs boisterously. In her hand she grips the 'Vajra Rod' given to her by her master. Wielding lightning together with the Vajra Rod, her figure racing across the heavens is truly heroic. Though her speech imitates the heroes of legend, rumor has it that at heart she's a maiden who dreams of having many children.

unit.398.profile: 好きな初夢を求めて眠り続け、気づけば周囲を潰してしまうストーンゴーレム娘。晴れ着姿でも重量は変わらず、抱き上げようとした者が次々とぺしゃんこになるのはお約束。新年の縁起物というより、新年早々の珍事担当である。だが、寄り添って眠ればよい初夢が見られると噂され、参拝者が後を絶たない。

A Stone Golem Girl who keeps sleeping in search of a good first dream of the year, only to find she's crushed everything around her. Her weight doesn't change even in festive attire, and anyone who tries to pick her up is guaranteed to end up flattened, one after another. Rather than a New Year's good-luck charm, she's more in charge of New Year's oddities. Still, it's rumored that sleeping close to her brings a good first dream, so worshippers keep coming without end.
unit.399.title: 初灯の槌の子娘
New Year's Tsuchinoko Girl

unit.399.profile: コタツを神具と崇める、異端のツチノコ巫女。新年の森でコタツに入り、スルメとお酒を供えて『福呼びの儀』を執り行うのが恒例行事。気づけば式神も参列し、全員で寝正月。結果として、森一帯に妙に温かい気流が発生し、参拝者たちはつい昼寝してしまうという。怠惰と福を同時に招く、ぐうたら界きっての守護巫女である。

A heretical Tsuchinoko shrine maiden who worships the kotatsu as a sacred implement. It's an annual tradition for her to sit in her kotatsu in the New Year's forest, offering dried squid and sake as she performs the 'Rite of Beckoning Fortune.' Before she knows it, her shikigami have joined in too, and everyone ends up dozing the New Year away together. As a result, a strangely warm current of air spreads through the forest, and worshippers can't help but fall asleep too. She is the foremost guardian shrine maiden of the lazy world, inviting both idleness and good fortune at once.
unit.400.title: 甘断斧ヴォーパルビースト娘

When an enemy this unit is blocking dies, recovers 50% of Max HP
unit.400.profile: バレンタイン限定仕様のヴォーパルビースト娘。うさ耳リボンにチョコ色コーデで、見た目は甘く中身は物騒。愛をこめて手作りしたチョコは、うなじ型・首輪型・ギロチン型の三本立て。本人いわく“気持ちがこもってるほど刃が通りやすい”らしい。恋も首もまとめて落とす、ある意味いちばん情熱的なバレンタイン職人である。

A Valentine's-limited Vorpal Beast Girl. With bunny-ear ribbons and a chocolate-colored outfit, she looks sweet but is dangerous underneath. The chocolates she handmade with love come in three varieties: nape-shaped, collar-shaped, and guillotine-shaped. According to her, 'the more feeling that's put into it, the easier the blade goes through.' Taking down both hearts and heads at once, she is, in a sense, the most passionate Valentine's artisan of all.
unit.401.title: 甘創のホワイトラビット娘
Sweets-Crafting White Rabbit Girl
race.401.text:
移動速度と攻撃速度増加、攻撃間隔減少
敵撃破時に自身射程内の敵の移動速度を大きく減少する

unit.401.profile: 甘い香りをまとうホワイトラビット娘。真剣な顔で計量スプーンを握りしめる姿は、まるで戦場の指揮官……ただし目的は“チョコが焦げないこと”。慌てて魔法を暴発させるたびにチョコが逃げ出し、森じゅうを走り回るのは毎年恒例。彼女にとってバレンタインとは、愛と混沌の追跡劇であるらしい。

A White Rabbit Girl wrapped in a sweet scent. Gripping her measuring spoon with a dead-serious face, she looks just like a battlefield commander... except her mission is 'don't let the chocolate burn.' Every year, whenever she panics and accidentally sets off her magic, the chocolate escapes and she ends up chasing it all through the forest. For her, Valentine's Day seems to be a chase scene made of love and chaos.

unit.402.profile: 困っているヒトを助けるため銀河の彼方から飛んで駆けつけてきたスターリターナー娘。幼く無邪気だが、ジャイアント娘に匹敵する巨体と、そこに秘められたパワーはとてつもない。しかし、その一方で燃費がすこぶる悪く、生命活動にはショタマターというショタの体液から採れるエネルギーを必要とする。口癖は「チョア！」。喜怒哀楽を表現する以外にも何にでも使える万能な言葉。同種族間では、この「チョア！」だけで全ての会話が賄えるという。

A Star Returner Girl who flew all the way from beyond the galaxy to help humans in trouble. She's young and innocent, but has a body comparable in size to a Giant Girl, along with tremendous hidden power. On the other hand, her fuel efficiency is extremely poor, and she needs energy drawn from a fluid called Shota Matter, taken from young boys, to sustain her life functions. Her catchphrase is 'Choa!' — an all-purpose word usable for expressing every emotion and more. Among her own kind, it's said that this one word, 'Choa!', can carry an entire conversation.

unit.403.profile: エロ本やエログッズを探しに、アンドロショタ星座からやってきたエルバッキー娘。杖をセンサーのようにエロ本・エログッズを見つけ、中身を検閲し、少年の教育に悪い過激なものがあった場合は捨てるのではなく、元の持ち主に返して厳重な管理を促している。自身は高等な宇宙人娘だと胸を張っているが、行動の多くが猫に酷似しているため、実は宇宙猫娘といったほうが正しいのではと噂されている。

An Elbucky Girl who came from the Andro-Shota constellation in search of adult magazines and adult goods. She uses her staff like a sensor to locate such magazines and goods, inspects their contents, and if she finds anything too extreme and bad for boys' upbringing, rather than throwing it away, she returns it to its original owner and urges them to keep it under strict control. She proudly claims to be a highly advanced alien girl, but since so much of her behavior closely resembles a cat's, it's rumored she might more accurately be called a space cat girl.

unit.404.profile: T.O.W.E.R.が生み出した、彼女の記憶を継承した新たな個体。小悪魔のような見た目をしているが、その行動理念は世界を守った英雄をひたすら甘やかすことらしく、とても優しく、ノリが良い。彼女が持つ目玉のようなモチーフの機械はアイカメラという名前で、常に録画を行っている。録画はT.O.W.E.R.にも共有されるが、取捨選択はティヴェルに一任されており、中には彼女が個人干渉するための、秘蔵映像も存在するらしい。

A new individual created by T.O.W.E.R., inheriting her memories. She looks like a little devil, but her guiding principle seems to be simply doting endlessly on the hero who protected the world — she's very kind and easygoing. The eyeball-motif device she carries is called an Eye Camera, and it's always recording. The footage is also shared with T.O.W.E.R., but the choice of what to keep is left entirely up to Tivel, and it seems some of it is footage she keeps secretly stored away for her own personal use.

unit.405.profile: 自然豊かな森を守るモンスター娘。失った６枚の『メラーム』を探している。『メラーム』とは７つ集めると世界を終わらせる不可視の鎧で、今、身にまとうのはその１枚。その目を見つめると石になり、口からは炎上発言が飛び出す。野生の食欲も旺盛で、マタンゴ娘を食材として狙っているとか。ストレスが溜まると森の奥で遠吠えをして発散しているらしい。

A monster girl who protects a forest rich in nature. She is searching for 6 lost pieces of the 'Meraam.' The 'Meraam' is an invisible armor that ends the world once 7 pieces are gathered, and what she currently wears is 1 of those pieces. Look into her eyes and you turn to stone, and inflammatory remarks come flying out of her mouth. She also has a hearty wild appetite, and is said to be eyeing Matango Girls as ingredients. When stress builds up, she apparently vents it by howling deep in the forest.

Healing Candy Gargoyle Girl

unit.406.profile: 石像のふりで“サプライズ手渡し”を狙う、純情なガーゴイル娘。計画はカンペキ——近づいたら石化を解いて、微笑んでチョコを差し出すだけ。ところが当日、見つめられた恥ずかしさでユイルの方が先にフリーズ。ごまかそうと口から水を噴いたら、その場は一瞬で“しっとり湯せん会場”に。見つめられるたびに心は熱く、頬は真っ赤、体だけカチコチ。照れと勇気の温度差に振り回されながらも、守りたい想いは少しずつ形になる。今年のバレンタインは、石の決意と、とろける恋心の綱引きになる予感らしい。

A pure-hearted Gargoyle Girl aiming for a 'surprise hand-delivery' by pretending to be a stone statue. The plan is perfect — once someone comes close, she'll simply undo her petrification, smile, and hold out the chocolate. On the day itself, though, the embarrassment of being looked at makes Yuiru freeze up first. When she tries to cover it up by spraying water from her mouth, the whole place instantly becomes a 'damp double-boiler venue.' Every time she's looked at, her heart burns hot, her cheeks turn bright red, and only her body stays stiff as stone. Tossed around by the gap in temperature between her shyness and her courage, the feelings she wants to protect are slowly taking shape. It seems this year's Valentine's Day will be a tug-of-war between stony resolve and a melting heart.

unit.407.profile: 炎のように光り輝くガルーダ娘。大人しく真面目そうに見えるが、実は怒りっぽく短気。そのため、どんな気性でも戦えるよう、扱いやすいムチを握っている。蛇が嫌いで、ある種族とは特に相容れない関係のようだ。その種族から霊薬を奪って飲んだことがあり、それから体液には滋養強壮の効果が表れたという。短気な部分を改めるため、時折ガンダルヴァ娘の歌を聴きに行き、心を落ち着かせているらしい。

A Garuda Girl who shines like flame. She looks quiet and serious, but is actually quick to anger and short-tempered. Because of this, she wields an easy-to-handle whip so she can fight no matter her mood. She dislikes snakes, and seems to be especially at odds with a certain race. She once stole and drank an elixir from that race, and ever since, her bodily fluids are said to have a restorative, invigorating effect. To try to fix her short temper, she apparently sometimes goes to listen to a Gandharva Girl's singing to calm her heart.

Max HP +20%
unit.408.profile: ゲシュペンス島の“えちち”が過積載し、進化したガイアドラゴン娘。島民健康祈願体操は、胸を張って深く息を入れ、腰をぐいっと前、尻をぷりっとキープ――という分かりやすい動きが中心。仕上げは聖油でぬるっと巡らせ、温まったところをゆっくり伸ばす。赤面者は続出するが、本人はきわどいフォームも「健康第一」で押し切るスタイル。

A Gaia Dragon Girl who evolved after Gespenst Island's 'sexiness' overloaded. Her islander health prayer exercise centers on simple moves: puff out the chest and breathe in deeply, thrust the hips forward, and hold the rear firm and round. The finishing touch is a slick rubdown with sacred oil, followed by a slow stretch once warmed up. Onlookers keep blushing one after another, but she pushes through even the most suggestive poses with a 'health first' attitude.
unit.409.title: アポカリプスドラゴン娘
Apocalypse Dragon Girl

unit.409.profile: 進化により、肉体も魔力も驚異的に高まったアポカリプスドラゴン娘。嬉々としてスキンシップを繰り出すが、力加減がまったく追いついていない。抱きつけば持ち上げ、尾を巻けば締め上げ、背に手を添えれば火の粉が舞う。加えて、接触時に感情が高ぶると体温と魔力が一気に上昇し、周りが危険地帯と化すことも。最近は服が焼ける事故が続き、周囲では「心も服も耐火仕様が必須」との声が上がっている。

An Apocalypse Dragon Girl whose body and magic power grew tremendously through evolution. She happily showers others with physical affection, but her strength control hasn't caught up at all. Hug her and she'll lift you up; have her wrap her tail around you and she'll squeeze; rest a hand on her back and sparks fly. On top of that, when her emotions run high during contact, her body heat and magic power spike all at once, sometimes turning the area into a danger zone. Lately there have been repeated incidents of clothes catching fire, and people around her have started saying that 'both hearts and clothes need to be fireproof.'
unit.410.title: ムシュフシュ娘
Mushussu Girl
race.410.text:
非スキル中は、60％の確率で最大2回追加攻撃が発生

The race trait's Skill Cooldown reduction effect now triggers 'when attacking a Burned or Poisoned enemy'
unit.410.profile: 長き眠りから目覚めた、大きな尻尾を振るうムシュフシュ娘。知識欲が旺盛で、歴史ある書物や遺跡を見かけると、まるで子供のように瞳を輝かせる。ある知識においては、サキュバス娘並みに精通しているようだ。ちなみにショタをイジめて介護する話が好きで好きでたまらないらしい。彼女がこっそり運営している同人サークル「むしゅふしゅ！」は、ゲシュペンス島の淑女たちから熱狂的に支持されている。

A Mushussu Girl who has awoken from a long sleep, wielding a great tail. She has an enormous thirst for knowledge, and her eyes light up like a child's whenever she comes across historic books or ruins. In one particular area of knowledge, she seems to be as well-versed as a Succubus Girl. Incidentally, she apparently loves nothing more than stories about teasing and then tenderly caring for boys. The doujin circle she secretly runs, 'Mushu Fushu!', has passionate support from the ladies of Gespenst Island.

Deals physical damage equal to 10% of own ATK to all Poisoned enemies every 1s
unit.411.profile: どこか神秘的でダウナーな雰囲気のあるギルタブルル娘。「私たちは神々の道具にすぎない」という独特な価値観を持っており、無気力で孤独な日々を送っている。ただ戦闘力は高く、だらだら戦うよりもサクッと倒す方が楽という心情で無慈悲に振るわれる鎌は死神のようだと恐れられているらしい。趣味は瞑想や黙祷で、理由は動かなくていいのと、昼寝しててもバレないからとのこと。

A Girtablilu Girl with a somewhat mysterious, low-energy air about her. She holds the peculiar view that 'we are nothing more than tools of the gods,' and spends her days listless and alone. Even so, her combat strength is high, and the sickle she swings mercilessly — reasoning that finishing enemies off quickly is easier than dragging out a fight — is said to be feared as something like a reaper's scythe. Her hobbies are meditation and silent prayer, for the reasons that she doesn't have to move and that no one notices if she's actually napping.

unit.412.profile: 偉大な魔女に育てられた使い魔のグリマルキン娘。いなくなった魔女の代わりに、闇の森の奥にある小さな館を守りつつ、魔女の残した魔法や調薬レシピを試している。偉大な魔女の使い魔である自分も偉大とプライドが高いが、実はさみしがり屋な一面も。夜は活発だが昼は眠たげなので、何か用事があるときは夜にお願いした方が上手くいく。

A Grimalkin Girl, a familiar raised by a great witch. In place of the witch who has since disappeared, she guards a small manor deep in the dark forest while experimenting with the magic and potion recipes the witch left behind. She's proud, believing that as the familiar of a great witch, she too must be great, but she's actually quite lonely deep down. She's active at night but drowsy during the day, so if you need something from her, asking at night works out better.
unit.413.title: ナーガ娘
Naga Girl

unit.413.profile: 意思を持つ蛇と一体化した髪が特徴のナーガ娘。好奇心旺盛な性格で、面白ければ何をしてもいいと考える節があるようだ。様々な毒を持つ『蛇ちゃん』たちを支配下に置き、状況に応じて使い分け、獲物を追い詰める。もちろん自身でも毒を持っており、それは心から彼女を信頼することで解毒できるという特殊なもの。気に入った相手には、文字通りに絡みに行き、モノにするまで放すことはないようだ。

A Naga Girl characterized by hair fused with sentient snakes. She's intensely curious by nature, and seems to hold the view that anything is fine as long as it's interesting. She keeps various venomous 'snake friends' under her control, using them differently depending on the situation to corner her prey. Naturally, she carries her own venom too, a special kind that can only be cured by trusting her from the bottom of your heart. When she takes a liking to someone, she goes to literally coil around them, and it seems she won't let go until she's made them hers.

unit.414.profile: 実験を繰り返した結果、自らの殻を破り、ムーンチャイルド娘に進化した。フラスコから解放されたことで、外界に対しての探究心＆知識欲が更に高まっている。対象に直に触れられるようになった喜びから、相手のパーソナルスペースを無視して、何でもベタベタ触りまくることがクセになっているようだ。うっかりトゲのあるものに触れてしまい、泣きながら逃げ帰る様子も目撃されているらしいが、当人は噂を否定している。

As a result of repeated experiments, she broke through her own shell and evolved into a Moon Child Girl. Freed from her flask, her curiosity and thirst for knowledge about the outside world have grown even further. Overjoyed at finally being able to touch things directly, she seems to have developed a habit of ignoring personal space and touching absolutely everything. She has reportedly been spotted accidentally touching something thorny and running home in tears, though she herself denies the rumor.

unit.415.profile: 強大な星力と固有の星術『引力操作』を操る異世界からやってきた竜の少女。新星学園の３年生であり、新星寮『ラルーナ』の寮長を務める。また竜族の名家である妃竜院家の長女にして次期当主でもある。小柄な見た目だが彼女自身は自分の肉体に自信を持っていて、力でも大柄な相手に決して引けを取らない。家訓である「竜たるもの、畏怖を持たれよ」という言葉を大切にし、常にそうあれるよう研鑽を重ねている。

A dragon girl from another world who wields immense star power and her own unique star art, 'Gravity Manipulation.' She is a 3th-year student at Nova Academy and serves as dormitory head of the Nova dorm 'Laluna.' She is also the eldest daughter, and next head, of the Hiryuin family, a distinguished house of the dragon clan. Though small in stature, she has full confidence in her own body, and never falls behind even larger opponents in strength. She cherishes her family motto, 'A dragon must be feared,' and constantly trains to always live up to it.

unit.416.profile: ミステリアスな気配漂う異界の騎士。誰かをからかうのが好きな気さくなお姉さんのように見えるが、一方で時折一線を引いたような冷たさを感じさせる。艶やかで特徴的な耳と尻尾を持つが決して誰にも触らせないらしい。ゲシュペンス島のお酒を気に入っているようで、酒好きのモンスター娘たちと夜な夜な晩酌を楽しんでいるとか。

An otherworldly knight with a mysterious air about her. She seems like a friendly older-sister type who likes to tease people, but at the same time she occasionally gives off a coldness, as if drawing a firm line. She has striking, lustrous ears and a tail, but apparently never lets anyone touch them. She seems to have taken a liking to Gespenst Island's liquor, and reportedly enjoys nightly drinks with the island's sake-loving monster girls.
unit.417.title: 妖怪を愛する名探偵
The Great Detective Who Loves Yokai

自身の攻撃力10％<aw>+2%</aw>分の継続ダメージを攻撃した相手に一定時間与える（この効果は重複しない）

Yokai Capture Gun

unit.417.profile: 異世界『アテネス』からやってきた浮世絵師。絵師として活動する一方で、街で起こる様々な事件に自ら進んで首を突っ込んでいく自称名探偵。妖怪をこよなく愛しており、あらゆる事件において妖怪が絡んでいると推測してしまうため、仲間達からは迷探偵と呼ばれることも。ところが、実際に妖怪が住んでいる妖怪島でのトラブルのほとんどが本当に妖怪の仕業のため、名推理を披露して、正真正銘の名探偵として大活躍している。

A ukiyo-e artist who came from the other world 'Athenes.' While active as an artist, she also willingly sticks her nose into every kind of incident that happens around town, calling herself a great detective. She loves Yokai more than anything, and because she always assumes Yokai are involved in every incident, her companions sometimes call her a 'bumbling detective' instead. However, since most of the trouble on Yokai Island, where Yokai actually live, really is the work of Yokai, she gets to show off her brilliant deductions and thrives as a genuine great detective.
unit.418.title: 人形使い
Puppeteer

unit.418.profile: 異世界『イリスクラウド』からやってきた呪術師。オオエ四天王と呼ばれている存在のひとり。クールな性格に見えるが、表に出すのが苦手なだけで、感情は豊かだという。純粋に人形が好き、というのもあるが、いつも抱いている人形は呪術の道具としても使っている。元の世界ではアマノハシダテという少女の世話役をしており、ゲシュペンス島での体験を彼女に伝えようと、日々精力的に島内を歩き回っている。

A sorceress who came from the other world 'Iris Cloud.' She is one of the beings known as the Ooe Four Heavenly Kings. She appears cool and composed, but is said to simply be bad at showing her feelings, which are actually quite rich. She purely loves dolls, but the doll she always holds also doubles as a tool for her sorcery. In her original world, she served as caretaker for a girl named Amanohashidate, and she now energetically wanders the island every day, eager to share her experiences on Gespenst Island with her.

unit.419.profile: 異界の探偵・セキエンの装束を身にまとったペガサス娘。探偵という肩書きには並々ならぬ憧れがあったらしく、意気揚々と謎探しに奔走している。得意の弓から銃に持ち替えたのは、セキエンへのリスペクトだけでなく、着物姿で銃を撃つのが一種のロマンだかららしい。この島で起こる事件の９割は密猟者の仕業な為、それが発覚するたび、また密猟者かとツッコミという名の銃弾を撃ち込んでいる。

A Pegasus Girl dressed in the outfit of the otherworldly detective Sekien. She apparently had an extraordinary longing for the title of 'detective,' and now runs around energetically chasing mysteries. She swapped her trusty bow for a gun, not only out of respect for Sekien, but also because firing a gun while wearing a kimono is, in its own way, quite romantic. Since 9 out of 10 incidents on this island turn out to be the work of poachers, every time she uncovers one, she fires off a bullet of retort that goes, 'poachers again?!'

unit.420.profile: 異界の獣人・シモアマヅの装束をまとったケルベロス娘。 おねショタ警察としての揺るがぬ正義感はそのままに、衣装の影響か、以前より冷静で落ち着いた振る舞いを見せるようになった。 暗い洞窟の奥で、物思いにふけることも増えたらしく、最近は人形遊びに夢中なのだという。

A Cerberus Girl wearing the outfit of the otherworldly beastfolk Shimoamazu. Her unshakeable sense of justice as a member of the Onee-Shota Police remains intact, but perhaps due to the influence of the outfit, she has started behaving in a calmer, more composed way than before. She's apparently taken to brooding deep in dark caves more often, and lately seems to be absorbed in playing with dolls.

unit.421.profile: 異世界からやってきた狂風の亜神。荒れ狂う風を司る悪霊の王でもある。そんな怖ろしい呼び名とは裏腹に気さくで接しやすい性格をしている。ただ自由奔放、制御不能で、気分次第で敵にも味方にもなるらしく、もしもそうなった時は、本物の嵐の如く無事過ぎ去ってくれるのを祈る以外無いという。

A demigod of the raging wind who came from another world. She is also the king of evil spirits who governs the raging, wild wind. Despite such a fearsome title, she has a friendly, easygoing personality. However, she is completely free-spirited and uncontrollable, and depending on her mood she may become either friend or foe — and if that happens, all one can do is pray she passes by safely, just like a real storm.

unit.422.profile: 『ＯＮＥショタ信号』を解析するために、アース０７２からやってきたＵＦＯ娘。本体は頭上の浮遊体であり、人型ホログラムを投影して会話をする。フリフリとした服装でパラソルを握っているが、どこかの星で見かけた雌型生命体を参考にしたようだ。そんな彼女は非科学的である幽霊やゾンビを信じない。だが得意な一発芸は、アメリから教わった幽体離脱。本気を出せば、質量を持った残像を生み出せるらしい。

A UFO Girl who came from Earth-072 to analyze the 'ONE Shota Signal.' Her true body is the floating object above her head, which projects a humanoid hologram to converse with others. She holds a frilly parasol, apparently modeled after a female life-form she once saw on some planet. Being the scientific type, she doesn't believe in unscientific things like ghosts or zombies. Still, her signature party trick, taught to her by Ameri, is astral projection — and if she goes all out, she can apparently even create an afterimage with actual mass.

unit.423.profile: 授業中によく居眠りをするシェイプシフター娘。睡眠学習中に教師がチョークを投げても、無意識に縦長の柱へ擬態して受け流している。学園に通っている理由は「昼寝の場所確保」と「学食のランチが美味しいから」という極めてシンプルなもの。気分次第で筆記用具から椅子まで何でも自分の体で生成するため、便利屋扱いされることも多いが、本人は全く気にしていない。褒められると調子に乗って余計な形に変わり、騒ぎを起こすのが玉にキズ。

A Shapeshifter Girl who often dozes off during class. Even when the teacher throws chalk at her while she's sleep-studying, she unconsciously disguises herself as a tall, thin pillar to deflect it. Her reasons for attending school are extremely simple: 'to secure a spot for napping' and 'because the cafeteria lunch is delicious.' Depending on her mood, she can turn her own body into anything from writing utensils to a chair, so she's often treated as a handy tool, though she doesn't mind at all. Her one flaw is that when praised, she gets carried away and shapeshifts into something unnecessary, causing a commotion.

unit.424.profile: 宇宙の果てからやってきた謎のどろどろモンスター娘。あらゆる生命体を吸収し同化する力を持っており、宇宙でもとても危険な存在と警戒されている。彼女自身も純粋で『同化＝仲良くなること』だと思っており、善悪の区別がついていない。彼女が大規模な同化を行うたびにアステリオムが退治にやってきていたが、ブロラは遊んでくれていると勘違いしている。弱点は冷気で想像するだけでも体が溶けてきてしまうらしい。

A mysterious, gooey monster girl who came from the far reaches of space. She has the power to absorb and assimilate any life form, and is considered a highly dangerous being even out in space. She herself is pure of heart and believes 'assimilation equals becoming friends,' unable to tell good from evil. Every time she carries out a large-scale assimilation, Asterium comes to subdue her, but Brora mistakenly thinks Asterium is just playing with her. Her weakness is cold — apparently, her body starts to melt just from imagining it.
unit.425.title: トライポッド娘

unit.425.profile: 巨大で頑丈な三脚の外骨格を持つモンスター娘。マーシアン娘たちの戦闘兵器「トライポッド」が、モンスター娘として自我を得た存在。かつては忠実な兵器だったようだが、自我を持ったことでマーシアン娘に反旗を翻し、激しい戦いへと発展した。やがて、マーシアン娘たちが散布したウイルスにより、戦意が消失。戦争は終結した。「脚が多い＝えらいひと」という価値観を持ち、クラーケン娘やスキュラ娘を心から尊敬している。わざと不安定なところで考え事をするのが趣味。考えていることはマーシアン娘殲滅計画……などでは決してない。

A monster girl with a massive, sturdy tripod exoskeleton. She is the Martian Girls' combat weapon, the 'Tripod,' which gained self-awareness and became a monster girl. She was apparently once a loyal weapon, but upon gaining self-awareness she turned against the Martian Girls, leading to a fierce battle. Eventually, a virus scattered by the Martian Girls wiped out her will to fight, bringing the war to an end. She holds the belief that 'more legs equals a more admirable person,' and deeply respects Kraken Girls and Scylla Girls. Her hobby is deliberately thinking things over while perched somewhere unstable. What she's thinking about is definitely not a plan to wipe out the Martian Girls... definitely not.

unit.426.profile: 頭部に巨大な角を持ち、芳醇かつ危険な毒を身に潜ませるバシュム娘。肌から滲み出る毒は、触れた者の理性を蕩けさせる効能を持つ。毒は香水化して販売しているらしく、評判は上々のようだ。また出来事のエッチさを『チェリー』という単位で評価する活動をしており、エピソードトークの強さを競う大会も定期的に開催しているらしい。特技は口の中でサクランボの茎を結べること。

A Bashmu Girl with a huge horn on her head, harboring a richly fragrant yet dangerous venom within her body. The venom that seeps from her skin has the effect of melting away the reason of anyone who touches it. She apparently sells her venom turned into perfume, and it seems to be quite popular. She also runs an activity that rates how naughty an event is using a unit called 'Cherries,' and reportedly holds regular tournaments where people compete over the raciness of their stories. Her special talent is being able to tie a cherry stem into a knot with just her mouth.
unit.427.title: クイユポニョン娘
Kuiyu Ponyon Girl
race.427.text:
射程+50<aw>+10</aw>、飛行して移動
3回攻撃するごとにミサイルを発射し、着弾地点が炎上し毎秒発動時攻撃力50％の持続ダメージが発生
攻撃時、相手にスタン値を蓄積（小）、さらに低確率で暗闇にする

Range +50<aw>+10</aw>, moves by flying
Every 3 attacks, fires a missile; the point of impact catches fire, dealing damage over time each second equal to 50% of ATK at the time of activation
On attack, builds up Stun (Small) on the enemy, and also has a low chance to inflict Darkness

Golden Radiance Bomb: Kuiyu Ponyon

Damage dealt to Stunned or Darkened enemies ×1.5
unit.427.profile: 『金煌爆球クイユポニョン』がモンスター娘化した姿。捨てられていたが、時を経てなぜかモンスター娘として復活した。お嬢様然としているが、感情制御が下手で喜怒哀楽の変化が激しく、暴走しがち。心の奥では「もう二度と捨てられたくない」と願っているようだ。

The form the 'Golden Radiance Bomb: Kuiyu Ponyon' took after becoming a monster girl. She was once thrown away, but somehow, after some time, was reborn as a monster girl. She carries herself like a young lady of high standing, but is bad at controlling her emotions, swinging wildly between joy, anger, sorrow, and delight, and tends to go out of control. Deep down in her heart, she seems to wish, 'I never want to be thrown away again.'
unit.428.title: ささやく夜風
The Whispering Night Wind

The Golden Thread's Lure

Summoning of the Yellow Robe

Book of the Yellow Wind
weapon.428.text: 配置中、味方のトークンの与えるダメージ1.4倍
While deployed, damage dealt by ally Tokens ×1.4
unit.428.profile: 異世界からやってきた、気まぐれで自由奔放な魔女。実は『ハスター』という神の力を宿しており、最強の魔導師と恐れられている。そのため魔術のレベルは高く、適性のない魔術でも難なく使用できるようだ。普段はおっとりとした優しい女性だが、時折、別人のように厳しい態度を見せることがあるらしい。

A whimsical, free-spirited witch who came from another world. She actually carries the power of a god called 'Hastur' within her, and is feared as the strongest sorceress. Because of this, her level of magic is extremely high, and she can apparently use even spells she has no natural aptitude for without any trouble. She's usually a gentle, easygoing woman, but is said to occasionally show a strict attitude, as if she were a completely different person.
unit.429.title: クルッル娘
Kururu Girl

編成時、<t=海魔>海魔</t>の攻撃力+12％<aw>+3％</aw>、物理防御力+10％<aw>+3％</aw>

非スキル中、通常攻撃がブロック中の敵1体への範囲魔法攻撃に変化し、攻撃した相手の魔法防御を5％減少

When formed into a team, <t=海魔>Sea Monster</t>'s ATK +12%<aw>+3%</aw>, DEF +10%<aw>+3</aw>%

Aqua of the Great Sea

awaken.90088.name: 水属性マスボーナス3倍
Water element tile bonus ×3
unit.429.profile: 深海に棲みつき、めったに表へ出てこない引きこもりのクルッル娘。深海の情報網『海洋ネット』を自在に使いこなし、日がな一日、同人誌の通販や感想巡りに没頭している。同人誌愛好家としても筋金入りで、自身でもレビューブログを運営しているらしい。「芸術に優劣も貴賤もない」というのが彼女の信条で、どんな作品にもまず敬意を払い、なるべく甘口のレビューを心がけている。また『沿岸部の守護者』として海岸でのゴミ拾いも活動のひとつとしている。決してお宝本を拾い集めるためではない……たぶん。

A shut-in Kururu Girl who lives in the deep sea and rarely comes out to the surface. She freely makes use of the deep sea's information network, the 'Ocean Net,' and spends her days absorbed in ordering doujinshi and browsing reviews. She's a hardcore doujinshi enthusiast, and apparently runs her own review blog. Her motto is 'there is no superiority or inferiority in art,' and she always tries to show respect for every work first, aiming to write reviews that are as gentle as possible. As a self-proclaimed 'guardian of the coastline,' she also makes beach cleanups one of her activities. It's definitely not just to pick up treasured books that wash ashore... probably.
unit.430.title: 工学のノーム娘
Engineer Gnome Girl

<t=飛行ノームロボトークン>飛行ノームロボトークン</t>を使役
スキル発動時、自身のマスに<t=砲台ノームロボトークン>砲台ノームロボトークン</t>を召喚する

Damage dealt by Flying/Turret Gnome Robot Tokens ×1.1
unit.430.profile: モンスター娘学園『ぴかぴか工作部』部長のノーム娘。その柔軟な発想力を活かし、学園の備品を作ったり、修理したりして活躍している。工作部の部室からはよく爆発音が聞こえるが、日常茶飯事なので誰も気にしていない。そんな彼女だが、たまに、自分自身にそっくりなロボットと並んで歩いている。それを見た新入生はしばらく、彼女たちを双子だと勘違いするらしい。

A Gnome Girl who serves as president of Monster Girl Academy's 'Sparkle Workshop Club.' She makes good use of her flexible creativity, actively building and repairing equipment for the school. Explosions are often heard from the workshop clubroom, but since it's an everyday occurrence, no one pays it any mind. Every now and then, though, she can be seen walking alongside a robot that looks just like her. New students who see this apparently mistake the two of them for twins for a while.
unit.431.title: ワイトロード娘
Wight Lord Girl
race.431.text:
配置中に死亡した敵の数に応じて自身の攻撃力+15％<aw>+3％</aw>
自身が敵を3体撃破する毎に周囲のマスに<t=ソウルトークン>ソウルトークン</t>を1体召喚
スキル発動時に全てのソウルトークンを即死させ、自身射程内の敵に対象の最大HP10％分のダメージを与える

Own ATK +15%<aw>+3</aw>% based on the number of enemies that have died while deployed
For every 3 enemies this unit defeats, summons 1 <t=ソウルトークン>Soul Token</t> onto surrounding tiles
On skill activation, instantly defeats all Soul Tokens, and deals damage equal to 10% of the target's Max HP to enemies in own range

Guide of Lost Souls

[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍、攻撃対象数+5
スキル発動時、全てのソウルトークンと射程内の敵の数に応じてCRI率とCRI上限+15％

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0], attack target count +5

Soul Blast

（再出撃時間短縮は重複不可）

Redeploy time of allies in range is reduced by 50%
(Redeploy time reduction does not stack)
unit.431.profile: 多くの霊魂から力を得たことで進化したワイトロード娘。霊魂やアンデッドを操る力は飛躍的に高まり、その支配はかつてない領域へと及んでいる。『魂の抜ける』ような独特な歌声は霊魂に安らぎを与えると同時に、その力を自らの糧へと変えるものらしい。かつてはツンツンイライラしていたことも多かったが、ゲシュペンス島の生命すべてをワイト化できるほどの力を得たことで、多少のことは「許してあげるわ、今は」という心の余裕が生まれたようだ。

A Wight Lord Girl who evolved by drawing power from countless souls. Her ability to command spirits and Undead has grown by leaps and bounds, and her dominion now extends into territory never reached before. Her uniquely 'soul-draining' singing voice gives spirits peace while also converting their power into her own sustenance. She used to be irritable and prickly quite often, but having gained enough power to turn every living thing on Gespenst Island into a Wight, she now seems to have gained the mental composure to say, 'I'll forgive you, for now,' about most small things.
unit.432.title: だいだらぼっち娘
Daidarabotchi Girl
race.432.text:

Giant of Land Creation

1度だけ攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍で攻撃を行う
自身がブロックしている場合は与えるダメージ3倍で敵1体に範囲攻撃、ブロックしていない場合は周囲の敵8体に遠距離攻撃を行う

Attacks 1 time(s) at ATK ×[MAG,0,0]

Earth-Shattering Creation Strike
weapon.432.name: 大地創造の籠手
Gauntlet of Earth Creation
weapon.432.text: 地上の敵への与えるダメージ2倍
unit.432.profile: 妖怪島の創生に関わったとされる、怪力無双のだいだらぼっち娘。文明や街を踏みつぶし、滅ぼした過去があると言われているが、性格は至って穏やか。普段は山に腰掛けてぼんやり空を眺めているが、そのまま尻を突き出して寝てしまうのが玉にきず。その巨大な尻が「幻の双子山」として近隣住民に目撃されるようになり、今日も島には新たな伝説が刻まれつつある。

A Daidarabotchi Girl of unmatched monstrous strength, said to have taken part in the creation of Yokai Island. She's said to have a past of crushing civilizations and destroying towns underfoot, but her personality is thoroughly gentle. She usually sits on a mountain, gazing absentmindedly at the sky, but her one flaw is that she tends to fall asleep like that with her rear sticking out. Her enormous rear has come to be spotted by nearby residents as the 'Phantom Twin Peaks,' and even today, a new legend is being carved into the island.
unit.433.title: 隠形鬼娘
Invisible Oni Girl
race.433.text:
敵の遠距離攻撃の対象にならない
ワープして移動するが、移動コスト+5
敵の背面から攻撃時、与えるダメージが2.5倍<aw>+0.2倍</aw>
スキル発動中、射程内の味方は闇属性マスに配置中の状態になり、さらに敵の遠距離攻撃の対象にならない

Cannot be targeted by enemy ranged attacks
Moves by warping, but Move cost +5
When attacking from behind an enemy, damage dealt ×2.5<aw>+0.2</aw>
While the skill is active, allies in range are treated as deployed on a Dark element tile, and also cannot be targeted by enemy ranged attacks
race.433.name: 黒霧の鬼
Oni of the Black Mist
race.433.bonus: 敵の背面から攻撃時、与えるダメージが+0.2倍
When attacking from behind an enemy, damage dealt +0.2×

[duration]秒、攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
物理攻撃を100％回避
攻撃が巨大手裏剣になり直進し触れた敵全てを攻撃する遠距離攻撃を行う

For [duration]s, ATK ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Evades physical attacks with 100% chance
Attacks become a giant shuriken performing a ranged attack that travels straight and hits all enemies it touches
skill.433.name: 影の帳
Curtain of Shadow
weapon.433.name: 隠影十字手裏剣
Hidden Shadow Cross Shuriken
weapon.433.text: 編成時、レンタルを含めず味方の属性の内、水/風/光/闇属性1種類ごとに妖怪の味方の攻撃力+4％（最大16％）
When formed into a team, not counting rentals, Yokai allies' ATK +4% for every 1 types of Water/Wind/Light/Dark elements among allies (up to 16%)
unit.433.profile: 姿を消して人を惑わすと恐れられた妖怪系モンスター娘。本来は妖怪島での霊山で“影の番”を務める守護鬼だったが、ゲシュペンス島の強いショタ力に引き寄せられ、やってきた。秘密結社『冥界』の妖怪島支部にも所属している。恥ずかしがり屋な性格で、極度に緊張すると姿が透明になり、消えてしまう。姿を見失うと足音や呼吸さえ聞こえなくなるため、“かくれんぼ最強モンスター娘”として恐れられている。鬼娘のホヅキとは血縁関係にあり、意外と酒豪らしい。

A Yokai-type monster girl feared for vanishing and leading people astray. She was originally a guardian Oni serving as the 'Shadow Watch' on a sacred mountain of Yokai Island, but she was drawn to Gespenst Island by its powerful shota energy and came here. She also belongs to the Yokai Island branch of the secret society 'Underworld.' She's shy by nature, and when extremely nervous, her form turns transparent and she disappears entirely. Once she's out of sight, not even her footsteps or breathing can be heard, so she's feared as the 'strongest monster girl at hide-and-seek.' She's related by blood to the Oni girl Hozuki, and is apparently surprisingly strong when it comes to drinking.
unit.434.title: 雲外鏡娘
Ungaikyo Girl
race.434.text:
射程内の敵の移動速度、攻撃速度を減少
射程内の敵はHPが15%<aw>+3％</aw>以下になると即死（ボスには無効）
味方がいるマスのみ配置可能な<t=鏡像トークン>鏡像トークン</t>を使役
スキル発動時、<t=鏡像トークン>鏡像トークン</t>を自身に付与する

Reduces the Move speed and Attack speed of enemies in range
Enemies in range are instantly defeated when their HP falls to 15%<aw>+3</aw>% or below (ineffective against bosses)
Commands <t=鏡像トークン>Mirror Image Token</t>, which can only be deployed on tiles with allies
On skill activation, grants itself <t=鏡像トークン>Mirror Image Token</t>
race.434.name: 真偽を量る鏡
The Mirror That Weighs Truth and Falsehood
race.434.bonus: HP threshold for the instant-defeat effect +3%
skill.434.text:
[duration]秒、自身と鏡像トークンの攻撃力[MAG,0,0]倍、射程[MAG,1,0]倍
全ての味方が受ける回復効果1.5倍

For [duration]s, ATK of self and Mirror Image Tokens ×[MAG,0,0], Range ×[MAG,1,0]
Healing effects received by all allies ×1.5
skill.434.name: 虚堂懸鏡
Mirror of the Empty Hall
weapon.434.name: 照魔鏡
Demon-Revealing Mirror
weapon.434.text: 自身の与える回復量、鏡像トークンの与えるダメージがそれぞれ1.2倍
Own healing given and damage dealt by Mirror Image Tokens each ×1.2
unit.434.profile: 真実の姿を明らかにする鏡を持つモンスター娘。争いや真偽を決める場に現れ、照魔鏡の力を用いて『判決』を言い渡す。そして照魔鏡に映る彼女の姿こそが、素の彼女だ。鏡像は、物静かで落ち着いた本体とは反対に、血の気が多く乱暴。隠されていた欲求を発散するかのように、自由奔放に動き回る。そんな彼女たちは、起きるとまず、お互いの身だしなみを整え合うのだという。

A monster girl who carries a mirror that reveals one's true form. She appears at scenes of conflict and disputes over truth, using the power of her Demon-Revealing Mirror to pass 'judgment.' The figure reflected in the Demon-Revealing Mirror is, in fact, her true self. Unlike her quiet, composed main body, her mirror image is hot-blooded and rough. As if venting pent-up desires, it moves about however it pleases. When the two of them wake up, they apparently first make sure to fix up each other's appearance.
unit.435.title: ダゴン娘
Dagon Girl
race.435.text:

編成時、水属性モンスター娘のHPと攻撃力+8%

unit.435.profile: 小山ほど巨大で、鱗や水かきのついた手足を持つモンスター娘。海の底でうごめく「深きものたち」を束ねる統率者。その声ひとつで潮は逆巻き、深淵から現れし軍勢が彼女の前に跪くという。ただし彼女の関心は、地上を恐怖に陥れる事でも支配する事でもなく、ヒュドラ娘のユラを崇めて甘やかすことらしい。

A monster girl as huge as a small mountain, with scaled, webbed limbs. She is the leader who commands the 'Deep Ones' that stir at the bottom of the sea. With a single call from her, the tides are said to reverse, and armies rising from the abyss kneel before her. However, her true interest lies not in plunging the surface world into terror or ruling over it, but in worshipping and doting on the Hydra Girl Yura.

unit.436.profile:
ある時は探究の徒、またある時は導きの師。ふたつの顔を使い
分けられるミノタウロス娘。そんな彼女の授業は、のんびりと
した口調のわりに、とても質が高いと学生からは人気だ。キラ
リと輝く眼鏡の奥から全員を観察しているらしい。よく牛乳を
飲んでおり、飲み物が買えない金欠の学生にも分けてくれる。
ちなみにその牛乳はとても美味しいようなのだが、どこで買っ
たのかは教えてくれない。

At times a seeker of knowledge, at other times a guiding teacher — a Minotaur Girl who can switch
between these two faces. Despite her laid-back tone,
her classes are very high quality and are popular with students. Behind her
glinting glasses, she seems to be observing everyone. She often drinks
milk, and shares it with cash-strapped students who can't afford drinks.
Incidentally, that milk seems to be very delicious, but she
won't tell anyone where she buys it.

unit.437.profile: 深い山の中に住み、迷い込んだ者に食事や宿を振る舞う、老女の姿をしたモンスター娘。普段は穏やかで世話焼きの「おばあさん」もとい「お母さん」だが、山を汚す者の気配を感じた瞬間、その姿は恐ろしいものへと変わるようだ。世話を焼くのが大好きで、汚れた服や傷ついた身体を見つけると、自慢の知恵袋を駆使してあっという間に解決してしまう。若い頃は派手なメイクのギャルだったようで、蛇骨婆娘とふたりで色々と食い散らかしていたらしい。

A monster girl who lives deep in the mountains, taking the form of an old woman, and offers food and lodging to those who lose their way. She's usually a gentle, caring 'grandmother' — or rather, 'mother' — but the moment she senses the presence of someone defiling the mountain, her form is said to turn into something terrifying. She loves taking care of people, and whenever she finds dirty clothes or an injured body, she puts her prized bag of wisdom to use and resolves it in an instant. In her younger days she was apparently a flashy, heavily made-up gal, and she and the Jakotsu-baba Girl are said to have gone around devouring all sorts of things together.

unit.439.profile: どんな天気でも傘を持ち歩き、絶対に手放さないからかさ小僧娘。舌を出しながら、片足立ちで移動する癖がある。脚力には意外と自信があるらしい。そんな彼女は、一つ目小僧娘のメイムと幼なじみのようだ。メイムのことを『推し』と呼び崇拝しており、話題を耳にするだけで挙動不審になる。ちなみにメイムの持っている笠は、アマササが贈ったもの。夜通しその自慢話をするのが、彼女の日課となっている。

A Karakasa Girl who carries her umbrella around no matter the weather and never lets go of it. She has a habit of moving around while hopping on one leg with her tongue sticking out. She's apparently surprisingly confident in her leg strength. She and the One-Eyed Boy Girl Maime seem to be childhood friends. She calls Maime her 'favorite' and worships her, getting visibly flustered just at the mention of her. Incidentally, the umbrella Maime carries was a gift from Amasasa. Bragging about that, all night long, has become her daily routine.

unit.440.profile: 『白無垢』をまとったさとり娘。ゲシュペンス島では珍しい美しい衣装のため、羨望の目と「うらやまけしからん」などの心の声が集まっており、常にご機嫌に笑っている。鍛えた料理の腕と心が読めることから『花嫁ぱわぁ』最強を自称しており、からかう態度ながら、たまに見せる献身的な姿は色々な意味で強力。とんでもないダークホースが現れたと、モンスター娘達の間で警戒が高まっているらしい。

A Satori Girl wearing a 'shiromuku' bridal kimono. Since such a beautiful outfit is rare on Gespenst Island, she draws envious looks and mental voices muttering things like 'how dare she look so good,' and she's always grinning happily. Thanks to her well-honed cooking skills and her mind-reading ability, she calls herself the strongest in 'bridal power,' and though she has a teasing attitude, the devoted side she occasionally shows is powerful in more ways than one. Word has it that an outrageous dark horse has appeared, and wariness is rising among the monster girls.

unit.441.profile: 命の循環を見届ける「スターリターナー」の少女。定めに抗うことなく、消えゆく命も自然な理として静かに見守る運命論者である。理知的な雰囲気からアステリオムの姉だと誤解されることも多いが、実際は妹。彼女自身は姉を深く尊敬しているため、立場を間違えられることを極端に嫌っている。趣味は偉大な姉のヒーローカードを作って配布することで、中には当たりつきのレアカードも存在するらしい。なお、掛け声の「ゼゥア！」には「ゼゥア！」「ゼゥイッ！」「ゼゥウッ！」という三段活用があるようだ。

A 'Star Returner' girl who watches over the cycle of life. She is a fatalist who does not resist destiny, quietly watching over even fading lives as a natural part of the order of things. Her intellectual air often leads people to mistake her for Asterium's older sister, but she is actually the younger sister. Since she deeply respects her sister, she absolutely hates having their positions mixed up. Her hobby is making and distributing hero cards of her great sister, and some of them are apparently rare cards with a prize attached. Incidentally, her battle cry, 'Zoah!', seems to have three variations: 'Zoah!', 'Zoit!', and 'Zoot!'

unit.442.profile: 漆黒のウェディングドレスを身にまとったデーモンロード娘。花嫁衣装は妹であるアンティモーから「永久就職しやがれですよ」の言葉と共に贈られたものらしい。身軽な装いにあわせて、武器も短剣へと持ち替えている。慣れない正装に恐縮しつつも、鏡を見るたびに綻ぶ笑みは隠せない。近くに妹の気配を感じつつ、二刀をぶんぶん振り回し、幸せに浮かれているようだ。

A Demon Lord Girl dressed in a jet-black wedding gown. The bridal outfit was apparently a gift from her younger sister Antimo, given with the words, 'Get yourself permanently employed already!' To match her lighter attire, she's also switched her weapon to a pair of short swords. Though she feels a bit self-conscious in such unfamiliar formal wear, she can't hide the smile that breaks out every time she looks in the mirror. Sensing her sister nearby, she happily swings her twin blades around, positively giddy with joy.
unit.443.title: 契雨のヴォジャノーイ娘
Rain-Vowed Vodyanoy Girl
race.443.text:
敵を5体撃破ごとに、10秒間天候：<t=雨>雨</t>にする
天候：<t=雨>雨</t>状態の時、自身の攻撃速度+40％<aw>+10％</aw>し、スキル待機時間が2秒ごとに1秒減少する

The Frog's Wedding

During Weather: Rain, own HP recovers 5% of Max HP every second
unit.443.profile: 婚姻の儀に使われる勝負服に身を包んだヴォジャノーイ娘。彼女が携えているのは、柄を長くした特別仕様のウェディングナイフ。舌で掴み、振るうことで、どんなに高いところにある枝でも切り落とせるのだという。余計な枝葉を切るその技は、まるで見事な曲芸。巷では人気を集めており、常におひねりが舞い飛んでいる。それで結婚資金を稼いでいるのだとか。ちなみにドレスはとてもキツいようで、彼女の体から分泌される粘液を上手く使わないと、着ることも脱ぐこともできないらしい。

A Vodyanoy Girl dressed in her finest outfit for the marriage ceremony. What she carries is a specially made wedding knife with an extended handle. By gripping it with her tongue and swinging it, she can apparently cut down branches no matter how high up they are. Her technique of trimming away excess branches and leaves looks like a magnificent acrobatic act. She's gathered quite a following among the public, and tips are always flying her way. It's said she's using that money to save up for her wedding. Incidentally, her dress is apparently extremely tight, and she can't put it on or take it off without skillfully using the mucus her body secretes.

unit.444.profile: 淫魔にして夜の女王でありながら、涼しげな水着姿の装いでビーチへ降り立ったリリス娘。もともと自由奔放な性格なのに、開放感あふれる浜辺の空気で一層フリーダムと化し、スキンシップは五割増し、発言の過激さは倍増と、周囲をいつも以上に当惑させている。「過激なのは照りつける太陽のせいです♪」などと証言しているものの、説得力に欠けるのは日頃の行いのせいか。抱いている人形は彼女お手製の一品だが、何やら妖しげな秘密の機能が隠されているともっぱらの噂。

A Lilith Girl, succubus and Queen of the Night, who has landed on the beach in a cool, refreshing swimsuit. Already free-spirited by nature, the open, liberating air of the beach has made her even more unrestrained — her physical affection is up fifty percent, and the outrageousness of her remarks has doubled, leaving everyone around her more flustered than usual. She claims, 'It's the blazing sun's fault I'm so wild ♪,' but perhaps due to her usual behavior, it's not very convincing. The doll she holds is one she made herself, though rumor has it some mysterious, secret function is hidden inside.
